May compile data pertaining to size, content, condition, and other characteristics of forest tracts under the direction of foresters, or train and lead forest workers in forest propagation and fire prevention and suppression. May assist conservation scientists in managing, improving, and protecting rangelands and wildlife habitats.

jobs.d: 收集、识别、分类和分析与刑事调查相关的物证。对武器或物质（例如纤维、头发和组织）进行测试，以确定对调查的意义。可以作为专家证人就证据或犯罪实验室技术作证。可以担任弹道学、指纹识别、笔迹或生物化学等专业领域的专家。
jobs.de: Collect, identify, classify, and analyze physical evidence related to criminal investigations. Perform tests on weapons or substances, such as fiber, hair, and tissue to determine significance to investigation. May testify as expert witnesses on evidence or crime laboratory techniques. May serve as specialists in area of expertise, such as ballistics, fingerprinting, handwriting, or biochemistry.

jobs.d: 进行测试以确定原材料、散装中间体和成品的质量。可进行稳定性样品测试。
jobs.de: Conduct tests to determine quality of raw materials, bulk intermediate and finished products. May conduct stability sample tests.

jobs.d: 应用遥感技术为自然资源、城市规划或国土安全等领域的科学家提供帮助。可以为飞行旅行准备飞行计划或传感器配置。
jobs.de: Apply remote sensing technologies to assist scientists in areas such as natural resources, urban planning, or homeland security. May prepare flight plans or sensor configurations for flight trips.

jobs.d: 审查、评估和分析工作环境并设计计划和程序，以控制、消除和预防由化学、物理和生物因素或人体工程学因素引起的疾病或伤害。可以进行检查并强制遵守有关个人健康和安全的法律法规。可以受雇于公共或私营部门。
jobs.de: Review, evaluate, and analyze work environments and design programs and procedures to control, eliminate, and prevent disease or injury caused by chemical, physical, and biological agents or ergonomic factors. May conduct inspections and enforce adherence to laws and regulations governing the health and safety of individuals. May be employed in the public or private sector.

jobs.t: 职业健康和安全技术人员
jobs.d: 收集工作环境数据，供职业健康和安全专家进行分析。实施并评估旨在限制工人化学、物理、生物和人体工程学风险的计划。
jobs.de: Collect data on work environments for analysis by occupational health and safety specialists. Implement and conduct evaluation of programs designed to limit chemical, physical, biological, and ergonomic risks to workers.

jobs.t: 药物滥用和行为障碍顾问
jobs.d: 为患有酒精、烟草、毒品或其他问题（例如赌博和饮食失调）的个人提供咨询和建议。可以为个人、家庭或团体提供咨询或参与预防计划。
jobs.te: Substance Abuse and Behavioral Disorder Counselors
jobs.de: Counsel and advise individuals with alcohol, tobacco, drug, or other problems, such as gambling and eating disorders. May counsel individuals, families, or groups or engage in prevention programs.

jobs.t: 教育、指导和职业辅导员和顾问
jobs.d: 为学生提供建议和协助，并提供教育和职业指导服务。
jobs.te: Educational, Guidance, and Career Counselors and Advisors
jobs.de: Advise and assist students and provide educational and vocational guidance services.

jobs.d: 在婚姻和家庭系统的背景下诊断和治疗精神和情感障碍，无论是认知、情感还是行为。应用心理治疗和家庭系统理论和技术向个人、夫妇和家庭提供服务，以治疗此类诊断出的神经和精神障碍。
jobs.de: Diagnose and treat mental and emotional disorders, whether cognitive, affective, or behavioral, within the context of marriage and family systems. Apply psychotherapeutic and family systems theories and techniques in the delivery of services to individuals, couples, and families for the purpose of treating such diagnosed nervous and mental disorders.

jobs.d: 为个人和团体提供咨询和建议，以促进最佳的心理和情绪健康，重点是预防。可以帮助个人处理广泛的心理健康问题，例如与成瘾和药物滥用相关的问题；家庭、养育子女和婚姻问题；压力管理；自尊；
jobs.de: Counsel and advise individuals and groups to promote optimum mental and emotional health, with an emphasis on prevention. May help individuals deal with a broad range of mental health issues, such as those associated with addictions and substance abuse; family, parenting, and marital problems; stress management; self-esteem; or aging.

jobs.d: 为个人提供咨询，以最大限度地提高个人的独立性和就业能力，以应对因出生缺陷、疾病、疾病、事故、衰老或日常生活压力而导致的个人、社会和职业困难。协调护理和治疗设施居民的活动。评估客户需求并设计和实施康复计划，其中可能包括个人和职业咨询、培训和就业安置。
jobs.de: Counsel individuals to maximize the independence and employability of persons coping with personal, social, and vocational difficulties that result from birth defects, illness, disease, accidents, aging, or the stress of daily life. Coordinate activities for residents of care and treatment facilities. Assess client needs and design and implement rehabilitation programs that may include personal and vocational counseling, training, and job placement.

jobs.t: 儿童、家庭和学校社会工作者
jobs.d: 提供社会服务和援助，以改善儿童及其家庭的社会和心理功能，并最大限度地提高家庭福祉和儿童的学业功能。可以协助父母，安排收养，并为被遗弃或受虐待的儿童寻找寄养家庭。在学校里，他们解决青少年怀孕、行为不端和逃学等问题。还可以为教师提供建议。
jobs.te: Child, Family, and School Social Workers
jobs.de: Provide social services and assistance to improve the social and psychological functioning of children and their families and to maximize the family well-being and the academic functioning of children. May assist parents, arrange adoptions, and find foster homes for abandoned or abused children. In schools, they address such problems as teenage pregnancy, misbehavior, and truancy. May also advise teachers.

jobs.d: 为个人、家庭和团体提供应对慢性、急性或绝症所需的社会心理支持。服务包括为家庭护理人员提供建议。为患者提供信息和咨询，并转介其他服务。还可以提供病例和护理管理或干预措施，旨在促进健康、预防疾病和解决获得医疗保健的障碍。
jobs.de: Provide individuals, families, and groups with the psychosocial support needed to cope with chronic, acute, or terminal illnesses. Services include advising family caregivers. Provide patients with information and counseling, and make referrals for other services. May also provide case and care management or interventions designed to promote health, prevent disease, and address barriers to access to healthcare.

jobs.t: 心理健康和药物滥用社会工作者
jobs.d: 评估和治疗有精神、情绪或药物滥用问题的个人，包括滥用酒精、烟草和/或其他药物。活动可能包括个人和团体治疗、危机干预、病例管理、客户宣传、预防和教育。
jobs.te: Mental Health and Substance Abuse Social Workers
jobs.de: Assess and treat individuals with mental, emotional, or substance abuse problems, including abuse of alcohol, tobacco, and/or other drugs. Activities may include individual and group therapy, crisis intervention, case management, client advocacy, prevention, and education.

jobs.d: 提供和管理健康教育计划，帮助个人、家庭及其社区最大限度地提高和保持健康的生活方式。在规划、实施、监测和评估旨在鼓励健康生活方式、政策和环境的计划之前，使用数据来确定社区需求。可以将卫生系统、卫生服务提供者、保险公司和患者联系起来，以满足个人和人口的健康需求。可以作为帮助个人、其他卫生专业人员或社区的资源，并可以管理健康教育计划的财政资源。
jobs.de: Provide and manage health education programs that help individuals, families, and their communities maximize and maintain healthy lifestyles. Use data to identify community needs prior to planning, implementing, monitoring, and evaluating programs designed to encourage healthy lifestyles, policies, and environments. May link health systems, health providers, insurers, and patients to address individual and population health needs. May serve as resource to assist individuals, other health professionals, or the community, and may administer fiscal resources for health education programs.

jobs.t: 缓刑官员和惩教治疗专家
jobs.d: 提供社会服务，协助被拘留、缓刑或假释的违法犯罪者康复。就涉及制定康复计划和罪犯待遇的行动提出建议，包括有条件释放以及教育和就业规定。
jobs.te: Probation Officers and Correctional Treatment Specialists
jobs.de: Provide social services to assist in rehabilitation of law offenders in custody or on probation or parole. Make recommendations for actions involving formulation of rehabilitation plan and treatment of offender, including conditional release and education and employment stipulations.

jobs.d: 协助其他社会和人类服务提供者在各个领域提供客户服务，例如心理学、康复或社会工作，包括对家庭的支持。可以协助客户确定并获得可用的福利以及社会和社区服务。可以协助社会工作者制定、组织和实施计划，以预防和解决与药物滥用、人际关系、康复或家属护理相关的问题。
jobs.de: Assist other social and human service providers in providing client services in a wide variety of fields, such as psychology, rehabilitation, or social work, including support for families. May assist clients in identifying and obtaining available benefits and social and community services. May assist social workers with developing, organizing, and conducting programs to prevent and resolve problems relevant to substance abuse, human relationships, rehabilitation, or dependent care.

jobs.d: 通过协助个人采取健康行为来促进社区内的健康。通过协助社区居民与医疗保健提供者或社会服务机构进行有效沟通，充当个人健康需求的倡导者。充当联络人或倡导者并实施促进、维持和改善个人和整体社区健康的计划。可以提供与健康相关的预防服务，例如血压、青光眼和听力筛查。可能会收集数据以帮助确定社区健康需求。
jobs.de: Promote health within a community by assisting individuals to adopt healthy behaviors. Serve as an advocate for the health needs of individuals by assisting community residents in effectively communicating with healthcare providers or social service agencies. Act as liaison or advocate and implement programs that promote, maintain, and improve individual and overall community health. May deliver health-related preventive services such as blood pressure, glaucoma, and hearing screenings. May collect data to help identify community health needs.

jobs.d: 进行宗教崇拜并执行与宗教信仰或教派的信仰和实践相关的其他精神功能。为成员提供精神和道德指导和帮助。
jobs.de: Conduct religious worship and perform other spiritual functions associated with beliefs and practices of religious faith or denomination. Provide spiritual and moral guidance and assistance to members.

jobs.d: 协调或设计计划并开展外展活动，以促进宗派团体的宗教教育或活动。可以提供与婚姻、健康、财务和宗教问题相关的咨询、指导和领导。
jobs.de: Coordinate or design programs and conduct outreach to promote the religious education or activities of a denominational group. May provide counseling, guidance, and leadership relative to marital, health, financial, and religious problems.

jobs.d: 在刑事和民事诉讼及其他法律程序中代表客户，起草法律文件，或就合法交易管理或向客户提供建议。可能专注于单一领域，也可能广泛涉足多个法律领域。
jobs.de: Represent clients in criminal and civil litigation and other legal proceedings, draw up legal documents, or manage or advise clients on legal transactions. May specialize in a single area or may practice broadly in many areas of law.

jobs.d: 在法庭上协助法官或进行研究或准备法律文件。
jobs.de: Assist judges in court or by conducting research or preparing legal documents.

jobs.t: 行政法法官、审判员和听证官
jobs.d: 举行听证会，就有关政府计划或其他政府相关事项的索赔提出建议或做出决定。确定责任、制裁或处罚，或建议接受或拒绝索赔或和解。
jobs.te: Administrative Law Judges, Adjudicators, and Hearing Officers
jobs.de: Conduct hearings to recommend or make decisions on claims concerning government programs or other government-related matters. Determine liability, sanctions, or penalties, or recommend the acceptance or rejection of claims or settlements.

jobs.t: 仲裁员、调解员、和调解员
jobs.d: 通过对话促进谈判和冲突解决。通过相关各方的共同同意，在法院系统之外解决冲突。
jobs.de: Facilitate negotiation and conflict resolution through dialogue. Resolve conflicts outside of the court system by mutual consent of parties involved.

jobs.t: 法官、治安法官和治安法官
jobs.d: 在法庭上进行仲裁、建议、裁决或执行司法。可以根据政府法规或量刑指南对刑事案件中的被告进行量刑。可以确定民事案件中被告的责任。可以主持婚礼。
jobs.de: Arbitrate, advise, adjudicate, or administer justice in a court of law. May sentence defendant in criminal cases according to government statutes or sentencing guidelines. May determine liability of defendant in civil cases. May perform wedding ceremonies.

jobs.d: 协助律师调查事实、准备法律文件或研究法律先例。进行研究以支持法律诉讼、制定辩护或发起法律诉讼。
jobs.de: Assist lawyers by investigating facts, preparing legal documents, or researching legal precedent. Conduct research to support a legal proceeding, to formulate a defense, or to initiate legal action.

jobs.t: 职称审查员、摘要员和检索员
jobs.d: 搜索房地产记录、检查产权或出于各种目的总结相关法律或保险文件或详细信息。可以通过搜索律师事务所、房地产机构或产权保险公司的公共和私人记录来编制抵押贷款、合同和其他与产权有关的文书清单。
jobs.de: Search real estate records, examine titles, or summarize pertinent legal or insurance documents or details for a variety of purposes. May compile lists of mortgages, contracts, and other instruments pertaining to titles by searching public and private records for law firms, real estate agencies, or title insurance companies.

jobs.d: 教授工商管理和管理课程，例如会计、金融、人力资源、劳动和劳资关系、营销和运筹学。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in business administration and management, such as accounting, finance, human resources, labor and industrial relations, marketing, and operations research. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.t: 计算机科学教师、中学后
jobs.d: 教授计算机科学课程。可能专注于计算机科学领域，例如计算机的设计和功能或操作和研究分析。包括主要从事教学工作的教师和从事教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in computer science. May specialize in a field of computer science, such as the design and function of computers or operations and research analysis. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授有关数学概念、统计学和精算科学的课程，以及在解决特定问题和情况时应用原始和标准化数学技术的课程。包括以教学为主的教师和教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses pertaining to mathematical concepts, statistics, and actuarial science and to the application of original and standardized mathematical techniques in solving specific problems and situations. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授建筑学和建筑设计课程，如建筑环境设计、室内建筑/设计、风景园林等。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in architecture and architectural design, such as architectural environmental design, interior architecture/design, and landscape architecture. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授有关物理定律和工程原理在机器、材料、仪器、流程和服务开发中的应用的课程。包括化学、土木、电气、工业、机械、矿物和石油工程等学科的教师。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses pertaining to the application of physical laws and principles of engineering for the development of machines, materials, instruments, processes, and services. Includes teachers of subjects such as chemical, civil, electrical, industrial, mechanical, mineral, and petroleum engineering. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授农业科学课程。包括农学、乳制品科学、渔业管理、园艺科学、家禽科学、牧场管理和农业土壤保持方面的教师。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in the agricultural sciences. Includes teachers of agronomy, dairy sciences, fisheries management, horticultural sciences, poultry sciences, range management, and agricultural soil conservation. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授生物科学课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in biological sciences. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.t: 林业和保护科学教师、中学后
jobs.d: 教授林业和保护科学课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.te: Forestry and Conservation Science Teachers, Postsecondary
jobs.de: Teach courses in forestry and conservation science. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.t: 大气、地球、海洋和空间科学教师、中学后
jobs.d: 教授物理科学课程，化学和物理除外。包括以教学为主的教师和教学与科研相结合的教师。
jobs.te: Atmospheric, Earth, Marine, and Space Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary
jobs.de: Teach courses in the physical sciences, except chemistry and physics. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching, and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授有关物质的化学、物理性质和成分变化的课程。工作可能包括提供定性和定量化学分析方法的指导。包括主要从事教学的教师和教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses pertaining to the chemical and physical properties and compositional changes of substances. Work may include providing instruction in the methods of qualitative and quantitative chemical analysis. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching, and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授环境科学课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in environmental science. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授有关物质和能量定律的课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses pertaining to the laws of matter and energy. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.t: 人类学和考古学教师、中学后
jobs.d: 教授人类学或考古学课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in anthropology or archeology. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.t: 地区、民族和文化研究教师、中学后
jobs.d: 教授与一个地区、一个民族或任何其他群体的文化和发展有关的课程，例如拉丁美洲研究、妇女研究或城市事务。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.te: Area, Ethnic, and Cultural Studies Teachers, Postsecondary
jobs.de: Teach courses pertaining to the culture and development of an area, an ethnic group, or any other group, such as Latin American studies, women's studies, or urban affairs. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授经济学课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in economics. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授地理课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in geography. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授政治学、国际事务和国际关系课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in political science, international affairs, and international relations. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授心理学课程，例如儿童心理学、临床心理学、发展心理学以及心理咨询。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in psychology, such as child, clinical, and developmental psychology, and psychological counseling. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授社会学课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in sociology. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授健康专业课程，涉及牙科、实验室技术、医学、药剂学、公共卫生、治疗和兽医学等领域。
jobs.de: Teach courses in health specialties, in fields such as dentistry, laboratory technology, medicine, pharmacy, public health, therapy, and veterinary medicine.

jobs.d: 在课堂和临床单元向护理学生展示和教授病人护理。包括主要从事教学工作的教师和从事教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Demonstrate and teach patient care in classroom and clinical units to nursing students. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授与教育相关的课程，例如咨询、课程、指导、指导、教师教育以及英语作为第二语言的教学。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses pertaining to education, such as counseling, curriculum, guidance, instruction, teacher education, and teaching English as a second language. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授图书馆学课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in library science. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.t: 刑事司法和执法教师、专上
jobs.d: 教授刑事司法、惩教和执法管理方面的课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.te: Criminal Justice and Law Enforcement Teachers, Postsecondary
jobs.de: Teach courses in criminal justice, corrections, and law enforcement administration. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授法律课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in law. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授社会工作课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in social work. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.t: 艺术、戏剧和音乐教师、专上
jobs.d: 教授戏剧、音乐和艺术课程，包括美术和应用艺术，如绘画和雕塑，或设计和工艺。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.te: Art, Drama, and Music Teachers, Postsecondary
jobs.de: Teach courses in drama, music, and the arts including fine and applied art, such as painting and sculpture, or design and crafts. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授传播学课程，例如组织传播、公共关系、广播/电视广播和新闻学。包括主要从事教学的教师和教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in communications, such as organizational communications, public relations, radio/television broadcasting, and journalism. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.t: 英语语言和文学教师、专上
jobs.d: 教授英语语言和文学课程，包括语言学和比较文学。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.te: English Language and Literature Teachers, Postsecondary
jobs.de: Teach courses in English language and literature, including linguistics and comparative literature. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 用英语以外的语言教授语言和文学课程。包括美国手语 (ASL) 教师。包括主要从事教学的教师和教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.te: Foreign Language and Literature Teachers, Postsecondary
jobs.de: Teach languages and literature courses in languages other than English. Includes teachers of American Sign Language (ASL). Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.d: 教授人类历史和史学课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学与研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in human history and historiography. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.t: 哲学和宗教教师、中学后
jobs.d: 教授哲学、宗教和神学课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.de: Teach courses in philosophy, religion, and theology. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.t: 家庭和消费科学教师、中学后
jobs.d: 教授儿童保育、家庭关系、金融、营养以及与家庭管理相关的课程。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.te: Family and Consumer Sciences Teachers, Postsecondary
jobs.de: Teach courses in childcare, family relations, finance, nutrition, and related subjects pertaining to home management. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.t: 娱乐和健身研究教师、中学后
jobs.d: 教授与娱乐、休闲和健身研究相关的课程，包括运动生理学和设施管理。包括主要从事教学的教师和从事教学和研究相结合的教师。
jobs.te: Recreation and Fitness Studies Teachers, Postsecondary
jobs.de: Teach courses pertaining to recreation, leisure, and fitness studies, including exercise physiology and facilities management. Includes both teachers primarily engaged in teaching and those who do a combination of teaching and research.

jobs.t: 职业/技术教育教师、中学后
jobs.d: 教授职业课程，旨在提供建筑、机械/维修、制造、运输或美容等学科的学士学位以下的职业培训，主要面向高中毕业或高中毕业的学生。教学在以学术或职业教育为主要业务的公立或私立学校中进行。
jobs.de: Teach vocational courses intended to provide occupational training below the baccalaureate level in subjects such as construction, mechanics/repair, manufacturing, transportation, or cosmetology, primarily to students who have graduated from or left high school. Teaching takes place in public or private schools whose primary business is academic or vocational education.

jobs.t: 学前教师，特殊教育除外
jobs.d: 按照课程或课程计划指导学龄前学生参加旨在促进社交、身体和智力成长的活动。
jobs.de: Instruct preschool-aged students, following curricula or lesson plans, in activities designed to promote social, physical, and intellectual growth.

jobs.t: 幼儿园教师，特殊教育除外
jobs.d: 向幼儿园学生教授学术和社交技能。
jobs.de: Teach academic and social skills to kindergarten students.

jobs.t: 小学学校教师，特殊教育除外
jobs.d: 向小学学生教授学术和社交技能。
jobs.te: Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education
jobs.de: Teach academic and social skills to students at the elementary school level.

jobs.t: 中学教师，特殊教育和职业/技术教育除外
jobs.d: 向初中、中级或初中学生教授一门或多门科目
jobs.te: Middle School Teachers, Except Special and Career/Technical Education
jobs.de: Teach one or more subjects to students at the middle, intermediate, or junior high school level.

jobs.t: 职业/技术教育教师，中学
jobs.d: 为初中、中级或初中水平的学生教授职业、职业、职业或技术科目。
jobs.de: Teach occupational, vocational, career, or technical subjects to students at the middle, intermediate, or junior high school level.

jobs.t: 中学教师，特殊教育和职业/技术教育除外
jobs.d: 为中学水平的学生教授一门或多门科目。
jobs.te: Secondary School Teachers, Except Special and Career/Technical Education
jobs.de: Teach one or more subjects to students at the secondary school level.

jobs.t: 职业/技术教育教师，中学
jobs.d: 为中学水平的学生教授职业、职业、职业或技术科目。
jobs.de: Teach occupational, vocational, career, or technical subjects to students at the secondary school level.

jobs.d: 为有学习、情感或身体障碍的学龄前学生教授学术、社交和生活技能。包括专门从事盲人或视力障碍学生工作的教师；失聪或有听力障碍的学生；以及智障学生。
jobs.de: Teach academic, social, and life skills to preschool-aged students with learning, emotional, or physical disabilities. Includes teachers who specialize and work with students who are blind or have visual impairments; students who are deaf or have hearing impairments; and students with intellectual disabilities.

jobs.t: 特殊教育教师，中学学校
jobs.d: 向有学习、情感或身体障碍的中学生教授学术、社交和生活技能。包括专门从事盲人或视力障碍学生工作的教师；失聪或有听力障碍的学生；
jobs.de: Teach academic, social, and life skills to middle school students with learning, emotional, or physical disabilities. Includes teachers who specialize and work with students who are blind or have visual impairments; students who are deaf or have hearing impairments; and students with intellectual disabilities.

jobs.d: 向有学习、情感或身体残疾的中学生教授学术、社交和生活技能。包括专门从事盲人或视力障碍学生工作的教师；失聪或有听力障碍的学生；
jobs.de: Teach academic, social, and life skills to secondary school students with learning, emotional, or physical disabilities. Includes teachers who specialize and work with students who are blind or have visual impairments; students who are deaf or have hearing impairments; and students with intellectual disabilities.

jobs.d: 为因粗大运动发育迟缓或其他障碍而有特殊身体需求的儿童、青少年或成人提供个性化的体育教学或服务。
jobs.de: Provide individualized physical education instruction or services to children, youth, or adults with exceptional physical needs due to gross motor developmental delays or other impairments.

jobs.t: 成人基础教育、成人中等教育和英语作为第二语言教师
jobs.d: 在基础教育、识字或英语作为第二语言课程或获得高中同等证书的课程中教授或指导失学青少年和成人。
jobs.te: Adult Basic Education, Adult Secondary Education, and English as a Second Language Instructors
jobs.de: Teach or instruct out-of-school youths and adults in basic education, literacy, or English as a Second Language classes, or in classes for earning a high school equivalency credential.

jobs.d: 以以下主要目的教授或指导个人或团体：自我充实或娱乐，而不是为了职业目标、教育成就、竞争或健身。
jobs.de: Teach or instruct individuals or groups for the primary purpose of self-enrichment or recreation, rather than for an occupational objective, educational attainment, competition, or fitness.

jobs.d: 指导个别学生或小组学生学习学术科目，以支持正式的课堂教学或为学生准备标准化或入学考试。
jobs.de: Instruct individual students or small groups of students in academic subjects to support formal class instruction or to prepare students for standardized or admissions tests.

jobs.d: 评估、编辑和直接保管永久记录和具有历史价值的文件。参与基于档案材料的研究活动。
jobs.de: Appraise, edit, and direct safekeeping of permanent records and historically valuable documents. Participate in research activities based on archival materials.

jobs.d: 管理藏品，例如博物馆或其他机构的艺术品、收藏品、历史物品或科学标本。可以开展机构的教学、研究或公共服务活动。
jobs.de: Administer collections, such as artwork, collectibles, historic items, or scientific specimens of museums or other institutions. May conduct instructional, research, or public service activities of institution.

jobs.t: 博物馆技术人员和管理员
jobs.d: 恢复、维护或准备博物馆藏品中的物品以供存储、研究或展览。可以处理化石、骨骼部分或植物等标本；或工艺品、纺织品或艺术品。可以识别和记录物体或将它们安装和布置在展品中。包括书籍或文件管理员。
jobs.de: Restore, maintain, or prepare objects in museum collections for storage, research, or exhibit. May work with specimens such as fossils, skeletal parts, or botanicals; or artifacts, textiles, or art. May identify and record objects or install and arrange them in exhibits. Includes book or document conservators.

jobs.t: 图书馆员和媒体收藏专家
jobs.d: 管理和维护图书馆或信息收藏，以供公共或私人通过参考或借阅访问。在各种环境中工作，例如教育机构、博物馆和公司，并使用各种类型的信息材料，例如书籍、期刊、录音、电影和数据库。任务可能包括获取、编目和流通图书馆资料，以及用户服务，例如查找和组织信息、提供如何访问信息的指导以及设置和操作图书馆的媒体设备。
jobs.de: Administer and maintain libraries or collections of information, for public or private access through reference or borrowing. Work in a variety of settings, such as educational institutions, museums, and corporations, and with various types of informational materials, such as books, periodicals, recordings, films, and databases. Tasks may include acquiring, cataloging, and circulating library materials, and user services such as locating and organizing information, providing instruction on how to access information, and setting up and operating a library's media equipment.

jobs.d: 通过帮助读者使用图书馆目录、数据库和索引来查找书籍和其他资料，协助图书馆员；并回答仅需要简短查阅标准参考的问题。编制记录；对书籍或其他媒体进行分类和上架；移除或修复损坏的书籍或其他介质；注册顾客；并对进出流通过程的物料进行检查。更换搁架区域（堆栈）或文件中的材料。包括协助在流动图书馆提供服务的流动图书司机。
jobs.de: Assist librarians by helping readers in the use of library catalogs, databases, and indexes to locate books and other materials; and by answering questions that require only brief consultation of standard reference. Compile records; sort and shelve books or other media; remove or repair damaged books or other media; register patrons; and check materials in and out of the circulation process. Replace materials in shelving area (stacks) or files. Includes bookmobile drivers who assist with providing services in mobile libraries.

jobs.t: 农场和家庭管理教育者
jobs.d: 为从事农业、农业相关流程或家庭管理活动的个人和家庭提供指导和建议。展示程序并应用研究成果来推进农业和家庭管理活动。可以制定教育推广计划。可以就农业问题（如农业流程和技术、害虫管理和食品安全）或家庭管理问题（如预算、营养和儿童发展）进行指导。
jobs.de: Instruct and advise individuals and families engaged in agriculture, agricultural-related processes, or home management activities. Demonstrate procedures and apply research findings to advance agricultural and home management activities. May develop educational outreach programs. May instruct on either agricultural issues such as agricultural processes and techniques, pest management, and food safety, or on home management issues such as budgeting, nutrition, and child development.

jobs.d: 开发教学材料，协调教育内容，并将当前技术纳入教学，以便为教育工作者和讲师开发课程和开展课程提供指导。可以培训和指导教师。包括教育顾问和专家以及教材总监。
jobs.de: Develop instructional material, coordinate educational content, and incorporate current technology into instruction in order to provide guidelines to educators and instructors for developing curricula and conducting courses. May train and coach teachers. Includes educational consultants and specialists, and instructional material directors.

jobs.t: 助教，学前班、小学、初中和中学，特殊教育除外
jobs.d: 协助学前班、小学、初中或中学教师履行教学职责。担任教师主要负责教育计划和服务的设计和实施的职位。
jobs.te: Teaching Assistants, Preschool, Elementary, Middle, and Secondary School, Except Special Education
jobs.de: Assist a preschool, elementary, middle, or secondary school teacher with instructional duties. Serve in a position for which a teacher has primary responsibility for the design and implementation of educational programs and services.

jobs.d: 协助高等教育机构的教师或其他教学人员开展教学支持活动，例如开发教材、领导讨论小组、准备和进行考试以及对考试或论文进行评分。
jobs.de: Assist faculty or other instructional staff in postsecondary institutions by performing instructional support activities, such as developing teaching materials, leading discussion groups, preparing and giving examinations, and grading examinations or papers.

jobs.d: 制定视觉制作和媒体（例如印刷品、广播、视频和电影）的设计概念和演示方法。指导从事艺术品或布局设计的工人。
jobs.de: Formulate design concepts and presentation approaches for visual productions and media, such as print, broadcasting, video, and film. Direct workers engaged in artwork or layout design.

jobs.d: 使用各种技术（例如焊接、编织、陶器和针线工艺）创建或复制用于销售和展览的手工制品。
jobs.de: Create or reproduce handmade objects for sale and exhibition using a variety of techniques, such as welding, weaving, pottery, and needlecraft.

jobs.t: 美术艺术家，包括画家、雕塑家和插画家
jobs.d: 使用各种媒体和技术创建原创艺术品。
jobs.te: Fine Artists, Including Painters, Sculptors, and Illustrators
jobs.de: Create original artwork using any of a wide variety of media and techniques.

jobs.d: 使用电影、视频、计算机或其他电子工具和媒体创建特效或动画，用于产品，例如电脑游戏、电影、音乐视频和广告。
jobs.de: Create special effects or animations using film, video, computers, or other electronic tools and media for use in products, such as computer games, movies, music videos, and commercials.

jobs.d: 设计并开发制造产品，如汽车、家用电器和儿童玩具。将艺术才华与对产品用途、营销和材料的研究相结合，创造出最具功能性和吸引力的产品设计。
jobs.de: Design and develop manufactured products, such as cars, home appliances, and children's toys. Combine artistic talent with research on product use, marketing, and materials to create the most functional and appealing product design.

jobs.d: 设计服装和配饰。创建原创设计或适应时尚潮流。
jobs.de: Design clothing and accessories. Create original designs or adapt fashion trends.

jobs.d: 设计、切割和布置活花、干花或人造花和叶子。
jobs.de: Design, cut, and arrange live, dried, or artificial flowers and foliage.

jobs.d: 设计或创建图形以满足特定的商业或促销需求，例如包装、展示或徽标。可以使用多种媒介来达到艺术或装饰效果。
jobs.de: Design or create graphics to meet specific commercial or promotional needs, such as packaging, displays, or logos. May use a variety of mediums to achieve artistic or decorative effects.

jobs.d: 规划、设计和装饰房间或建筑物的内部空间。设计实用、美观且有利于实现预期目的的室内环境或物理布局。可能专注于室内设计的特定领域、风格或阶段。
jobs.de: Plan, design, and furnish the internal space of rooms or buildings. Design interior environments or create physical layouts that are practical, aesthetic, and conducive to the intended purposes. May specialize in a particular field, style, or phase of interior design.

jobs.t: 商品展示器和窗户修剪器
jobs.d: 规划和搭建商业展示，例如零售店的窗户和室内装饰以及贸易展览。
jobs.de: Plan and erect commercial displays, such as those in windows and interiors of retail stores and at trade exhibitions.

jobs.d: 为电影、视频、电视和戏剧制作设计特别展品和布景。可以研究剧本，与导演协商，并进行研究以确定适当的建筑风格。
jobs.de: Design special exhibits and sets for film, video, television, and theater productions. May study scripts, confer with directors, and conduct research to determine appropriate architectural styles.

jobs.d: 在舞台、电视、广播、视频或电影制作或其他娱乐、信息或指导环境中扮演角色。通过言语、手势和身体动作来诠释严肃或喜剧角色，以娱乐或告知观众。可以跳舞和唱歌。
jobs.de: Play parts in stage, television, radio, video, or film productions, or other settings for entertainment, information, or instruction. Interpret serious or comic role by speech, gesture, and body movement to entertain or inform audience. May dance and sing.

jobs.d: 制作或导演舞台、电视、广播、视频或电影作品以供娱乐、信息或指导。负责创意决策，例如剧本的解释、演员或嘉宾的选择、布景设计、声音、特效和编舞。
jobs.de: Produce or direct stage, television, radio, video, or film productions for entertainment, information, or instruction. Responsible for creative decisions, such as interpretation of script, choice of actors or guests, set design, sound, special effects, and choreography.

jobs.d: 指导和协调参与广播或电视台节目时间表和节目（例如体育或新闻）准备的人员的活动。
jobs.de: Direct and coordinate activities of personnel engaged in preparation of radio or television station program schedules and programs, such as sports or news.

jobs.d: 试镜和采访表演者，为舞台、电视、广播或电影制作中的部分选择最合适的人才。
jobs.de: Audition and interview performers to select most appropriate talent for parts in stage, television, radio, or motion picture productions.

jobs.d: 协调技术部门的活动，例如录音、编辑、工程和技术部门的活动。维护、制作广播或电视节目。
jobs.de: Coordinate activities of technical departments, such as taping, editing, engineering, and maintenance, to produce radio or television programs.

jobs.d: 参加体育赛事。
jobs.de: Compete in athletic events.

jobs.d: 以比赛为主要目的，指导或指导团体或个人体育基础知识。展示参与的技巧和方法。可以评估运动员的优势和劣势作为可能的新兵或提高运动员的技术，为他们的比赛做好准备。需要持有教学证书的人员应在适当的教学类别中报告。
jobs.de: Instruct or coach groups or individuals in the fundamentals of sports for the primary purpose of competition. Demonstrate techniques and methods of participation. May evaluate athletes' strengths and weaknesses as possible recruits or to improve the athletes' technique to prepare them for competition. Those required to hold teaching certifications should be reported in the appropriate teaching category.

jobs.t: 裁判员、裁判员和其他体育官员
jobs.d: 主持竞技性体育或体育赛事。发现违规行为并根据既定规定决定处罚。包括所有体育官员、裁判员和竞赛评委。
jobs.te: Umpires, Referees, and Other Sports Officials
jobs.de: Officiate at competitive athletic or sporting events. Detect infractions of rules and decide penalties according to established regulations. Includes all sporting officials, referees, and competition judges.

jobs.d: 表演舞蹈。可以在舞台上表演、进行广播或进行视频录制。
jobs.de: Perform dances. May perform on stage, for broadcasting, or for video recording.

jobs.d: 创建新的舞蹈动作。排练例行公事的表演。可以指导和舞台演示。
jobs.de: Create new dance routines. Rehearse performance of routines. May direct and stage presentations.

jobs.d: 指挥、指导、计划和领导音乐艺术家或团体（例如管弦乐队、乐队、合唱团和欢乐合唱团）的器乐或声乐表演；或创作​​原创音乐作品。
jobs.de: Conduct, direct, plan, and lead instrumental or vocal performances by musical artists or groups, such as orchestras, bands, choirs, and glee clubs; or create original works of music.

jobs.d: 演奏一种或多种乐器或唱歌。可以在舞台上进行广播、录音或录像表演。
jobs.de: Play one or more musical instruments or sing. May perform on stage, for broadcasting, or for sound or video recording.

jobs.t: 广播播音员和电台唱片骑师
jobs.d: 讲话或朗读脚本材料，例如广播、电视或其他通信媒体上的新闻报道或商业信息。可以播放和排列音乐、宣布艺术家或表演名称、识别电台或采访嘉宾。
jobs.te: Broadcast Announcers and Radio Disc Jockeys
jobs.de: Speak or read from scripted materials, such as news reports or commercial messages, on radio, television, or other communications media. May play and queue music, announce artist or title of performance, identify station, or interview guests.

jobs.t: 新闻分析师、记者和记者
jobs.d: 为印刷品、广播或其他传播媒体（例如报纸、杂志、广播或电视）叙述或撰写新闻故事、评论或评论。可以通过访谈、调查或观察来收集和分析信息。
jobs.de: Narrate or write news stories, reviews, or commentary for print, broadcast, or other communications media such as newspapers, magazines, radio, or television. May collect and analyze information through interview, investigation, or observation.

jobs.d: 为个人、团体或组织宣传或创建预期的公众形象。可以撰写或选择材料以发布到各种传播媒体。可能擅长使用社交媒体。
jobs.de: Promote or create an intended public image for individuals, groups, or organizations. May write or select material for release to various communications media. May specialize in using social media.

jobs.d: 计划、协调、修改或编辑书面材料。可以审查可能发表的提案和草案。
jobs.de: Plan, coordinate, revise, or edit written material. May review proposals and drafts for possible publication.

jobs.d: 撰写技术材料，例如设备手册、附录或操作和维护说明。可协助排版工作。
jobs.de: Write technical materials, such as equipment manuals, appendices, or operating and maintenance instructions. May assist in layout work.

jobs.d: 创作和准备书面材料，如剧本、故事、广告和其他材料。
jobs.de: Originate and prepare written material, such as scripts, stories, advertisements, and other material.

jobs.t: 诗人、作词家和创意作家
jobs.d: 创作原创书面作品，如剧本、散文、散文、诗歌或歌词，以供出版或表演。
jobs.de: Create original written works, such as scripts, essays, prose, poetry or song lyrics, for publication or performance.

jobs.d: 口译或手语，或将书面文本从一种语言翻译成另一种语言。
jobs.de: Interpret oral or sign language, or translate written text from one language into another.

jobs.d: 使用逐字方法和设备捕获、存储、检索和转录审前和审判程序或其他内容信息。包括操作计算机速记字幕设备为听力障碍观众提供现场或预先录制的广播字幕的速记员。
jobs.de: Use verbatim methods and equipment to capture, store, retrieve, and transcribe pretrial and trial proceedings or other information. Includes stenocaptioners who operate computerized stenographic captioning equipment to provide captions of live or prerecorded broadcasts for hearing-impaired viewers.

jobs.d: 设置、维护和拆卸音频和视频设备，例如麦克风、扬声器、连接电线和电缆、声音和混音板、摄像机、视频监视器和服务器，以及用于现场或录制活动的相关电子设备，例如音乐会、会议、大会、演示、播客、新闻发布会、和体育赛事。
jobs.de: Set up, maintain, and dismantle audio and video equipment, such as microphones, sound speakers, connecting wires and cables, sound and mixing boards, video cameras, video monitors and servers, and related electronic equipment for live or recorded events, such as concerts, meetings, conventions, presentations, podcasts, news conferences, and sporting events.

jobs.d: 设置、操作和维护用于获取、编辑和传输广播或电视节目的音频和视频的电子设备。控制和调整传入和传出的广播信号，以调节音量、信号强度和信号清晰度。操作卫星、微波或其他发射设备来广播广播或电视节目。
jobs.de: Set up, operate, and maintain the electronic equipment used to acquire, edit, and transmit audio and video for radio or television programs. Control and adjust incoming and outgoing broadcast signals to regulate sound volume, signal strength, and signal clarity. Operate satellite, microwave, or other transmitter equipment to broadcast radio or television programs.

jobs.d: 组装和操作设备来录制、同步、混合、编辑或再现声音，包括音乐、语音或音效，用于戏剧、视频、电影、电视、播客、体育赛事和其他制作。
jobs.de: Assemble and operate equipment to record, synchronize, mix, edit, or reproduce sound, including music, voices, or sound effects, for theater, video, film, television, podcasts, sporting events, and other productions.

jobs.d: 拍摄人物、风景、商品或其他主题。可以使用照明设备来增强拍摄对象的外观。可以使用编辑软件来制作成品图像和印刷品。包括商业和工业摄影师、科学摄影师和摄影记者。
jobs.de: Photograph people, landscapes, merchandise, or other subjects. May use lighting equipment to enhance a subject's appearance. May use editing software to produce finished images and prints. Includes commercial and industrial photographers, scientific photographers, and photojournalists.

jobs.t: 摄像机操作员、电视、视频和电影
jobs.d: 操作电视、摄像机或电影摄影机，为电视、视频或电影制作记录图像或场景。
jobs.te: Camera Operators, Television, Video, and Film
jobs.de: Operate television, video, or film camera to record images or scenes for television, video, or film productions.

jobs.d: 编辑电影、视频或其他媒体上的动态图像。可以与制片人或导演合作，组织最终制作的图像。可以编辑配乐或将配乐与图像同步。
jobs.de: Edit moving images on film, video, or other media. May work with a producer or director to organize images for final production. May edit or synchronize soundtracks with images.

jobs.d: 通过操纵脊柱和肌肉骨骼系统来评估、治疗和护理患者。可以提供脊柱调整或解决骶骨或骨盆错位。
jobs.de: Assess, treat, and care for patients by manipulation of spine and musculoskeletal system. May provide spinal adjustment or address sacral or pelvic misalignment.

jobs.d: 检查、诊断和治疗牙齿和牙龈的疾病、损伤和畸形。可治疗影响口腔卫生和牙齿保留的神经、牙髓和其他牙齿组织疾病。可以安装牙科器具或提供预防性护理。
jobs.de: Examine, diagnose, and treat diseases, injuries, and malformations of teeth and gums. May treat diseases of nerve, pulp, and other dental tissues affecting oral hygiene and retention of teeth. May fit dental appliances or provide preventive care.

jobs.d: 对口腔颌面部区域的硬组织和软组织进行手术和相关程序，以治疗疾病、损伤或缺陷。可以诊断口腔颌面部区域的问题。可能会进行手术以改善功能或外观。
jobs.de: Perform surgery and related procedures on the hard and soft tissues of the oral and maxillofacial regions to treat diseases, injuries, or defects. May diagnose problems of the oral and maxillofacial regions. May perform surgery to improve function or appearance.

jobs.d: 检查、诊断和治疗牙齿咬合不正和口腔异常。设计和制造矫正牙齿和颌骨的矫治器，以产生和维持正常功能并改善外观。
jobs.de: Examine, diagnose, and treat dental malocclusions and oral cavity anomalies. Design and fabricate appliances to realign teeth and jaws to produce and maintain normal function and to improve appearance.

jobs.d: 诊断、治疗、康复、设计和安装假肢，以维持患有与牙齿、口腔和颌面组织或颌相关的临床病症的患者的口腔功能、健康和外观。
jobs.de: Diagnose, treat, rehabilitate, design, and fit prostheses that maintain oral function, health, and appearance for patients with clinical conditions associated with teeth, oral and maxillofacial tissues, or the jaw.

jobs.d: 规划和实施食品服务或营养计划，以协助促进健康和控制疾病。可以监督提供定量食品服务的部门的活动、为个人提供咨询或进行营养研究。
jobs.de: Plan and conduct food service or nutritional programs to assist in the promotion of health and control of disease. May supervise activities of a department providing quantity food services, counsel individuals, or conduct nutritional research.

jobs.d: 诊断、管理和治疗人眼和视觉系统的状况和疾病。检查眼睛和视觉系统，诊断问题或损伤，开出矫正镜片并提供治疗。可以开出治疗药物来治疗特定的眼部疾病。
jobs.de: Diagnose, manage, and treat conditions and diseases of the human eye and visual system. Examine eyes and visual system, diagnose problems or impairments, prescribe corrective lenses, and provide treatment. May prescribe therapeutic drugs to treat specific eye conditions.

jobs.d: 分发医生和其他健康从业者开出的药物，并向患者提供有关药物及其使用的信息。可以就药物的选择、剂量、相互作用和副作用向医生和其他健康从业者提供建议。
jobs.de: Dispense drugs prescribed by physicians and other health practitioners and provide information to patients about medications and their use. May advise physicians and other health practitioners on the selection, dosage, interactions, and side effects of medications.

jobs.d: 提供通常由医生在医生监督下执行的医疗保健服务。进行完整的体检、提供治疗并为患者提供咨询。在某些情况下，可能会开药。必须毕业于经认可的医师助理教育课程。
jobs.de: Provide healthcare services typically performed by a physician, under the supervision of a physician. Conduct complete physicals, provide treatment, and counsel patients. May, in some cases, prescribe medication. Must graduate from an accredited educational program for physician assistants.

jobs.d: 协助麻醉师进行外科和非外科手术的麻醉管理。监测患者状况并在手术治疗期间提供患者护理。
jobs.de: Assist anesthesiologists in the administration of anesthesia for surgical and non-surgical procedures. Monitor patient status and provide patient care during surgical treatment.

jobs.d: 诊断和治疗人类足部的疾病和畸形。
jobs.de: Diagnose and treat diseases and deformities of the human foot.

jobs.d: 评估、计划和组织康复计划，帮助残疾人或发育迟缓的人建立或恢复职业、家务和日常生活技能以及一般独立性。使用治疗技术，适应个人的环境，教授技能，并修改对个人造成障碍的特定任务。
jobs.de: Assess, plan, and organize rehabilitative programs that help build or restore vocational, homemaking, and daily living skills, as well as general independence, to persons with disabilities or developmental delays. Use therapeutic techniques, adapt the individual's environment, teach skills, and modify specific tasks that present barriers to the individual.

jobs.t: 低视力治疗师、定向和活动专家以及视力康复治疗师
jobs.d: 为视力障碍患者提供治疗，以改善他们的日常生活活动功能。可以培训患者进行计算机使用、沟通技巧或家庭管理技能等活动。
jobs.te: Low Vision Therapists, Orientation and Mobility Specialists, and Vision Rehabilitation Therapists
jobs.de: Provide therapy to patients with visual impairments to improve their functioning in daily life activities. May train patients in activities such as computer use, communication skills, or home management skills.

jobs.d: 评估、计划、组织和参与康复计划，以改善活动能力、缓解疼痛、增强力量，并改善或纠正因疾病或受伤而导致的残疾状况。
jobs.de: Assess, plan, organize, and participate in rehabilitative programs that improve mobility, relieve pain, increase strength, and improve or correct disabling conditions resulting from disease or injury.

jobs.d: 按照放射肿瘤科医生的规定，根据既定做法和标准向患者提供放射治疗。职责可能包括审查处方和诊断；充当与医生和支持护理人员的联络人；准备设备，例如固定、治疗和保护装置；维护记录、报告和文件。可能协助剂量测定程序和肿瘤定位。
jobs.de: Provide radiation therapy to patients as prescribed by a radiation oncologist according to established practices and standards. Duties may include reviewing prescription and diagnosis; acting as liaison with physician and supportive care personnel; preparing equipment, such as immobilization, treatment, and protection devices; and maintaining records, reports, and files. May assist in dosimetry procedures and tumor localization.

jobs.d: 为医院、疗养院或其他机构的患者计划、指导或协调经医学批准的娱乐项目。活动包括体育、旅行、戏剧、社交活动和手工艺。可以评估患者状况并推荐适当的娱乐活动。
jobs.de: Plan, direct, or coordinate medically-approved recreation programs for patients in hospitals, nursing homes, or other institutions. Activities include sports, trips, dramatics, social activities, and crafts. May assess a patient condition and recommend appropriate recreational activity.

jobs.d: 评估、治疗和护理患有呼吸障碍的患者。对所有呼吸护理方式承担主要责任，包括监督呼吸治疗技术人员。启动并进行治疗程序；保存患者记录；并选择、组装、检查和操作设备。
jobs.de: Assess, treat, and care for patients with breathing disorders. Assume primary responsibility for all respiratory care modalities, including the supervision of respiratory therapy technicians. Initiate and conduct therapeutic procedures; maintain patient records; and select, assemble, check, and operate equipment.

jobs.d: 评估和治疗有言语、语言、声音和流畅性障碍的人。可以选择替代通信系统并教授它们的使用。可能会进行与言语和语言问题相关的研究。
jobs.de: Assess and treat persons with speech, language, voice, and fluency disorders. May select alternative communication systems and teach their use. May perform research related to speech and language problems.

jobs.d: 评估、计划或实施健身计划，包括锻炼或身体活动，例如旨在改善心肺功能、身体成分、肌肉力量、肌肉耐力或灵活性的计划。
jobs.de: Assess, plan, or implement fitness programs that include exercise or physical activities such as those designed to improve cardiorespiratory function, body composition, muscular strength, muscular endurance, or flexibility.

jobs.d: 计划或进行艺术治疗课程或项目，以改善客户的身体、认知或情感健康。
jobs.de: Plan or conduct art therapy sessions or programs to improve clients' physical, cognitive, or emotional well-being.

jobs.d: 计划、组织、指导或评估临床和循证音乐治疗干预措施，以积极影响个人的身体、心理、认知或行为状态。
jobs.de: Plan, organize, direct, or assess clinical and evidenced-based music therapy interventions to positively influence individuals' physical, psychological, cognitive, or behavioral status.

jobs.d: 诊断、治疗或研究动物的疾病和伤害。包括进行研究和开发、检查牲畜或照顾宠物和伴侣动物的兽医。
jobs.de: Diagnose, treat, or research diseases and injuries of animals. Includes veterinarians who conduct research and development, inspect livestock, or care for pets and companion animals.

jobs.d: 评估患者的健康问题和需求，制定和实施护理计划，并维护医疗记录。对患病、受伤、康复或残疾的患者进行护理。可以为患者提供有关健康维护和疾病预防的建议或提供病例管理。需要许可或注册。
jobs.de: Assess patient health problems and needs, develop and implement nursing care plans, and maintain medical records. Administer nursing care to ill, injured, convalescent, or disabled patients. May advise patients on health maintenance and disease prevention or provide case management. Licensing or registration required.

jobs.d: 为患有心脏病、呼吸窘迫综合征或休克等急性疾病的患者提供先进的护理服务。可能会照顾术前和术后患者，或执行先进的侵入性诊断或治疗程序。
jobs.de: Provide advanced nursing care for patients with acute conditions such as heart attacks, respiratory distress syndrome, or shock. May care for pre- and post-operative patients or perform advanced, invasive diagnostic or therapeutic procedures.

jobs.d: 评估、诊断和治疗患有精神健康或物质使用障碍或此类疾病的可能性的个人和家庭。应用治疗活动，包括按照州法规开出药物处方，以及进行心理治疗。
jobs.de: Assess, diagnose, and treat individuals and families with mental health or substance use disorders or the potential for such disorders. Apply therapeutic activities, including the prescription of medication, per state regulations, and the administration of psychotherapy.

jobs.d: 为重症监护病房或冠心病监护病房的患者提供专门的护理护理。
jobs.de: Provide specialized nursing care for patients in critical or coronary care units.

jobs.d: 指导护理人员在医院、临终关怀医院、诊所或家庭等临床实践环境中提供患者护理。确保遵守既定的临床政策、方案、法规和标准。
jobs.de: Direct nursing staff in the provision of patient care in a clinical practice setting, such as a hospital, hospice, clinic, or home. Ensure adherence to established clinical policies, protocols, regulations, and standards.

jobs.d: 管理麻醉，监测患者的生命体征，并监督患者从麻醉中恢复。可以协助麻醉师、外科医生、其他医生或牙医。必须是接受过专业研究生教育的注册护士。
jobs.de: Administer anesthesia, monitor patient's vital signs, and oversee patient recovery from anesthesia. May assist anesthesiologists, surgeons, other physicians, or dentists. Must be registered nurses who have specialized graduate education.

jobs.d: 独立或作为医疗团队的一部分诊断和协调分娩过程的各个方面。可以提供良好的女性妇科护理。必须接受过专业的研究生护理教育。
jobs.de: Diagnose and coordinate all aspects of the birthing process, either independently or as part of a healthcare team. May provide well-woman gynecological care. Must have specialized, graduate nursing education.

jobs.d: 独立或作为医疗团队的一部分诊断和治疗急性、偶发性或慢性疾病。可能侧重于健康促进和疾病预防。可以订购、执行或解释诊断测试，例如实验室工作和 X 射线。可以开药。必须是受过专门研究生教育的注册护士。
jobs.de: Diagnose and treat acute, episodic, or chronic illness, independently or as part of a healthcare team. May focus on health promotion and disease prevention. May order, perform, or interpret diagnostic tests such as lab work and x rays. May prescribe medication. Must be registered nurses who have specialized graduate education.

jobs.d: 评估和治疗患有听力和相关疾病的人。可能会安装助听器并提供听觉训练。可能会进行与听力问题相关的研究。
jobs.de: Assess and treat persons with hearing and related disorders. May fit hearing aids and provide auditory training. May perform research related to hearing problems.

jobs.d: 在手术前、手术期间或手术后使用麻醉剂和镇痛药来控制疼痛。
jobs.de: Administer anesthetics and analgesics for pain management prior to, during, or after surgery.

jobs.d: 诊断和治疗与皮肤、头发和指甲有关的疾病。可以执行医疗和皮肤科手术功能。
jobs.de: Diagnose and treat diseases relating to the skin, hair, and nails. May perform both medical and dermatological surgery functions.

jobs.d: 在整个生命周期中为个人和家庭诊断、治疗和提供预防性护理。当需要进一步诊断或治疗时，可以将患者转介给专家。
jobs.de: Diagnose, treat, and provide preventive care to individuals and families across the lifespan. May refer patients to specialists when needed for further diagnosis or treatment.

jobs.d: 对多种内脏系统疾病和损伤进行诊断并提供非手术治疗。主要为成人和青少年提供护理，主要在门诊护理环境中进行。
jobs.de: Diagnose and provide nonsurgical treatment for a wide range of diseases and injuries of internal organ systems. Provide care mainly for adults and adolescents, and are based primarily in an outpatient care setting.

jobs.d: 诊断、管理和治疗大脑、脊髓和周围神经的紊乱和疾病，主要以非手术为重点。
jobs.de: Diagnose, manage, and treat disorders and diseases of the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nerves, with a primarily nonsurgical focus.

jobs.d: 提供与怀孕或分娩相关的医疗护理。诊断、治疗和帮助预防女性疾病，特别是影响生殖系统的疾病。还可以为女性提供一般护理。可以执行医疗和妇科手术功能。
jobs.de: Provide medical care related to pregnancy or childbirth. Diagnose, treat, and help prevent diseases of women, particularly those affecting the reproductive system. May also provide general care to women. May perform both medical and gynecological surgery functions.

jobs.d: 诊断、治疗和帮助预防儿童疾病和伤害。根据需要，可以将患者转介给专家进行进一步诊断或治疗。
jobs.de: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent diseases and injuries in children. May refer patients to specialists for further diagnosis or treatment, as needed.

jobs.d: 使用器官、身体组织和体液诊断疾病并进行实验室测试。包括法医。
jobs.de: Diagnose diseases and conduct lab tests using organs, body tissues, and fluids. Includes medical examiners.

jobs.d: 诊断、治疗和帮助预防精神障碍。
jobs.de: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent mental disorders.

jobs.d: 使用医学成像技术（例如 X 射线、磁共振成像 (MRI)、核医学和超声波）诊断和治疗疾病和损伤。可以进行微创医疗程序和测试。
jobs.de: Diagnose and treat diseases and injuries using medical imaging techniques, such as x rays, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), nuclear medicine, and ultrasounds. May perform minimally invasive medical procedures and tests.

jobs.t: 过敏科医生和免疫学家
jobs.d: 诊断、治疗和帮助预防影响免疫系统的过敏性疾病和疾病过程。
jobs.de: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent allergic diseases and disease processes affecting the immune system.

jobs.d: 主要在内科病房、急症监护室、重症监护室、康复中心或急诊室等环境中提供住院护理。在整个治疗过程中管理和协调患者护理。
jobs.de: Provide inpatient care predominantly in settings such as medical wards, acute care units, intensive care units, rehabilitation centers, or emergency rooms. Manage and coordinate patient care throughout treatment.

jobs.d: 诊断、治疗和帮助预防泌尿生殖系统和肾腺的良性和恶性内科和外科疾病。
jobs.de: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent benign and malignant medical and surgical disorders of the genitourinary system and the renal glands.

jobs.d: 诊断和治疗需要物理治疗的疾病，以提供身体、心理和职业康复。
jobs.de: Diagnose and treat disorders requiring physiotherapy to provide physical, mental, and occupational rehabilitation.

jobs.d: 应用一般预防医学和公共卫生问题的知识，促进团体或个人的医疗保健，并帮助预防或减少疾病、伤害、残疾、或死亡。可以在临床健康促进和疾病预防的背景下进行人群医学或诊断和治疗患者。
jobs.de: Apply knowledge of general preventive medicine and public health issues to promote health care to groups or individuals, and aid in the prevention or reduction of risk of disease, injury, disability, or death. May practice population-based medicine or diagnose and treat patients in the context of clinical health promotion and disease prevention.

jobs.d: 诊断、治疗和帮助预防体育赛事、运动训练和体育活动期间发生的伤害。
jobs.de: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent injuries that occur during sporting events, athletic training, and physical activities.

jobs.d: 诊断并进行手术以治疗和帮助预防眼部疾病。还可以提供视力治疗服务，包括眼镜和隐形眼镜。
jobs.de: Diagnose and perform surgery to treat and help prevent disorders and diseases of the eye. May also provide vision services for treatment including glasses and contacts.

jobs.d: 通过使用针灸针刺激体内的特定穴位来诊断、治疗和预防疾病。还可以使用杯子、营养补充剂、治疗性按摩、穴位按摩和其他替代健康疗法。
jobs.de: Diagnose, treat, and prevent disorders by stimulating specific acupuncture points within the body using acupuncture needles. May also use cups, nutritional supplements, therapeutic massage, acupressure, and other alternative health therapies.

jobs.d: 为患者提供口腔卫生护理。评估患者口腔卫生问题或需求并保存健康记录。为患者提供口腔健康维护和疾病预防方面的建议。可以提供高级护理，例如提供氟化物治疗或进行局部麻醉。
jobs.de: Administer oral hygiene care to patients. Assess patient oral hygiene problems or needs and maintain health records. Advise patients on oral health maintenance and disease prevention. May provide advanced care such as providing fluoride treatment or administering topical anesthesia.

jobs.d: 使用基于个人自然愈合能力的实践系统来诊断、治疗和帮助预防疾病。可以使用生理、心理或机械方法。还可以使用天然药物、处方药或传奇药物、食物、草药或其他自然疗法。
jobs.de: Diagnose, treat, and help prevent diseases using a system of practice that is based on the natural healing capacity of individuals. May use physiological, psychological or mechanical methods. May also use natural medicines, prescription or legend drugs, foods, herbs, or other natural remedies.

jobs.d: 诊断和治疗视觉系统疾病，例如双眼视觉和眼球运动障碍。
jobs.de: Diagnose and treat visual system disorders such as binocular vision and eye movement impairments.

jobs.t: 医疗和临床实验室技术专家
jobs.d: 进行复杂的医学实验室测试以诊断、治疗和预防疾病。可以培训或监督员工。
jobs.de: Perform complex medical laboratory tests for diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease. May train or supervise staff.

jobs.d: 分析生物样本（例如羊水、骨髓、实体瘤和血液）中发现的染色体或染色体片段，以帮助遗传或获得性遗传疾病的研究、诊断、分类或治疗。通过经典的细胞遗传学、荧光原位杂交 (FISH) 或阵列比较基因组杂交 (aCGH) 技术进行分析。
jobs.de: Analyze chromosomes or chromosome segments found in biological specimens, such as amniotic fluids, bone marrow, solid tumors, and blood to aid in the study, diagnosis, classification, or treatment of inherited or acquired genetic diseases. Conduct analyses through classical cytogenetic, fluorescent in situ hybridization (FISH) or array comparative genome hybridization (aCGH) techniques.

jobs.d: 按照既定标准和实践对细胞进行染色、封片和研究，以检测癌症、激素异常和其他病理状况的证据。
jobs.de: Stain, mount, and study cells to detect evidence of cancer, hormonal abnormalities, and other pathological conditions following established standards and practices.

jobs.d: 应用健康和疾病原因的知识来评估新的实验室技术和程序来检查组织样本。处理并制备组织切片的组织学载玻片，供病理学家进行显微镜检查和诊断。可以解决技术或仪器问题或协助研究。
jobs.de: Apply knowledge of health and disease causes to evaluate new laboratory techniques and procedures to examine tissue samples. Process and prepare histological slides from tissue sections for microscopic examination and diagnosis by pathologists. May solve technical or instrument problems or assist with research studies.

jobs.t: 医疗和临床实验室技术专家
jobs.d: 进行常规医学实验室测试以诊断、治疗和预防疾病。可以在医疗技术专家的监督下工作。
jobs.de: Perform routine medical laboratory tests for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease. May work under the supervision of a medical technologist.

jobs.t: 心血管技术专家和技术人员
jobs.d: 出于诊断、治疗或研究目的对患者的肺部或心血管系统进行测试。可以进行或协助心电图、心导管检查、肺功能、肺活量和类似测试。
jobs.de: Conduct tests on pulmonary or cardiovascular systems of patients for diagnostic, therapeutic, or research purposes. May conduct or assist in electrocardiograms, cardiac catheterizations, pulmonary functions, lung capacity, and similar tests.

jobs.d: 制作内脏器官的超声波记录供医生使用。包括血管技术人员。
jobs.de: Produce ultrasonic recordings of internal organs for use by physicians. Includes vascular technologists.

jobs.d: 使用各种放射性同位素设备在治疗、诊断和示踪研究中准备、管理和测量放射性同位素。准备放射性材料的储备溶液并计算放射科医生要施用的剂量。让患者接受辐射。按照标准实验室技术进行血容量、红细胞存活和脂肪吸收研究。
jobs.de: Prepare, administer, and measure radioactive isotopes in therapeutic, diagnostic, and tracer studies using a variety of radioisotope equipment. Prepare stock solutions of radioactive materials and calculate doses to be administered by radiologists. Subject patients to radiation. Execute blood volume, red cell survival, and fat absorption studies following standard laboratory techniques.

jobs.t: 放射技术人员和技术人员
jobs.d: 出于诊断或研究目的，进行 X 射线和 CAT 扫描或将非放射性物质注入患者的血液中。包括放射技术专家和专门从事其他扫描方式的技术人员。
jobs.de: Take x-rays and CAT scans or administer nonradioactive materials into patient's bloodstream for diagnostic or research purposes. Includes radiologic technologists and technicians who specialize in other scanning modalities.

jobs.d: 操作磁共振成像 (MRI) 扫描仪。监控患者的安全和舒适度，并查看正在扫描区域的图像以确保图片质量。可以静脉注射钆造影剂量。可能会采访患者，解释 MRI 程序，并将患者放在检查台上。可以输入计算机数据，例如患者病史、要扫描的解剖区域、指定方向和进入位置。
jobs.de: Operate Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scanners. Monitor patient safety and comfort, and view images of area being scanned to ensure quality of pictures. May administer gadolinium contrast dosage intravenously. May interview patient, explain MRI procedures, and position patient on examining table. May enter into the computer data such as patient history, anatomical area to be scanned, orientation specified, and position of entry.

jobs.d: 生成放射治疗计划，制定放射剂量计算，沟通和监督治疗计划的实施，并与放射肿瘤学团队成员协商。
jobs.de: Generate radiation treatment plans, develop radiation dose calculations, communicate and supervise the treatment plan implementation, and consult with members of radiation oncology team.

jobs.d: 在营养师的监督下协助提供食品服务和营养计划。可以根据既定指南计划和制作膳食，教授食物和营养原理，或为个人提供咨询。
jobs.de: Assist in the provision of food service and nutritional programs, under the supervision of a dietitian. May plan and produce meals based on established guidelines, teach principles of food and nutrition, or counsel individuals.

jobs.d: 在药剂师的指导下准备药物。可以根据处方测量、混合、计数、标记和记录药物的数量和剂量。
jobs.de: Prepare medications under the direction of a pharmacist. May measure, mix, count out, label, and record amounts and dosages of medications according to prescription orders.

jobs.d: 遵循医生或其他健康从业者的指示，照顾有精神或情绪问题或残疾的个人。监测患者的身体和情绪健康并向医务人员报告。可以参加康复和治疗计划，帮助保持个人卫生，以及服用口服或注射药物。
jobs.de: Care for individuals with mental or emotional conditions or disabilities, following the instructions of physicians or other health practitioners. Monitor patients' physical and emotional well-being and report to medical staff. May participate in rehabilitation and treatment programs, help with personal hygiene, and administer oral or injectable medications.

jobs.d: 在外科医生、注册护士或其他外科人员的监督下协助手术。可以帮助设置手术室、准备和运送患者进行手术、调整灯光和设备、将仪器和其他用品传递给外科医生和外科医生助理、握住牵开器、切割缝线以及帮助计数海绵、针头、用品和仪器。
jobs.de: Assist in operations, under the supervision of surgeons, registered nurses, or other surgical personnel. May help set up operating room, prepare and transport patients for surgery, adjust lights and equipment, pass instruments and other supplies to surgeons and surgeons' assistants, hold retractors, cut sutures, and help count sponges, needles, supplies, and instruments.

jobs.t: 兽医技术人员和技术人员
jobs.d: 在实验室环境中进行医学测试，用于治疗和诊断动物疾病。准备疫苗和血清以预防疾病。准备组织样本、采集血液样本并进行实验室测试，例如尿液分析和血细胞计数。清洁和消毒仪器和材料并维护设备和机器。可以在手术期间协助兽医。
jobs.de: Perform medical tests in a laboratory environment for use in the treatment and diagnosis of diseases in animals. Prepare vaccines and serums for prevention of diseases. Prepare tissue samples, take blood samples, and execute laboratory tests, such as urinalysis and blood counts. Clean and sterilize instruments and materials and maintain equipment and machines. May assist a veterinarian during surgery.

jobs.d: 协助眼科医生执行眼科临床功能。可以进行眼科检查，使用眼科药物，并指导患者护理和使用矫正镜片。
jobs.de: Assist ophthalmologists by performing ophthalmic clinical functions. May administer eye exams, administer eye medications, and instruct the patient in care and use of corrective lenses.

jobs.t: 持证实用和持证职业护士
jobs.d: 在医院、疗养院、诊所、私人住宅、集体之家和类似机构中照顾生病、受伤或正在康复的患者或残疾人。可以在注册护士的监督下工作。需要许可。
jobs.te: Licensed Practical and Licensed Vocational Nurses
jobs.de: Care for ill, injured, or convalescing patients or persons with disabilities in hospitals, nursing homes, clinics, private homes, group homes, and similar institutions. May work under the supervision of a registered nurse. Licensing required.

jobs.d: 根据书面光学处方或规格为客户设计、测量、装配和调整镜片和镜架。协助客户佩戴、摘除和护理隐形眼镜。协助客户选择镜框。通过面部和眼睛测量以及光学处方来测量客户的眼镜尺寸和坐标框架。为光学实验室准备工作订单，其中包含研磨镜片和将镜片安装到镜架中的说明。验证成品镜片的准确性。调整镜框和镜片位置以适合客户。可以塑造或重塑框架。包括隐形眼镜配镜师。
jobs.de: Design, measure, fit, and adapt lenses and frames for client according to written optical prescription or specification. Assist client with inserting, removing, and caring for contact lenses. Assist client with selecting frames. Measure customer for size of eyeglasses and coordinate frames with facial and eye measurements and optical prescription. Prepare work order for optical laboratory containing instructions for grinding and mounting lenses in frames. Verify exactness of finished lens spectacles. Adjust frame and lens position to fit client. May shape or reshape frames. Includes contact lens opticians.

jobs.d: 设计、测量、安装和调整矫形支架、器具或假肢，例如残疾患者的四肢或面部部位。
jobs.de: Design, measure, fit, and adapt orthopedic braces, appliances or prostheses, such as limbs or facial parts for patients with disabling conditions.

jobs.d: 为客户选择和安装助听器。管理和解释听力测试。评估助听器功效。进行耳印模并准备、设计和修改耳模。
jobs.de: Select and fit hearing aids for customers. Administer and interpret tests of hearing. Assess hearing instrument efficacy. Take ear impressions and prepare, design, and modify ear molds.

jobs.d: 进行神经电诊断 (END) 测试，例如脑电图、诱发电位、多导睡眠图或眼震电图。可以进行神​​经传导研究。
jobs.de: Conduct electroneurodiagnostic (END) tests such as electroencephalograms, evoked potentials, polysomnograms, or electronystagmograms. May perform nerve conduction studies.

jobs.d: 协助眼科医生进行眼科临床功能和眼科摄影。向其他眼科人员提供指导和监督。协助小型外科手术、应用无菌技术和准备器械。可以进行眼科检查、施用眼科药物并指导患者护理和使用矫正镜片。
jobs.de: Assist ophthalmologists by performing ophthalmic clinical functions and ophthalmic photography. Provide instruction and supervision to other ophthalmic personnel. Assist with minor surgical procedures, applying aseptic techniques and preparing instruments. May perform eye exams, administer eye medications, and instruct patients in care and use of corrective lenses.

jobs.d: 协助患者获得服务、了解政策和做出医疗保健决策。
jobs.de: Assist patients in obtaining services, understanding policies and making health care decisions.

jobs.d: 评估和治疗肌肉骨骼损伤或疾病。提供预防、治疗、紧急和康复护理。
jobs.de: Evaluate and treat musculoskeletal injuries or illnesses. Provide preventive, therapeutic, emergency, and rehabilitative care.

jobs.d: 评估个人或家庭罹患各种遗传性疾病的风险，例如遗传性疾病和出生缺陷。向其他医疗保健提供者或关注遗传性疾病风险的个人和家庭提供信息。建议个人和家庭支持针对高危人群的明智决策和应对方法。可能有助于进行与遗传状况或遗传咨询相关的研究。
jobs.de: Assess individual or family risk for a variety of inherited conditions, such as genetic disorders and birth defects. Provide information to other healthcare providers or to individuals and families concerned with the risk of inherited conditions. Advise individuals and families to support informed decisionmaking and coping methods for those at risk. May help conduct research related to genetic conditions or genetic counseling.

jobs.d: 在外科医生的监督下协助手术。可以根据州法律，帮助外科医生切开并闭合手术部位、操纵或移除组织、植入手术装置或引流管、抽吸手术部位、放置导管、夹紧或烧灼血管或组织，以及在手术部位涂抹敷料。
jobs.de: Assist in operations, under the supervision of surgeons. May, in accordance with state laws, help surgeons to make incisions and close surgical sites, manipulate or remove tissues, implant surgical devices or drains, suction the surgical site, place catheters, clamp or cauterize vessels or tissue, and apply dressings to surgical site.

jobs.d: 提供产前护理和分娩协助。
jobs.de: Provide prenatal care and childbirth assistance.

jobs.d: 监测残疾人或患病者的健康状况，并满足他们与健康相关的需求，例如更换绷带、包扎伤口或给药。工作是在场外或间歇性现场持照护理人员的指导下进行的。为日常医疗保健任务或日常生活活动提供帮助，例如喂食、洗澡、如厕或行走。还可以根据患者的能力帮助完成准备饭菜、做简单家务和洗衣服等任务。
jobs.de: Monitor the health status of an individual with disabilities or illness, and address their health-related needs, such as changing bandages, dressing wounds, or administering medication. Work is performed under the direction of offsite or intermittent onsite licensed nursing staff. Provide assistance with routine healthcare tasks or activities of daily living, such as feeding, bathing, toileting, or ambulation. May also help with tasks such as preparing meals, doing light housekeeping, and doing laundry depending on the patient's abilities.

jobs.d: 为需要个人护理和日常生活支持活动（例如喂养、洗澡、穿衣、梳洗、如厕和行走）帮助的残疾人或疾病患者提供个性化帮助。还可以帮助完成一些任务，例如准备饭菜、做简单的家务和洗衣服。根据护理接受者的需要，工作在不同的环境中进行，可能包括其家、工作地点、社区或日间非住宅设施等地点。
jobs.de: Provide personalized assistance to individuals with disabilities or illness who require help with personal care and activities of daily living support (e.g., feeding, bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and ambulation). May also provide help with tasks such as preparing meals, doing light housekeeping, and doing laundry. Work is performed in various settings depending on the needs of the care recipient and may include locations such as their home, place of work, out in the community, or at a daytime nonresidential facility.

jobs.d: 在现场持证护理人员的指导下提供或协助基本护理或支持。履行职责，例如监测医疗或护理机构中患者的健康状况、喂养、洗澡、穿衣、梳洗、如厕或行走。可能包括药物管理和其他与健康相关的任务。包括护理人员、护理助理和护理人员。
jobs.de: Provide or assist with basic care or support under the direction of onsite licensed nursing staff. Perform duties such as monitoring of health status, feeding, bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, or ambulation of patients in a health or nursing facility. May include medication administration and other health-related tasks. Includes nursing care attendants, nursing aides, and nursing attendants.

jobs.d: 使用轮椅、担架或移动床将患者运送到手术室或 X 光室等区域。可以维持供应品或清洁和运输设备的库存。精神科护理人员属于精神科助手。
jobs.de: Transport patients to areas such as operating rooms or x-ray rooms using wheelchairs, stretchers, or moveable beds. May maintain stocks of supplies or clean and transport equipment. Psychiatric orderlies are included in Psychiatric Aides.

jobs.d: 在护理人员和医务人员的指导下协助精神障碍或情绪失常的患者。可以协助日常生活活动，引导患者进行教育和娱乐活动，或陪伴患者往返检查和治疗。可以抑制暴力的患者。包括精神科护理人员。
jobs.de: Assist mentally impaired or emotionally disturbed patients, working under direction of nursing and medical staff. May assist with daily living activities, lead patients in educational and recreational activities, or accompany patients to and from examinations and treatments. May restrain violent patients. Includes psychiatric orderlies.

jobs.d: 协助职业治疗师提供职业治疗和程序。可以根据州法律协助制定治疗计划、履行日常职能、指导活动计划并记录治疗进度。通常需要正式培训。
jobs.de: Assist occupational therapists in providing occupational therapy treatments and procedures. May, in accordance with state laws, assist in development of treatment plans, carry out routine functions, direct activity programs, and document the progress of treatments. Generally requires formal training.

jobs.d: 在职业治疗师或职业治疗助理的密切监督下，仅在特定情况下执行委派的、选定的或常规任务。这些职责包括准备病人和治疗室。
jobs.de: Under close supervision of an occupational therapist or occupational therapy assistant, perform only delegated, selected, or routine tasks in specific situations. These duties include preparing patient and treatment room.

jobs.d: 协助物理治疗师提供物理治疗和程序。可以根据州法律，协助制定治疗计划，执行日常职能，记录治疗进度，并根据患者状况并在物理治疗师制定的治疗计划范围内修改具体治疗方案。通常需要正式培训。
jobs.de: Assist physical therapists in providing physical therapy treatments and procedures. May, in accordance with state laws, assist in the development of treatment plans, carry out routine functions, document the progress of treatment, and modify specific treatments in accordance with patient status and within the scope of treatment plans established by a physical therapist. Generally requires formal training.

jobs.d: 在物理治疗师或物理治疗助理的密切监督下，仅在特定情况下执行委派的、选定的或常规任务。这些职责包括为患者和治疗区域做好准备。
jobs.de: Under close supervision of a physical therapist or physical therapy assistant, perform only delegated, selected, or routine tasks in specific situations. These duties include preparing the patient and the treatment area.

jobs.d: 对软组织和关节进行治疗性按摩。可协助评估运动范围和肌肉力量，或提出客户治疗计划。
jobs.de: Perform therapeutic massages of soft tissues and joints. May assist in the assessment of range of motion and muscle strength, or propose client therapy plans.

jobs.d: 在牙医的指导下执行有限的临床职责。临床职责可能包括设备准备和消毒、患者治疗准备、在治疗期间协助牙医以及为患者提供口腔保健程序的说明。可以履行行政职责，例如安排预约、维护医疗记录、计费和出于保险目的编码信息。
jobs.de: Perform limited clinical duties under the direction of a dentist. Clinical duties may include equipment preparation and sterilization, preparing patients for treatment, assisting the dentist during treatment, and providing patients with instructions for oral healthcare procedures. May perform administrative duties such as scheduling appointments, maintaining medical records, billing, and coding information for insurance purposes.

jobs.d: 在医生的指导下执行行政和某些临床职责。行政职责可能包括安排预约、维护医疗记录、计费和出于保险目的编码信息。临床职责可能包括采集和记录生命体征和病史、准备患者检查、抽血以及按照医生的指示给药。
jobs.de: Perform administrative and certain clinical duties under the direction of a physician. Administrative duties may include scheduling appointments, maintaining medical records, billing, and coding information for insurance purposes. Clinical duties may include taking and recording vital signs and medical histories, preparing patients for examination, drawing blood, and administering medications as directed by physician.

jobs.d: 准备、消毒、安装或清洁实验室或医疗设备。可以执行常规实验室任务并操作或检查设备。
jobs.de: Prepare, sterilize, install, or clean laboratory or healthcare equipment. May perform routine laboratory tasks and operate or inspect equipment.

jobs.d: 使用各种电子设备转录医生和其他医疗保健从业人员记录的医疗报告，包括办公室就诊、急诊室就诊、诊断成像研究、操作、图表审查和最终摘要。转录口述报告并将缩写翻译成完全可以理解的形式。根据需要进行编辑，并以打印或电子形式返回报告以供审核和签名或更正。
jobs.de: Transcribe medical reports recorded by physicians and other healthcare practitioners using various electronic devices, covering office visits, emergency room visits, diagnostic imaging studies, operations, chart reviews, and final summaries. Transcribe dictated reports and translate abbreviations into fully understandable form. Edit as necessary and return reports in either printed or electronic form for review and signature, or correction.

jobs.d: 记录运送到药房的药品，存储进货商品，并通知主管库存需求。可以操作收银机并接受配药处方。
jobs.de: Record drugs delivered to the pharmacy, store incoming merchandise, and inform the supervisor of stock needs. May operate cash register and accept prescriptions for filling.

jobs.t: 兽医助理和实验动物看护者
jobs.d: 在实验室、动物医院和诊所给宠物和其他非农场动物喂食、饮水并检查是否有生病、疾病或受伤的迹象。清洁和消毒笼子和工作区域，并对实验室和手术设备进行消毒。可以提供常规术后护理、口服或局部用药，或在兽医或实验动物技术人员或技师、兽医或科学家的监督下准备实验室检查样本。
jobs.te: Veterinary Assistants and Laboratory Animal Caretakers
jobs.de: Feed, water, and examine pets and other nonfarm animals for signs of illness, disease, or injury in laboratories and animal hospitals and clinics. Clean and disinfect cages and work areas, and sterilize laboratory and surgical equipment. May provide routine postoperative care, administer medication orally or topically, or prepare samples for laboratory examination under the supervision of veterinary or laboratory animal technologists or technicians, veterinarians, or scientists.

jobs.d: 抽血用于测试、输血、捐赠或研究。可以向患者解释手术过程并协助出现不良反应的患者康复。
jobs.de: Draw blood for tests, transfusions, donations, or research. May explain the procedure to patients and assist in the recovery of patients with adverse reactions.

jobs.d: 协助言语病理学家评估和治疗言语、语言、声音和流畅性障碍。按照言语病理学家的计划和指导实施言语和语言计划或活动。监控替代通信设备和系统的使用。
jobs.de: Assist speech-language pathologists in the assessment and treatment of speech, language, voice, and fluency disorders. Implement speech and language programs or activities as planned and directed by speech-language pathologists. Monitor the use of alternative communication devices and systems.

jobs.d: 保持无菌区域，在内窥镜检查过程中为医生和护士提供支持。仪器、设备的准备和维护。可以获取样本。
jobs.de: Maintain a sterile field to provide support for physicians and nurses during endoscopy procedures. Prepare and maintain instruments and equipment. May obtain specimens.

jobs.d: 直接监督和协调惩教人员和狱卒的活动。
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of correctional officers and jailers.

jobs.t: 警察和侦探的一线主管
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调警察部队成员的活动。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Police and Detectives
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of members of police force.

jobs.t: 消防和预防工作人员的一线主管
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调从事消防和火灾预防和控制的工作人员的活动。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Firefighting and Prevention Workers
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of workers engaged in firefighting and fire prevention and control.

jobs.d: 控制和扑灭火灾或应对生命、财产或环境面临风险的紧急情况。职责可能包括防火、紧急医疗服务、危险物质响应、搜索和救援以及灾难援助。
jobs.de: Control and extinguish fires or respond to emergency situations where life, property, or the environment is at risk. Duties may include fire prevention, emergency medical service, hazardous material response, search and rescue, and disaster assistance.

jobs.d: 检查建筑物以发现火灾隐患并执行当地法令和州法律，或调查和收集事实以确定火灾和爆炸的原因。
jobs.de: Inspect buildings to detect fire hazards and enforce local ordinances and state laws, or investigate and gather facts to determine cause of fires and explosions.

jobs.t: 森林火灾督察和预防专家
jobs.d: 执行消防法规，检查森林是否存在火灾隐患，并建议森林火灾预防或控制措施。可以报​​告森林火灾和天气状况。
jobs.te: Forest Fire Inspectors and Prevention Specialists
jobs.de: Enforce fire regulations, inspect forest for fire hazards, and recommend forest fire prevention or control measures. May report forest fires and weather conditions.

jobs.d: 维持法庭秩序。
jobs.de: Maintain order in courts of law.

jobs.d: 根据既定法规和程序在刑罚或康复机构中看守囚犯。可以看守在监狱、法庭、监狱或其他地点之间转运的囚犯。包括大部分时间在惩教机构看守囚犯的副警长和警察。
jobs.de: Guard inmates in penal or rehabilitative institutions in accordance with established regulations and procedures. May guard prisoners in transit between jail, courtroom, prison, or other point. Includes deputy sheriffs and police who spend the majority of their time guarding prisoners in correctional institutions.

jobs.d: 对涉嫌违反联邦、州或地方法律的行为进行调查，以预防或解决犯罪。
jobs.de: Conduct investigations related to suspected violations of federal, state, or local laws to prevent or solve crimes.

jobs.t: 警察身份识别和记录官员
jobs.d: 在犯罪现场收集证据，对指纹进行分类和识别，并对证据进行拍照，以用于刑事和民事案件。
jobs.de: Collect evidence at crime scene, classify and identify fingerprints, and photograph evidence for use in criminal and civil cases.

jobs.d: 收集、分析或评估来自各种来源的信息，例如执法数据库、监视、情报网络或地理信息系统。使用情报数据预测和防止有组织的犯罪活动，例如恐怖主义。
jobs.de: Gather, analyze, or evaluate information from a variety of sources, such as law enforcement databases, surveillance, intelligence networks or geographic information systems. Use intelligence data to anticipate and prevent organized crime activities, such as terrorism.

jobs.d: 在指定区域巡逻，防止违反鱼类和狩猎法。调查野生动物对农作物或财产造成损害的报告。编译生物数据。
jobs.de: Patrol assigned area to prevent fish and game law violations. Investigate reports of damage to crops or property by wildlife. Compile biological data.

jobs.d: 在公共停车场或城市街道等指定区域巡逻，向超时停车违规者和非法停放车辆开罚单。
jobs.de: Patrol assigned area, such as public parking lot or city streets to issue tickets to overtime parking violators and illegally parked vehicles.

jobs.d: 通过执行地方、部落、州或联邦法律和条例来维持秩序并保护生命和财产。执行以下职责的组合： 巡逻特定区域；直接交通；发出交通传票；调查事故；逮捕和逮捕嫌疑人，或送达法院的法律程序。包括在教育机构工作的警察。
jobs.de: Maintain order and protect life and property by enforcing local, tribal, state, or federal laws and ordinances. Perform a combination of the following duties: patrol a specific area; direct traffic; issue traffic summonses; investigate accidents; apprehend and arrest suspects, or serve legal processes of courts. Includes police officers working at educational institutions.

jobs.d: 调查和检查进出美国或各州之间的人员、公共承运人、货物和商品，以发现违反移民和海关法律法规的行为。
jobs.de: Investigate and inspect persons, common carriers, goods, and merchandise, arriving in or departing from the United States or between states to detect violations of immigration and customs laws and regulations.

jobs.d: 保护和警察铁路和运输财产、雇员或乘客。
jobs.de: Protect and police railroad and transit property, employees, or passengers.

jobs.d: 处理动物以调查虐待情况或控制被遗弃、危险或无人看管的动物。
jobs.de: Handle animals for the purpose of investigations of mistreatment, or control of abandoned, dangerous, or unattended animals.

jobs.d: 聚集，分析、汇编并向客户报告有关个人或组织的信息，或发现私人机构中发生的非法行为或违反规则的情况。
jobs.de: Gather, analyze, compile, and report information regarding individuals or organizations to clients, or detect occurrences of unlawful acts or infractions of rules in private establishment.

jobs.t: 赌博监视人员和赌博调查员
jobs.d: 观察赌博运营是否存在员工或顾客的作弊或盗窃等不正常活动。调查赌博资产（例如金钱、筹码和赌博设备）的潜在威胁。充当管理层和客户的监督和安全代理。
jobs.te: Gambling Surveillance Officers and Gambling Investigators
jobs.de: Observe gambling operation for irregular activities such as cheating or theft by either employees or patrons. Investigate potential threats to gambling assets such as money, chips, and gambling equipment. Act as oversight and security agent for management and customers.

jobs.d: 警卫、巡逻或监控场所，以防止盗窃、暴力或违反规则。可以操作 X 射线和金属探测器设备。
jobs.de: Guard, patrol, or monitor premises to prevent theft, violence, or infractions of rules. May operate x-ray and metal detector equipment.

jobs.d: 在街道、学校、铁路道口或建筑工地等场所引导或控制车辆或行人交通。
jobs.de: Guide or control vehicular or pedestrian traffic at such places as streets, schools, railroad crossings, or construction sites.

jobs.t: 救生员、滑雪巡逻人员和其他娱乐防护服务人员
jobs.d: 监控游泳池、海滩或滑雪场等休闲区域，为参与者提供帮助和保护。
jobs.te: Lifeguards, Ski Patrol, and Other Recreational Protective Service Workers
jobs.de: Monitor recreational areas, such as pools, beaches, or ski slopes, to provide assistance and protection to participants.

jobs.d: 对乘客、行李或货物进行检查，以确保遵守运输安全管理局 (TSA) 的规定。可以在安检点操作基本的安全设备，例如 X 光机和手杖。
jobs.de: Conduct screening of passengers, baggage, or cargo to ensure compliance with Transportation Security Administration (TSA) regulations. May operate basic security equipment such as x-ray machines and hand wands at screening checkpoints.

jobs.d: 实施程序和系统以防止商品丢失。对员工活动进行审计和调查。可协助制定保护资产的政策、程序和系统。
jobs.de: Implement procedures and systems to prevent merchandise loss. Conduct audits and investigations of employee activity. May assist in developing policies, procedures, and systems for safeguarding assets.

jobs.d: 直接，并可参与沙拉、汤、鱼、肉、蔬菜、甜点或其他食物的准备、调味和烹饪。可以计划菜单项目并为其定价、订购供应品以及保存记录和账目。
jobs.de: Direct and may participate in the preparation, seasoning, and cooking of salads, soups, fish, meats, vegetables, desserts, or other foods. May plan and price menu items, order supplies, and keep records and accounts.

jobs.t: 食品准备和服务人员的一线主管
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调从事食品准备和服务的工人的活动。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Food Preparation and Serving Workers
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of workers engaged in preparing and serving food.

jobs.d: 在菜单有限的快餐店准备和烹饪食物。这些厨师的职责仅限于准备一些基本物品，通常涉及操作大容量的单一用途烹饪设备。
jobs.de: Prepare and cook food in a fast food restaurant with a limited menu. Duties of these cooks are limited to preparation of a few basic items and normally involve operating large-volume single-purpose cooking equipment.

jobs.d: 为学校、医院或自助餐厅等机构准备和烹饪大量食物。
jobs.de: Prepare and cook large quantities of food for institutions, such as schools, hospitals, or cafeterias.

jobs.d: 在私人住宅准备饭菜。包括私人厨师。
jobs.de: Prepare meals in private homes. Includes personal chefs.
