jobs.d: 在餐厅准备、调味和烹饪汤、肉、蔬菜或甜点等菜肴。可以订购供应品、保存记录和账目、为菜单上的项目定价或计划菜单。
jobs.de: Prepare, season, and cook dishes such as soups, meats, vegetables, or desserts in restaurants. May order supplies, keep records and accounts, price items on menu, or plan menu.

jobs.d: 准备和烹饪各种只需要很短准备时间的食物。可以接受顾客的订单并在柜台或餐桌上为顾客提供服务。
jobs.de: Prepare and cook to order a variety of foods that require only a short preparation time. May take orders from customers and serve patrons at counters or tables.

jobs.d: 执行除烹饪以外的各种食物准备职责，例如准备冷食和贝类、切肉以及冲泡咖啡或茶。
jobs.de: Perform a variety of food preparation duties other than cooking, such as preparing cold foods and shellfish, slicing meat, and brewing coffee or tea.

jobs.d: 直接或通过服务员为顾客混合饮料并提供服务。
jobs.de: Mix and serve drinks to patrons, directly or through waitstaff.

jobs.d: 执行诸如接受订单和提供食品和饮料等职责。在柜台或蒸汽桌上为顾客提供服务。可以接受付款。可以准备食物和饮料。
jobs.de: Perform duties such as taking orders and serving food and beverages. Serve customers at counter or from a steam table. May take payment. May prepare food and beverages.

jobs.d: 准备或提供特色咖啡或其他饮料。向顾客提供烘焙食品或三明治等食品。
jobs.de: Prepare or serve specialty coffee or other beverages. Serve food such as baked goods or sandwiches to patrons.

jobs.d: 在餐饮场所的餐桌上接受订单并为顾客提供食品和饮料。
jobs.de: Take orders and serve food and beverages to patrons at tables in dining establishment.

jobs.d: 向餐厅环境之外的个人提供食物，例如在酒店房间、医院房间、住宿护理设施或汽车中。
jobs.de: Serve food to individuals outside of a restaurant environment, such as in hotel rooms, hospital rooms, residential care facilities, or cars.

jobs.t: 餐厅和自助餐厅服务员和调酒师助手
jobs.d: 提供餐饮服务。干净的桌子；清除脏盘子；更换脏桌布；设置桌子；补充干净的床单、银器、玻璃器皿和餐具的供应；为服务吧提供食物；并为顾客提供水、调味品和咖啡等物品。
jobs.te: Dining Room and Cafeteria Attendants and Bartender Helpers
jobs.de: Facilitate food service. Clean tables; remove dirty dishes; replace soiled table linens; set tables; replenish supply of clean linens, silverware, glassware, and dishes; supply service bar with food; and serve items such as water, condiments, and coffee to patrons.

jobs.d: 清洁餐具、厨房、食品准备设备或餐具。
jobs.de: Clean dishes, kitchen, food preparation equipment, or utensils.

jobs.t: 餐厅、酒廊和咖啡店的男女主人
jobs.d: 欢迎顾客，让他们坐在餐桌或休息室，并帮助确保设施和服务的质量。
jobs.te: Hosts and Hostesses, Restaurant, Lounge, and Coffee Shop
jobs.de: Welcome patrons, seat them at tables or in lounge, and help ensure quality of facilities and service.

jobs.t: 家政和清洁的一线主管工人
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调酒店、医院、办公室和其他场所的清洁人员的工作活动。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Housekeeping and Janitorial Workers
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate work activities of cleaning personnel in hotels, hospitals, offices, and other establishments.

jobs.t: 园林绿化、草坪服务和场地维护的一线主管 工人
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调从事园林绿化或园林绿化工作的工人的活动场地维护活动。工作可能涉及审查合同以确定服务、机器和劳动力要求；回答潜在客户有关方法、材料和价格范围的询问；并根据劳动力、材料和机器成本进行估算。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Landscaping, Lawn Service, and Groundskeeping Workers
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of workers engaged in landscaping or groundskeeping activities. Work may involve reviewing contracts to ascertain service, machine, and workforce requirements; answering inquiries from potential customers regarding methods, material, and price ranges; and preparing estimates according to labor, material, and machine costs.

jobs.t: 门卫和清洁工，女佣和家政清洁工除外
jobs.d: 保持建筑物清洁有序。执行繁重的清洁工作，例如清洁地板、清洗地毯、清洗墙壁和玻璃以及清除垃圾。职责可能包括照管炉子和锅炉、进行日常维护活动、通知管理层需要维修以及清理人行道上的积雪或碎片。
jobs.te: Janitors and Cleaners, Except Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners
jobs.de: Keep buildings in clean and orderly condition. Perform heavy cleaning duties, such as cleaning floors, shampooing rugs, washing walls and glass, and removing rubbish. Duties may include tending furnace and boiler, performing routine maintenance activities, notifying management of need for repairs, and cleaning snow or debris from sidewalk.

jobs.d: 执行任何轻度清洁职责的组合，以保持私人家庭或商业机构（例如酒店和医院）的清洁和有序。职责可能包括整理床铺、补充床单、清洁房间和大厅以及吸尘。
jobs.de: Perform any combination of light cleaning duties to maintain private households or commercial establishments, such as hotels and hospitals, in a clean and orderly manner. Duties may include making beds, replenishing linens, cleaning rooms and halls, and vacuuming.

jobs.d: 使用或释放​​化学溶液或有毒气体，并设置陷阱来杀死或清除侵扰建筑物和周边地区的害虫和害虫。
jobs.de: Apply or release chemical solutions or toxic gases and set traps to kill or remove pests and vermin that infest buildings and surrounding areas.

jobs.t: 园林绿化和场地维护工人
jobs.d: 使用手动或电动工具或设备进行景观美化或维护财产地面。工人通常执行各种任务，其中可能包括以下任意组合：草皮铺设、割草、修剪、种植、浇水、施肥、挖掘、耙地、喷水装置安装以及无灰浆节段混凝土砌体墙单元的安装。
jobs.de: Landscape or maintain grounds of property using hand or power tools or equipment. Workers typically perform a variety of tasks, which may include any combination of the following: sod laying, mowing, trimming, planting, watering, fertilizing, digging, raking, sprinkler installation, and installation of mortarless segmental concrete masonry wall units.

jobs.t: 农药操作者、喷雾器和施用者，植被
jobs.d: 通过喷雾剂、灰尘、蒸汽、土壤掺入或化学施用在树木上混合或施用杀虫剂、除草剂、杀菌剂或杀虫剂，灌木、草坪或农作物。通常需要特定的培训和州或联邦认证。
jobs.te: Pesticide Handlers, Sprayers, and Applicators, Vegetation
jobs.de: Mix or apply pesticides, herbicides, fungicides, or insecticides through sprays, dusts, vapors, soil incorporation, or chemical application on trees, shrubs, lawns, or crops. Usually requires specific training and state or federal certification.

jobs.d: 使用复杂的攀爬和索具技术，剪掉树木或灌木上枯死或多余的树枝，以保持道路、人行道或公用设施的通行权，或改善树木的外观、健康和价值。使用手锯、手动修剪器、剪刀和电动修剪器修剪或处理树木或灌木。在树冠上进行离地作业，可以使用卡车升降机。
jobs.de: Using sophisticated climbing and rigging techniques, cut away dead or excess branches from trees or shrubs to maintain right-of-way for roads, sidewalks, or utilities, or to improve appearance, health, and value of tree. Prune or treat trees or shrubs using handsaws, hand pruners, clippers, and power pruners. Works off the ground in the tree canopy and may use truck-mounted lifts.

jobs.t: 赌博服务工作人员的一线主管
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调指定赌博区域内工人的活动。可以在桌子之间巡视，观察操作，并确保每个轮班的车站和游戏都有覆盖。可以验证并支付累积奖金。可能会在支付后重置老虎机并对老虎机进行维修或调整，或建议拆除老虎机进行维修。可以为酒店/赌场的客人计划和组织活动和服务。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Gambling Services Workers
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of workers in assigned gambling areas. May circulate among tables, observe operations, and ensure that stations and games are covered for each shift. May verify and pay off jackpots. May reset slot machines after payoffs and make repairs or adjustments to slot machines or recommend removal of slot machines for repair. May plan and organize activities and services for guests in hotels/casinos.

jobs.t: 个人服务工作人员的一线主管
jobs.d: 监督和协调个人服务人员的活动。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Personal Service Workers
jobs.de: Supervise and coordinate activities of personal service workers.

jobs.d: 训练动物骑乘、挽具、安全、表演或服从，或协助残疾人。让动物习惯人类的声音和接触，并训练动物对命令做出反应。按照规定的标准训练动物进行表演或比赛。可以训练动物搬运行李或作为狼群团队的一员工作。
jobs.de: Train animals for riding, harness, security, performance, or obedience, or for assisting persons with disabilities. Accustom animals to human voice and contact, and condition animals to respond to commands. Train animals according to prescribed standards for show or competition. May train animals to carry pack loads or work as part of pack team.

jobs.d: 喂食、饮水、梳理毛发、洗澡、锻炼或以其他方式提供护理，以促进和维持宠物和其他非食用动物的福祉，例如狗、猫、赛马、观赏鱼或鸟类、动物园动物和老鼠。在狗舍、动物收容所、动物园、马戏团和水族馆等场所工作。可以保存喂养、治疗以及接收或释放动物的记录。可以清洁、消毒和修理笼子、围栏或鱼缸。
jobs.de: Feed, water, groom, bathe, exercise, or otherwise provide care to promote and maintain the well-being of pets and other animals that are not raised for consumption, such as dogs, cats, race horses, ornamental fish or birds, zoo animals, and mice. Work in settings such as kennels, animal shelters, zoos, circuses, and aquariums. May keep records of feedings, treatments, and animals received or discharged. May clean, disinfect, and repair cages, pens, or fish tanks.

jobs.d: 操作桌上游戏。站在或坐在桌子后面，通过向玩家分发适当数量的纸牌或方块或操作其他赌博设备来操作机会游戏。分配奖金或收集玩家的金钱或筹码。可以将赌场的手牌与玩家的手牌进行比较。
jobs.de: Operate table games. Stand or sit behind table and operate games of chance by dispensing the appropriate number of cards or blocks to players, or operating other gambling equipment. Distribute winnings or collect players' money or chips. May compare the house's hand against players' hands.

jobs.t: 赌博和体育书籍作家和跑步者
jobs.d: 发布信息，使顾客能够对各种比赛和体育赛事进行下注。协助运营基诺、宾果等游戏。可以操作随机数字生成设备并为顾客宣布数字。接收、验证并记录顾客的赌注。扫描和处理顾客出示的中奖彩票，并支付这些投注的奖金。
jobs.te: Gambling and Sports Book Writers and Runners
jobs.de: Post information enabling patrons to wager on various races and sporting events. Assist in the operation of games such as keno and bingo. May operate random number-generating equipment and announce the numbers for patrons. Receive, verify, and record patrons' wagers. Scan and process winning tickets presented by patrons and pay out winnings for those wagers.

jobs.d: 设置和操作电影投影和相关声音再现设备。
jobs.de: Set up and operate motion picture projection and related sound reproduction equipment.

jobs.t: 引座员、大堂服务员和检票员
jobs.d: 在娱乐活动中协助顾客履行职责，例如向顾客收集入场券和通行证、协助寻找座位、寻找丢失的物品以及帮助顾客找到卫生间和电话等设施。
jobs.te: Ushers, Lobby Attendants, and Ticket Takers
jobs.de: Assist patrons at entertainment events by performing duties, such as collecting admission tickets and passes from patrons, assisting in finding seats, searching for lost articles, and helping patrons locate such facilities as restrooms and telephones.

jobs.d: 在娱乐或休闲设施中履行各种服务职责。可以安排娱乐设施的使用，为体育赛事或娱乐活动的参与者维护和提供设备，或经营娱乐特许经营和游乐设施。
jobs.de: Perform a variety of attending duties at amusement or recreation facility. May schedule use of recreation facilities, maintain and provide equipment to participants of sporting events or recreational pursuits, or operate amusement concessions and rides.

jobs.d: 为演员选择、试穿和照顾服装，并协助艺人。可能会在表演期间协助更换多种服装。
jobs.de: Select, fit, and take care of costumes for cast members, and aid entertainers. May assist with multiple costume changes during performances.

jobs.t: 更衣室、衣帽间和更衣室服务员
jobs.d: 在更衣室、更衣室或衣帽间向顾客或顾客提供个人物品。
jobs.te: Locker Room, Coatroom, and Dressing Room Attendants
jobs.de: Provide personal items to patrons or customers in locker rooms, dressing rooms, or coatrooms.

jobs.d: 按照法律要求准备安葬尸体。
jobs.de: Prepare bodies for interment in conformity with legal requirements.

jobs.d: 在葬礼期间执行各种任务，例如在服务之前将棺材放在客厅或教堂，在棺材周围布置鲜花或灯光，指挥或护送哀悼者，关闭
jobs.de: Perform a variety of tasks during funeral, such as placing casket in parlor or chapel prior to service, arranging floral offerings or lights around casket, directing or escorting mourners, closing casket, and issuing and storing funeral equipment.

jobs.t: 殡葬师、承办人和葬礼人员编曲
jobs.d: 执行各种任务来安排和指导个人葬礼服务，例如协调将遗体运送到太平间、采访家人或其他授权人员以安排细节、选择护柩者、协助选择负责宗教仪式的官员以及为哀悼者提供交通。
jobs.de: Perform various tasks to arrange and direct individual funeral services, such as coordinating transportation of body to mortuary, interviewing family or other authorized person to arrange details, selecting pallbearers, aiding with the selection of officials for religious rites, and providing transportation for mourners.

jobs.d: 提供理发服务，例如剪发、修剪、洗发和造型；修剪胡须；或刮胡子。
jobs.de: Provide barbering services, such as cutting, trimming, shampooing, and styling hair; trimming beards; or giving shaves.

jobs.t: 美发师、发型师和美容师
jobs.d: 提供美容服务，例如剪发、染发、造型以及按摩和护理头皮。可以洗头、化妆、戴假发、脱毛，并提供指甲和护肤服务。
jobs.de: Provide beauty services, such as cutting, coloring, and styling hair, and massaging and treating scalp. May shampoo hair, apply makeup, dress wigs, remove hair, and provide nail and skincare services.

jobs.d: 为表演者化妆，以反映其角色的时期、背景和情况。
jobs.de: Apply makeup to performers to reflect period, setting, and situation of their role.

jobs.d: 清洁和塑造顾客的手指甲和脚趾甲。可以抛光或装饰指甲。
jobs.de: Clean and shape customers' fingernails and toenails. May polish or decorate nails.

jobs.d: 洗发并冲洗顾客的头发。
jobs.de: Shampoo and rinse customers' hair.

jobs.d: 为面部和身体提供护肤护理，以增强个人的外观。包括电科医生和激光脱毛专家。
jobs.de: Provide skincare treatments to face and body to enhance an individual's appearance. Includes electrologists and laser hair removal specialists.

jobs.d: 在交通枢纽为旅客或酒店或类似场所的客人处理行李。
jobs.de: Handle baggage for travelers at transportation terminals or for guests at hotels or similar establishments.

jobs.d: 为酒店、公寓或办公楼的顾客提供个人服务。可以接受消息；安排交通、商业服务或娱乐或提供建议；或监控客人对家政和维护的要求。
jobs.de: Assist patrons at hotel, apartment, or office building with personal services. May take messages; arrange or give advice on transportation, business services, or entertainment; or monitor guest requests for housekeeping and maintenance.

jobs.d: 护送个人或团体观光旅游或穿过工业设施、公共建筑和艺术画廊等名胜古迹。
jobs.de: Escort individuals or groups on sightseeing tours or through places of interest, such as industrial establishments, public buildings, and art galleries.

jobs.d: 为个人和团体计划、组织和进行长途旅行、游览和探险。
jobs.de: Plan, organize, and conduct long-distance travel, tours, and expeditions for individuals and groups.

jobs.d: 照顾学校、企业、私人家庭和托儿机构的儿童。执行各种任务，例如穿衣、喂食、洗澡和监督玩耍。
jobs.de: Attend to children at schools, businesses, private households, and childcare institutions. Perform a variety of tasks, such as dressing, feeding, bathing, and overseeing play.

jobs.d: 照顾私人家庭中的儿童，并为父母提供支持和专业知识，以满足儿童的身体、情感、智力和社交需求。职责可能包括膳食计划和准备、洗衣和衣物护理、组织游戏活动和郊游、纪律、智力刺激、语言活动和交通。
jobs.de: Care for children in private households and provide support and expertise to parents in satisfying children's physical, emotional, intellectual, and social needs. Duties may include meal planning and preparation, laundry and clothing care, organization of play activities and outings, discipline, intellectual stimulation, language activities, and transportation.

jobs.t: 运动教练和团体健身教练
jobs.d: 指导或指导团体或个人进行以个人健身为主要目的的锻炼活动。展示技巧和形式，观察参与者，并向他们解释提高技能所需的纠正措施。制定并实施个性化的锻炼方法。
jobs.te: Exercise Trainers and Group Fitness Instructors
jobs.de: Instruct or coach groups or individuals in exercise activities for the primary purpose of personal fitness. Demonstrate techniques and form, observe participants, and explain to them corrective measures necessary to improve their skills. Develop and implement individualized approaches to exercise.

jobs.d: 与公共、私人或志愿者机构或娱乐设施中的团体一起开展娱乐活动。组织和促进各种活动，例如艺术和手工艺、体育、游戏、音乐、戏剧、社交娱乐、露营和爱好，同时考虑到个人会员的需求和兴趣。
jobs.de: Conduct recreation activities with groups in public, private, or volunteer agencies or recreation facilities. Organize and promote activities, such as arts and crafts, sports, games, music, dramatics, social recreation, camping, and hobbies, taking into account the needs and interests of individual members.

jobs.d: 协调中学和大学宿舍、团体之家或类似场所的居民设施中的活动。订购用品并确定维护、修理和家具的需求。可以维护家庭记录并分配房间。可以协助居民解决问题或向他们推荐咨询资源。
jobs.de: Coordinate activities in resident facilities in secondary school and college dormitories, group homes, or similar establishments. Order supplies and determine need for maintenance, repairs, and furnishings. May maintain household records and assign rooms. May assist residents with problem solving or refer them to counseling resources.

jobs.t: 零售销售一线主管员工
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调机构或部门的零售工作人员的活动。除了监督职责外，职责还可能包括管理职能，例如采购、预算、会计和人事工作。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Retail Sales Workers
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of retail sales workers in an establishment or department. Duties may include management functions, such as purchasing, budgeting, accounting, and personnel work, in addition to supervisory duties.

jobs.t: 非零售销售一线主管 员工
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调零售人员以外的销售人员的活动。除了监督职责外，还可以履行预算、会计和人事工作等职责。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Non-Retail Sales Workers
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of sales workers other than retail sales workers. May perform duties such as budgeting, accounting, and personnel work, in addition to supervisory duties.

jobs.d: 在金融机构以外的机构接收和支付资金。可以使用电子扫描仪、收银机或相关设备。可以处理信用卡或借记卡交易并验证支票。
jobs.de: Receive and disburse money in establishments other than financial institutions. May use electronic scanners, cash registers, or related equipment. May process credit or debit card transactions and validate checks.

jobs.t: 赌博换班员及摊位收银员
jobs.d: 用硬币、代币和筹码兑换顾客的钱。可以发放付款并在收据上获得客户签名。可以在老虎机区域经营一个摊位，并在轮班开始时为找零人员提供银行，或者清点和审计抽屉中的钱。
jobs.te: Gambling Change Persons and Booth Cashiers
jobs.de: Exchange coins, tokens, and chips for patrons' money. May issue payoffs and obtain customer's signature on receipt. May operate a booth in the slot machine area and furnish change persons with money bank at the start of the shift, or count and audit money in drawers.

jobs.d: 通常亲自接收维修、租赁和服务订单。可以描述可用选项、计算成本并接受付款。
jobs.de: Receive orders, generally in person, for repairs, rentals, and services. May describe available options, compute cost, and accept payment.

jobs.d: 在修理店或零件店销售备件和更换零件和设备。
jobs.de: Sell spare and replacement parts and equipment in repair shop or parts store.

jobs.d: 向消费者销售商品，例如家具、机动车辆、电器或服装。
jobs.de: Sell merchandise, such as furniture, motor vehicles, appliances, or apparel to consumers.

jobs.d: 在出版物、标牌、电视、广播或互联网机构或公共场所销售或征求广告空间、时间或媒体。
jobs.de: Sell or solicit advertising space, time, or media in publications, signage, TV, radio, or Internet establishments or public spaces.

jobs.d: 销售人寿、财产、伤亡、健康、汽车或其他类型的保险。可以将客户推荐给独立经纪人、担任独立经纪人或受雇于保险公司。
jobs.de: Sell life, property, casualty, health, automotive, or other types of insurance. May refer clients to independent brokers, work as an independent broker, or be employed by an insurance company.

jobs.t: 证券、商品和金融服务销售代理
jobs.d: 在投资和贸易公司买卖证券或商品，或向企业和个人提供金融服务。可以为客户提供有关股票、债券、共同基金、商品和市场状况的建议。
jobs.te: Securities, Commodities, and Financial Services Sales Agents
jobs.de: Buy and sell securities or commodities in investment and trading firms, or provide financial services to businesses and individuals. May advise customers about stocks, bonds, mutual funds, commodities, and market conditions.

jobs.d: 为客户计划和销售交通和住宿。确定目的地、交通方式、旅行日期、费用和所需住宿。还可以描述、计划和安排行程并销售旅游套餐。可以协助解决客户的旅行问题。
jobs.de: Plan and sell transportation and accommodations for customers. Determine destination, modes of transportation, travel dates, costs, and accommodations required. May also describe, plan, and arrange itineraries and sell tour packages. May assist in resolving clients' travel problems.

jobs.t: 销售代表、批发和制造、技术和科学产品
jobs.d: 向需要生物、工程、化学和电子等领域技术或科学知识的批发商或制造商销售商品，这些知识通常从至少两年的高等教育中获得。
jobs.te: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Technical and Scientific Products
jobs.de: Sell goods for wholesalers or manufacturers where technical or scientific knowledge is required in such areas as biology, engineering, chemistry, and electronics, normally obtained from at least 2 years of postsecondary education.

jobs.t: 太阳能销售代表和评估员
jobs.d: 联系新客户或现有客户以确定他们的太阳能设备需求，建议系统或设备，或估算成本。
jobs.de: Contact new or existing customers to determine their solar equipment needs, suggest systems or equipment, or estimate costs.

jobs.t: 销售代表、批发和制造，技术和科学产品除外
jobs.d: 向企业或个人团体销售批发商或制造商的商品。工作需要对所售商品有丰富的了解。
jobs.te: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing, Except Technical and Scientific Products
jobs.de: Sell goods for wholesalers or manufacturers to businesses or groups of individuals. Work requires substantial knowledge of items sold.

jobs.d: 展示商品并回答问题，以引起公众购买该产品的兴趣。可以出售展示的商品。
jobs.de: Demonstrate merchandise and answer questions for the purpose of creating public interest in buying the product. May sell demonstrated merchandise.

jobs.d: 在时装秀、私人展示或零售场所为潜在买家提供模特服装或其他服装和配饰。可以摆出姿势拍照用于杂志或广告。可以作为绘画、雕塑和其他类型艺术表达的主题。
jobs.de: Model garments or other apparel and accessories for prospective buyers at fashion shows, private showings, or retail establishments. May pose for photos to be used in magazines or advertisements. May pose as subject for paintings, sculptures, and other types of artistic expression.

jobs.d: 经营房地产办公室，或在商业房地产公司工作，监督房地产交易。其他职责通常包括出售房地产或出租房产以及安排贷款。
jobs.de: Operate real estate office, or work for commercial real estate firm, overseeing real estate transactions. Other duties usually include selling real estate or renting properties and arranging loans.

jobs.d: 为客户出租、购买或出售房产。履行诸如研究房产清单、采访潜在客户、陪同客户前往房产现场、讨论销售条件以及起草房地产合同等职责。包括代表买方的代理人。
jobs.de: Rent, buy, or sell property for clients. Perform duties such as study property listings, interview prospective clients, accompany clients to property site, discuss conditions of sale, and draw up real estate contracts. Includes agents who represent buyer.

jobs.d: 销售商业商品或服务，其销售需要相当于工程学学士学位的技术背景。
jobs.de: Sell business goods or services, the selling of which requires a technical background equivalent to a baccalaureate degree in engineering.

jobs.d: 通过电话索取商品或服务的捐赠或订单。
jobs.de: Solicit donations or orders for goods or services over the telephone.

jobs.t: 上门销售人员、新闻和街头小贩及相关人员
jobs.d: 挨家挨户或在街上销售商品或服务。
jobs.te: Door-to-Door Sales Workers, News and Street Vendors, and Related Workers
jobs.de: Sell goods or services door-to-door or on the street.

jobs.t: 办公室一线主管和行政支持人员
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调文书和行政支持人员的活动。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Office and Administrative Support Workers
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of clerical and administrative support workers.

jobs.t: 总机接线员，包括应答服务
jobs.d: 操作电话业务系统设备或用于中继传入、传出和办公室间呼叫的总机。可以向呼叫者提供信息并记录消息。
jobs.de: Operate telephone business systems equipment or switchboards to relay incoming, outgoing, and interoffice calls. May supply information to callers and record messages.

jobs.d: 通过访问字母、地理或其他目录来提供信息。协助客户处理特殊的计费请求，例如向第三方收费以及因拨错号码或连接不良而获得积分或退款。可以处理紧急电话并协助儿童或身体残疾的人拨打电话。
jobs.de: Provide information by accessing alphabetical, geographical, or other directories. Assist customers with special billing requests, such as charges to a third party and credits or refunds for incorrectly dialed numbers or bad connections. May handle emergency calls and assist children or people with physical disabilities to make telephone calls.

jobs.d: 通过邮件、电话或亲自拜访以索取付款的方式找到并通知拖欠帐户的客户。职责包括接收付款并将金额记入客户的帐户、在客户未回复时向信贷部门准备报表、启动收回程序或中断服务，以及保留收款和帐户状态记录。
jobs.de: Locate and notify customers of delinquent accounts by mail, telephone, or personal visit to solicit payment. Duties include receiving payment and posting amount to customer's account, preparing statements to credit department if customer fails to respond, initiating repossession proceedings or service disconnection, and keeping records of collection and status of accounts.

jobs.d: 编译、计算和记录帐单、会计、统计和其他用于帐单目的的数字数据。为所提供的服务或货物的交付或装运准备账单发票。
jobs.de: Compile, compute, and record billing, accounting, statistical, and other numerical data for billing purposes. Prepare billing invoices for services rendered or for delivery or shipment of goods.

jobs.d: 计算、分类和记录数字数据以保持财务记录的完整性。执行例行计算、过账和验证职责的任意组合，以获得用于维护会计记录的主要财务数据。还可以检查其他工作人员记录的与业务交易有关的数字、计算和过帐的准确性。
jobs.de: Compute, classify, and record numerical data to keep financial records complete. Perform any combination of routine calculating, posting, and verifying duties to obtain primary financial data for use in maintaining accounting records. May also check the accuracy of figures, calculations, and postings pertaining to business transactions recorded by other workers.

jobs.d: 在赌场中，为顾客进行金融交易。接受顾客的信用申请并验证信用证明以提供支票兑现授权或建立房屋信用账户。可以将每日交易摘要与余额账簿进行核对。可能会向顾客出售赌博筹码、代币或门票，或向其他工作人员出售，然后再转售给顾客。可以根据顾客的要求将赌博筹码、代币或门票兑换成货币。可以使用收银机或计算机来记录交易。
jobs.de: In a gambling establishment, conduct financial transactions for patrons. Accept patron's credit application and verify credit references to provide check-cashing authorization or to establish house credit accounts. May reconcile daily summaries of transactions to balance books. May sell gambling chips, tokens, or tickets to patrons, or to other workers for resale to patrons. May convert gambling chips, tokens, or tickets to currency upon patron's request. May use a cash register or computer to record transaction.

jobs.d: 编译并记录员工时间和工资数据。可以计算员工的工作时间、产量和佣金。可以计算并过帐工资和扣除额，或准备薪水。
jobs.de: Compile and record employee time and payroll data. May compute employees' time worked, production, and commission. May compute and post wages and deductions, or prepare paychecks.

jobs.d: 编译信息和记录以制定材料和服务采购的采购订单。
jobs.de: Compile information and records to draw up purchase orders for procurement of materials and services.

jobs.d: 接收和支付款项。保存金融机构各种交易中涉及的货币和流通票据的记录。
jobs.de: Receive and pay out money. Keep records of money and negotiable instruments involved in a financial institution's various transactions.

jobs.d: 履行与购买、出售或持有证券相关的职责。职责包括编写股票购买或销售订单、计算转让税、核实股票交易、接受和交付证券、跟踪股票价格波动、计算股本、分配股息以及保存日常交易和持有记录。
jobs.de: Perform duties related to the purchase, sale, or holding of securities. Duties include writing orders for stock purchases or sales, computing transfer taxes, verifying stock transactions, accepting and delivering securities, tracking stock price fluctuations, computing equity, distributing dividends, and keeping records of daily transactions and holdings.

jobs.d: 撰写信件或电子信件以回复商品请求、损坏索赔、信用和其他信息、拖欠账户、不正确的账单或不满意的服务。职责可能包括收集数据以制定答复和准备信件。
jobs.de: Compose letters or electronic correspondence in reply to requests for merchandise, damage claims, credit and other information, delinquent accounts, incorrect billings, or unsatisfactory services. Duties may include gathering data to formulate reply and preparing correspondence.

jobs.d: 为法院、市政府或政府许可机构和局履行文书职责。可以准备待传唤的案件清单；为法官和法庭提供安全信息；为镇或市议会准备议程或章程草案；回复官方信件；保存财务记录和账目；颁发执照或许可证；并记录数据、管理测试或收取费用。
jobs.de: Perform clerical duties for courts of law, municipalities, or governmental licensing agencies and bureaus. May prepare docket of cases to be called; secure information for judges and court; prepare draft agendas or bylaws for town or city council; answer official correspondence; keep fiscal records and accounts; issue licenses or permits; and record data, administer tests, or collect fees.

jobs.t: 信用授权人、检查员和文员
jobs.d: 授权对客户帐户收取信用费用。调查申请信贷的个人或企业机构的历史和信用状况。可能会采访申请人以获取个人和财务数据、确定信用度、处理申请并通知客户接受或拒绝信贷。
jobs.de: Authorize credit charges against customers' accounts. Investigate history and credit standing of individuals or business establishments applying for credit. May interview applicants to obtain personal and financial data, determine credit worthiness, process applications, and notify customers of acceptance or rejection of credit.

jobs.d: 与客户互动，提供基本或脚本信息，以回应有关产品和服务的日常查询。可以处理和解决一般投诉。不包括主要职责是安装、销售、维修和技术支持的个人。
jobs.de: Interact with customers to provide basic or scripted information in response to routine inquiries about products and services. May handle and resolve general complaints. Excludes individuals whose duties are primarily installation, sales, repair, and technical support.

jobs.d: 确定申请接受政府计划和机构资源（如福利、失业救济、社会保障和公共住房）援助的人员的资格。
jobs.de: Determine eligibility of persons applying to receive assistance from government programs and agency resources, such as welfare, unemployment benefits, social security, and public housing.

jobs.d: 按字母或数字顺序或根据所使用的归档系统归档信件、卡片、发票、收据和其他记录。根据要求找到并删除文件中的材料。
jobs.de: File correspondence, cards, invoices, receipts, and other records in alphabetical or numerical order or according to the filing system used. Locate and remove material from file when requested.

jobs.t: 酒店、汽车旅馆和度假村前台文员
jobs.d: 为酒店、汽车旅馆和度假村的顾客登记和分配房间、发放房间钥匙或房卡、发送和接收消息、保存占用房间和客人帐户的记录、进行和确认预订、向离开的客人提供报表并收取费用。
jobs.te: Hotel, Motel, and Resort Desk Clerks
jobs.de: Accommodate hotel, motel, and resort patrons by registering and assigning rooms to guests, issuing room keys or cards, transmitting and receiving messages, keeping records of occupied rooms and guests' accounts, making and confirming reservations, and presenting statements to and collecting payments from departing guests.

jobs.t: 面试官，除了资格和贷款
jobs.d: 通过电话、邮件、亲自或其他方式与人员面谈，以完成表格、申请或调查问卷。提出具体问题、记录答案并协助人员填写表格。可以整理、分类和归档表格。
jobs.de: Interview persons by telephone, mail, in person, or by other means for the purpose of completing forms, applications, or questionnaires. Ask specific questions, record answers, and assist persons with completing form. May sort, classify, and file forms.

jobs.d: 编译记录，整理、上架、发放和接收图书馆资料，如书籍、电子媒体、图片、卡片、幻灯片和缩微胶卷。根据标识号和标题，找到要借阅的图书馆资料并更换书架区域、书库或文件中的资料。注册顾客以允许他们借阅书籍、期刊和其他图书馆资料。
jobs.de: Compile records, and sort, shelve, issue, and receive library materials such as books, electronic media, pictures, cards, slides and microfilm. Locate library materials for loan and replace material in shelving area, stacks, or files according to identification number and title. Register patrons to permit them to borrow books, periodicals, and other library materials.

jobs.d: 采访贷款申请人以获取信息；调查申请人的背景并核实推荐信；准备贷款申请文件；并将调查结果、报告和文件转发给评估部门。审查贷款文件以确保完整性，并在贷款批准后完成贷款设立、借款人和卖方之间的交易。
jobs.de: Interview loan applicants to elicit information; investigate applicants' backgrounds and verify references; prepare loan request papers; and forward findings, reports, and documents to appraisal department. Review loan papers to ensure completeness, and complete transactions between loan establishment, borrowers, and sellers upon approval of loan.

jobs.d: 采访希望在金融机构开户的人员。向潜在客户解释可用的账户服务，并协助他们准备申请。
jobs.de: Interview persons desiring to open accounts in financial institutions. Explain account services available to prospective customers and assist them in preparing applications.

jobs.d: 接收和处理材料、商品、分类广告或维修、安装或设施租赁等服务的传入订单。通常通过邮件、电话、传真或其他电子方式接收订单。职责包括通知客户收货、价格、发货日期和延误情况；准备合同；并处理投诉。
jobs.de: Receive and process incoming orders for materials, merchandise, classified ads, or services such as repairs, installations, or rental of facilities. Generally receives orders via mail, phone, fax, or other electronic means. Duties include informing customers of receipt, prices, shipping dates, and delays; preparing contracts; and handling complaints.

jobs.t: 人力资源助理，工资和计时除外
jobs.d: 编制并保存人事记录。记录每位员工的数据，例如地址、每周收入、缺勤、销售或生产量、监督报告以及终止日期和原因。可以准备就业记录报告、归档就业记录，或搜索员工档案并向授权人员提供信息。
jobs.te: Human Resources Assistants, Except Payroll and Timekeeping
jobs.de: Compile and keep personnel records. Record data for each employee, such as address, weekly earnings, absences, amount of sales or production, supervisory reports, and date of and reason for termination. May prepare reports for employment records, file employment records, or search employee files and furnish information to authorized persons.

jobs.d: 回答询问并向公众、客户、访客和其他有关各方提供有关在组织内的部门、办公室和员工的机构和地点进行的活动的信息。
jobs.de: Answer inquiries and provide information to the general public, customers, visitors, and other interested parties regarding activities conducted at establishment and location of departments, offices, and employees within the organization.

jobs.t: 预订和交通票务代理和旅行文员
jobs.d: 预订并确认交通或住宿，或出售交通票。可以检查行李并引导乘客前往指定的大厅、码头或跑道；交付门票并联系个人和团体，告知他们有关旅行团的信息；或为游客提供旅行或交通信息。
jobs.te: Reservation and Transportation Ticket Agents and Travel Clerks
jobs.de: Make and confirm reservations for transportation or lodging, or sell transportation tickets. May check baggage and direct passengers to designated concourse, pier, or track; deliver tickets and contact individuals and groups to inform them of package tours; or provide tourists with travel or transportation information.

jobs.d: 在航空公司、火车、货运站和航运码头加快进出货物和货物的路线运输。接受客户订单并安排提货并将货物运送到装货平台。准备并检查提单以确定运费和关税。
jobs.de: Expedite and route movement of incoming and outgoing cargo and freight shipments in airline, train, and trucking terminals and shipping docks. Take orders from customers and arrange pickup of freight and cargo for delivery to loading platform. Prepare and examine bills of lading to determine shipping charges and tariffs.

jobs.d: 研究产品运输的费率、路线或运输方式。保持对影响国际货物运输的法规的认识。安排其他服务，例如仓储或内陆运输。
jobs.de: Research rates, routings, or modes of transport for shipment of products. Maintain awareness of regulations affecting the international movement of cargo. Make arrangements for additional services, such as storage or inland transportation.

jobs.d: 在机构内的办公室或部门之间拾取和递送消息、文件、包裹和其他物品，或者通过步行、自行车、摩托车、汽车或公共交通工具直接运送到其他企业。
jobs.de: Pick up and deliver messages, documents, packages, and other items between offices or departments within an establishment or directly to other business concerns, traveling by foot, bicycle, motorcycle, automobile, or public conveyance.

jobs.d: 操作电话、无线电或其他通信系统，以便在 9-1-1 公共安全应答点和紧急行动中心接收和传达紧急援助请求。从公众和其他来源获取有关犯罪、威胁、骚乱、恐怖主义行为、火灾、医疗紧急情况和其他公共安全事务的信息。可以协调并向执法和应急响应人员提供信息。可以根据需要访问敏感数据库和其他信息源。可以根据执法、消防或紧急医疗程序的知识和认证，向呼叫者提供额外的指示。
jobs.de: Operate telephone, radio, or other communication systems to receive and communicate requests for emergency assistance at 9-1-1 public safety answering points and emergency operations centers. Take information from the public and other sources regarding crimes, threats, disturbances, acts of terrorism, fires, medical emergencies, and other public safety matters. May coordinate and provide information to law enforcement and emergency response personnel. May access sensitive databases and other information sources as needed. May provide additional instructions to callers based on knowledge of and certification in law enforcement, fire, or emergency medical procedures.

jobs.t: 调度员，警察、消防和救护车除外
jobs.d: 安排和派遣工人、工作人员、设备或服务车辆，以运送材料、货物或乘客，或在营业地点外提供正常安装、服务或紧急维修。职责可能包括使用无线电、电话或计算机传输任务以及编制工作进度统计数据和报告。
jobs.te: Dispatchers, Except Police, Fire, and Ambulance
jobs.de: Schedule and dispatch workers, work crews, equipment, or service vehicles for conveyance of materials, freight, or passengers, or for normal installation, service, or emergency repairs rendered outside the place of business. Duties may include using radio, telephone, or computer to transmit assignments and compiling statistics and reports on work progress.

jobs.d: 读取电表并记录电力、燃气、水或蒸汽的消耗量。
jobs.de: Read meter and record consumption of electricity, gas, water, or steam.

jobs.d: 在美国邮政服务 (USPS) 邮局执行任何任务组合，例如接收信件和包裹；销售邮票和印花税票、明信片和贴邮票的信封；填写和出售汇票；将邮件放入邮架的鸽洞或袋子中；并检查邮件的邮资是否正确。包括 USPS 承包商雇用的邮政服务职员。
jobs.de: Perform any combination of tasks in a United States Postal Service (USPS) post office, such as receive letters and parcels; sell postage and revenue stamps, postal cards, and stamped envelopes; fill out and sell money orders; place mail in pigeon holes of mail rack or in bags; and examine mail for correct postage. Includes postal service clerks employed by USPS contractors.

jobs.d: 为美国邮政服务 (USPS) 分类和投递邮件。通过车辆或步行按照既定路线投递邮件。包括 USPS 承包商雇用的邮政服务邮递员。
jobs.de: Sort and deliver mail for the United States Postal Service (USPS). Deliver mail on established route by vehicle or on foot. Includes postal service mail carriers employed by USPS contractors.

jobs.t: 邮政服务邮件分拣机、处理器和处理机操作员
jobs.d: 准备传入和传出邮件以供美国邮政服务 (USPS) 分发。检查、分类和路由邮件。装载、操作、偶尔调整和修理邮件处理、分拣和取消机械。保存货件、邮袋和麻袋的记录，并履行与邮政服务中的邮件处理相关的其他职责。包括 USPS 承包商雇用的邮政服务邮件分拣员和处理员。
jobs.te: Postal Service Mail Sorters, Processors, and Processing Machine Operators
jobs.de: Prepare incoming and outgoing mail for distribution for the United States Postal Service (USPS). Examine, sort, and route mail. Load, operate, and occasionally adjust and repair mail processing, sorting, and canceling machinery. Keep records of shipments, pouches, and sacks, and perform other duties related to mail handling within the postal service. Includes postal service mail sorters and processors employed by USPS contractors.

jobs.d: 根据生产计划协调并加快企业部门内部或部门之间的工作和材料流动。职责包括审查和分发生产、工作和装运时间表；与部门主管商议确定工作进度和完成日期；编制有关工作进度、库存水平、成本和生产问题的报告。
jobs.de: Coordinate and expedite the flow of work and materials within or between departments of an establishment according to production schedule. Duties include reviewing and distributing production, work, and shipment schedules; conferring with department supervisors to determine progress of work and completion dates; and compiling reports on progress of work, inventory levels, costs, and production problems.

jobs.d: 验证并维护涉及库存的进出货物的记录。职责包括验证和记录传入的商品或材料以及安排产品的运输。可以准备装运物品。
jobs.de: Verify and maintain records on incoming and outgoing shipments involving inventory. Duties include verifying and recording incoming merchandise or material and arranging for the transportation of products. May prepare items for shipment.

jobs.t: 称重员、测量员、检查员和取样员、记录保存
jobs.d: 称重、测量和检查材料、供应品和设备，以保存相关记录。职责本质上主要是文书工作。包括收集和保存产品或材料样品的工作人员。
jobs.te: Weighers, Measurers, Checkers, and Samplers, Recordkeeping
jobs.de: Weigh, measure, and check materials, supplies, and equipment for the purpose of keeping relevant records. Duties are primarily clerical by nature. Includes workers who collect and keep record of samples of products or materials.

jobs.t: 执行秘书和行政行政助理
jobs.d: 通过开展研究、准备统计报告和处理信息请求以及执行日常管理职能（例如准备信件、接待来访者、安排电话会议和安排会议）提供高级行政支持。还可以培训和监督较低级别的文职人员。
jobs.te: Executive Secretaries and Executive Administrative Assistants
jobs.de: Provide high-level administrative support by conducting research, preparing statistical reports, and handling information requests, as well as performing routine administrative functions such as preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls, and scheduling meetings. May also train and supervise lower-level clerical staff.

jobs.d: 使用法律术语、程序和文件履行秘书职责。准备法律文件和信件，例如传票、投诉、动议和传票。还可以协助法律研究。
jobs.de: Perform secretarial duties using legal terminology, procedures, and documents. Prepare legal papers and correspondence, such as summonses, complaints, motions, and subpoenas. May also assist with legal research.

jobs.d: 利用医学术语和医院、诊所或实验室程序的特定知识履行秘书职责。职责可能包括安排预约、向患者开具账单，以及编制和记录病历、报告和信件。
jobs.de: Perform secretarial duties using specific knowledge of medical terminology and hospital, clinic, or laboratory procedures. Duties may include scheduling appointments, billing patients, and compiling and recording medical charts, reports, and correspondence.

jobs.t: 秘书和行政助理，法律、医疗和行政人员除外
jobs.d: 执行日常管理职能，例如起草信件、安排预约、组织和维护纸质和电子文件，或向呼叫者提供信息。
jobs.te: Secretaries and Administrative Assistants, Except Legal, Medical, and Executive
jobs.de: Perform routine administrative functions such as drafting correspondence, scheduling appointments, organizing and maintaining paper and electronic files, or providing information to callers.

jobs.d: 操作数据输入设备，例如键盘或照片合成穿孔器。职责可能包括验证数据和准备打印材料。
jobs.de: Operate data entry device, such as keyboard or photo composing perforator. Duties may include verifying data and preparing materials for printing.

jobs.d: 使用文字处理器、计算机或打字机从草稿、更正副本或录音中输入信件、报告、表格或其他材料。可以履行指定的其他文书职责。
jobs.de: Use word processor, computer, or typewriter to type letters, reports, forms, or other material from rough draft, corrected copy, or voice recording. May perform other clerical duties as assigned.

jobs.d: 使用计算机软件格式化打字稿和图形元素以生成可供出版的材料。
jobs.de: Format typescript and graphic elements using computer software to produce publication-ready material.

jobs.t: 保险索赔和保单处理文员
jobs.d: 处理新的保单、对现有保单的修改和索赔表。从保单持有人处获取信息，以验证索赔表、申请和相关文件以及公司记录信息的准确性和完整性。更新现有保单和公司记录，以反映保单持有人和保险公司代表要求的变更。
jobs.te: Insurance Claims and Policy Processing Clerks
jobs.de: Process new insurance policies, modifications to existing policies, and claims forms. Obtain information from policyholders to verify the accuracy and completeness of information on claims forms, applications and related documents, and company records. Update existing policies and company records to reflect changes requested by policyholders and insurance company representatives.

jobs.t: 邮件文员和邮件机器操作员，邮政服务除外
jobs.d: 准备传入和传出的邮件以供分发。为收到的邮件添加时间戳、打开、阅读、排序和路由；以及在外发邮件或包裹上写地址、密封、盖章、折叠、填充并贴上邮资。职责还可能包括保存必要的记录和填写的表格。
jobs.te: Mail Clerks and Mail Machine Operators, Except Postal Service
jobs.de: Prepare incoming and outgoing mail for distribution. Time-stamp, open, read, sort, and route incoming mail; and address, seal, stamp, fold, stuff, and affix postage to outgoing mail or packages. Duties may also include keeping necessary records and completed forms.

jobs.d: 履行的职责过于多样化，无法归类为任何特定的办公室文书职业，需要了解办公系统和程序。文书职责可根据各个机构的办公程序进行分配，可能包括接听电话、簿记、打字或文字处理、办公机器操作和归档的组合。
jobs.de: Perform duties too varied and diverse to be classified in any specific office clerical occupation, requiring knowledge of office systems and procedures. Clerical duties may be assigned in accordance with the office procedures of individual establishments and may include a combination of answering telephones, bookkeeping, typing or word processing, office machine operation, and filing.

jobs.t: 办公机器操作员，除了计算机
jobs.d: 操作一台或多台各种办公机器，例如复印机、照相机和复印机或其他办公机器。
jobs.de: Operate one or more of a variety of office machines, such as photocopying, photographic, and duplicating machines, or other office machines.

jobs.d: 阅读成绩单或校样类型设置，以检测并标记纠正任何语法、印刷或构图错误。不包括主要职责是编辑副本的工人。包括盲文校对员。
jobs.de: Read transcript or proof type setup to detect and mark for correction any grammatical, typographical, or compositional errors. Excludes workers whose primary duty is editing copy. Includes proofreaders of braille.

jobs.d: 根据统计公式编译和计算数据，用于统计研究。可以进行精算计算并编制图表和图表供精算师使用。包括精算职员。
jobs.de: Compile and compute data according to statistical formulas for use in statistical studies. May perform actuarial computations and compile charts and graphs for use by actuaries. Includes actuarial clerks.

jobs.d: 直接监督和协调农业、林业、水产养殖和相关工人的活动。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Farming, Fishing, and Forestry Workers
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of agricultural, forestry, aquacultural, and related workers.

jobs.d: 检查农产品、加工设备和设施以及鱼类和伐木作业，以确保遵守有关健康、质量和安全的法规和法律。
jobs.de: Inspect agricultural commodities, processing equipment, and facilities, and fish and logging operations, to ensure compliance with regulations and laws governing health, quality, and safety.

jobs.d: 根据家谱、特征和后代选择和饲养动物。可能需要人工授精技术和设备使用的知识。可能涉及保存发情、出生间隔或血统的记录。
jobs.de: Select and breed animals according to their genealogy, characteristics, and offspring. May require knowledge of artificial insemination techniques and equipment use. May involve keeping records on heats, birth intervals, or pedigree.

jobs.t: 分级员和分拣员、农产品
jobs.d: 按大小、重量、颜色或状况对未加工食品和其他农产品进行分级、分类或分类。
jobs.de: Grade, sort, or classify unprocessed food and other agricultural products by size, weight, color, or condition.

jobs.d: 驱动和控制设备以支持耕地等农业活动；种植、培育和收获农作物；喂养和放牧牲畜；或清除动物粪便。可以执行农作物打捆或干草捆扎等任务。可以操作固定设备执行收获后任务，例如脱壳​​、脱壳、脱粒和轧棉。
jobs.de: Drive and control equipment to support agricultural activities such as tilling soil; planting, cultivating, and harvesting crops; feeding and herding livestock; or removing animal waste. May perform tasks such as crop baling or hay bucking. May operate stationary equipment to perform post-harvest tasks such as husking, shelling, threshing, and ginning.

jobs.t: 农场工人和劳工、农作物、苗圃和温室
jobs.d: 手动种植、培育和收获蔬菜、水果、坚果、园艺特产和大田作物。使用手动工具，如铲子、抹刀、锄头、夯实器、修枝钩、剪刀和刀。职责可能包括耕地和施肥；移植、除草、间苗或修剪作物；使用杀虫剂；或清洁、分级、分类、包装和装载收获的产品。可以建造棚架、修理栅栏和农场建筑，或参与灌溉活动。
jobs.te: Farmworkers and Laborers, Crop, Nursery, and Greenhouse
jobs.de: Manually plant, cultivate, and harvest vegetables, fruits, nuts, horticultural specialties, and field crops. Use hand tools, such as shovels, trowels, hoes, tampers, pruning hooks, shears, and knives. Duties may include tilling soil and applying fertilizers; transplanting, weeding, thinning, or pruning crops; applying pesticides; or cleaning, grading, sorting, packing, and loading harvested products. May construct trellises, repair fences and farm buildings, or participate in irrigation activities.

jobs.t: 农场工人、农场、牧场和水产养殖动物
jobs.d: 照料活体农场、牧场、开放式牧场或水产养殖动物，其中可能包括牛、绵羊、猪、山羊、马和其他马科动物、家禽、兔子、有鳍鱼类、贝类和蜜蜂。照顾为动物产品而生产的动物，如肉、毛皮、毛皮、羽毛、蛋、奶和蜂蜜。职责可能包括喂养、浇水、放牧、放牧、挤奶、去势、烙印、去喙、称重、捕捉和装载动物。可以保存动物记录；检查动物以发现疾病和损伤；协助分娩；并酌情给予药物、疫苗接种或杀虫剂。可以清洁和维护动物饲养区域。包括从羊身上剪羊毛和在孵化场收集鸡蛋的工人。
jobs.te: Farmworkers, Farm, Ranch, and Aquacultural Animals
jobs.de: Attend to live farm, ranch, open range or aquacultural animals that may include cattle, sheep, swine, goats, horses and other equines, poultry, rabbits, finfish, shellfish, and bees. Attend to animals produced for animal products, such as meat, fur, skins, feathers, eggs, milk, and honey. Duties may include feeding, watering, herding, grazing, milking, castrating, branding, de-beaking, weighing, catching, and loading animals. May maintain records on animals; examine animals to detect diseases and injuries; assist in birth deliveries; and administer medications, vaccinations, or insecticides as appropriate. May clean and maintain animal housing areas. Includes workers who shear wool from sheep and collect eggs in hatcheries.

jobs.d: 狩猎、诱捕、捕捉或采集野生动物或水生动物和植物。可以使用网、陷阱或其他设备。可以将捕获物拖上船或其他船只。
jobs.de: Hunt, trap, catch, or gather wild animals or aquatic animals and plants. May use nets, traps, or other equipment. May haul catch onto ship or other vessel.

jobs.d: 在监督下，通过培育和运输幼苗等活动，从事开发、维护或保护森林、林地、林地、湿地和牧场等区域所需的体力劳动；防治对植物生命有害的昆虫、害虫和疾病；以及控制水、侵蚀和土壤淋滤的建筑结构。包括护林员助手、拔苗工、植树工和松草等非木材林业产品的采集工。
jobs.de: Under supervision, perform manual labor necessary to develop, maintain, or protect areas such as forests, forested areas, woodlands, wetlands, and rangelands through such activities as raising and transporting seedlings; combating insects, pests, and diseases harmful to plant life; and building structures to control water, erosion, and leaching of soil. Includes forester aides, seedling pullers, tree planters, and gatherers of nontimber forestry products such as pine straw.

jobs.d: 利用有关树木特性和切割技术的知识，使用斧头或电锯砍伐树木，以控制倒下方向并最大程度地减少树木损坏。
jobs.de: Use axes or chainsaws to fell trees using knowledge of tree characteristics and cutting techniques to control direction of fall and minimize tree damage.

jobs.d: 驾驶配备一种或多种配件（例如推土机铲刀、前剪、抓斗、伐木拱门、电缆绞车、吊装架或起重机吊臂）的伐木拖拉机或轮式车辆，以倒下的树；滑动、装载、卸载或堆放原木；或拉树桩或清除刷子。包括操作独立伐木机，例如木材削片机。
jobs.de: Drive logging tractor or wheeled vehicle equipped with one or more accessories, such as bulldozer blade, frontal shear, grapple, logging arch, cable winches, hoisting rack, or crane boom, to fell tree; to skid, load, unload, or stack logs; or to pull stumps or clear brush. Includes operating stand-alone logging machines, such as log chippers.

jobs.d: 在分拣场、磨坊、原木甲板或类似地点对原木进行分级或估计原木或纸浆木材的可销售含量或价值。检查原木是否有缺陷或测量原木以确定体积。
jobs.de: Grade logs or estimate the marketable content or value of logs or pulpwood in sorting yards, millpond, log deck, or similar locations. Inspect logs for defects or measure logs to determine volume.

jobs.t: 建筑行业和采掘工人的一线主管
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调建筑或采掘工人的活动。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Construction Trades and Extraction Workers
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of construction or extraction workers.

jobs.d: 指导工作人员安装住宅或商业太阳能光伏或热力系统。
jobs.de: Direct work crews installing residential or commercial solar photovoltaic or thermal systems.

jobs.d: 建造、组装、维护和修理固定式蒸汽锅炉和锅炉房辅助设备。按照蓝图对齐结构或板部分以组装锅炉框架水箱或桶。工作涉及使用手动和电动工具、铅锤、水平仪、楔子、卡爪或螺丝扣。协助测试组装好的容器。直接清洗锅炉和锅炉炉膛。检查和修理锅炉配件，如安全阀、调节器、自动控制机构、水柱和辅助机械。
jobs.de: Construct, assemble, maintain, and repair stationary steam boilers and boiler house auxiliaries. Align structures or plate sections to assemble boiler frame tanks or vats, following blueprints. Work involves use of hand and power tools, plumb bobs, levels, wedges, dogs, or turnbuckles. Assist in testing assembled vessels. Direct cleaning of boilers and boiler furnaces. Inspect and repair boiler fittings, such as safety valves, regulators, automatic-control mechanisms, water columns, and auxiliary machines.

jobs.d: 用砂浆和其他物质铺设和粘合建筑材料，如砖、结构瓦、混凝土块、煤渣块、玻璃块和赤土块，以建造或修理墙壁、隔断、拱门、下水道和其他结构。
jobs.de: Lay and bind building materials, such as brick, structural tile, concrete block, cinder block, glass block, and terra-cotta block, with mortar and other substances, to construct or repair walls, partitions, arches, sewers, and other structures.

jobs.d: 建造石头结构，如桥墩、墙壁和桥台。铺设人行道、路缘石或用于大桶、储罐和地板的特殊类型的砖石。
jobs.de: Build stone structures, such as piers, walls, and abutments. Lay walks, curbstones, or special types of masonry for vats, tanks, and floors.

jobs.d: 建造、架设、安装或修理由木材和类似材料（例如混凝土模板）制成的结构和固定装置；建筑框架，包括隔断、托梁、立柱和椽子；以及木楼梯、门窗框架和硬木地板。还可以安装橱柜、壁板、干墙以及棉絮或卷材隔热材料。包括在地下通道中建造门或格栅（通风墙或隔断）的格栅建造者。
jobs.de: Construct, erect, install, or repair structures and fixtures made of wood and comparable materials, such as concrete forms; building frameworks, including partitions, joists, studding, and rafters; and wood stairways, window and door frames, and hardwood floors. May also install cabinets, siding, drywall, and batt or roll insulation. Includes brattice builders who build doors or brattices (ventilation walls or partitions) in underground passageways.

jobs.d: 在地板上铺设和安装地毯卷或块。安装衬垫和装饰地板材料。
jobs.de: Lay and install carpet from rolls or blocks on floors. Install padding and trim flooring materials.

jobs.t: 地板层，地毯、木材和硬瓷砖除外
jobs.d: 在地板上应用减震、隔音或装饰性覆盖物的块、条或片。
jobs.te: Floor Layers, Except Carpet, Wood, and Hard Tiles
jobs.de: Apply blocks, strips, or sheets of shock-absorbing, sound-deadening, or decorative coverings to floors.

jobs.d: 使用地板刮刀和地板砂光机将木地板刮擦并打磨至光滑表面，并涂上面漆。
jobs.de: Scrape and sand wooden floors to smooth surfaces using floor scraper and floor sanding machine, and apply coats of finish.

jobs.d: 在墙壁、地板、天花板、台面和屋顶甲板上应用硬瓷砖、石头和类似材料。
jobs.de: Apply hard tile, stone, and comparable materials to walls, floors, ceilings, countertops, and roof decks.

jobs.t: 水泥泥瓦匠和混凝土整理工
jobs.d: 平滑使用各种手动和电动工具完成浇筑混凝土的表面，例如地板、人行道、人行道、道路或路缘石。对齐人行道、路缘或排水沟的表格；修补空隙；并使用锯切割伸缩缝。
jobs.de: Smooth and finish surfaces of poured concrete, such as floors, walks, sidewalks, roads, or curbs using a variety of hand and power tools. Align forms for sidewalks, curbs, or gutters; patch voids; and use saws to cut expansion joints.

jobs.d: 将水泥、沙子、颜料或大理石碎片的混合物涂在地板、楼梯和橱柜固定装置上，形成耐用和装饰性的表面。
jobs.de: Apply a mixture of cement, sand, pigment, or marble chips to floors, stairways, and cabinet fixtures to fashion durable and decorative surfaces.

jobs.d: 在建筑工地执行涉及体力劳动的任务。可以操作所有类型的手动和电动工具：空气锤、夯土机、水泥搅拌机、小型机械葫芦、勘测和测量设备以及各种其他设备和仪器。可以清理和准备场地、挖掘沟渠、设置支架支撑挖掘两侧、搭建脚手架以及清理瓦砾、碎片和其他废料。可以协助其他工艺工人。
jobs.de: Perform tasks involving physical labor at construction sites. May operate hand and power tools of all types: air hammers, earth tampers, cement mixers, small mechanical hoists, surveying and measuring equipment, and a variety of other equipment and instruments. May clean and prepare sites, dig trenches, set braces to support the sides of excavations, erect scaffolding, and clean up rubble, debris, and other waste materials. May assist other craft workers.

jobs.t: 铺路、铺面和捣固设备操作员
jobs.d: 操作用于将混凝土、沥青或其他材料施加到路基、停车场、机场跑道和滑行道上或用于夯实砾石、泥土或其他材料的设备。包括混凝土和沥青摊铺机操作员、模板夯实机操作员和石料撒布机操作员。
jobs.te: Paving, Surfacing, and Tamping Equipment Operators
jobs.de: Operate equipment used for applying concrete, asphalt, or other materials to road beds, parking lots, or airport runways and taxiways or for tamping gravel, dirt, or other materials. Includes concrete and asphalt paving machine operators, form tampers, tamping machine operators, and stone spreader operators.

jobs.d: 操作安装在滑橇、驳船、履带式履带或机车起重机上的打桩机，为挡土墙、舱壁以及建筑物、桥梁和码头等结构的基础打桩。
jobs.de: Operate pile drivers mounted on skids, barges, crawler treads, or locomotive cranes to drive pilings for retaining walls, bulkheads, and foundations of structures such as buildings, bridges, and piers.

jobs.t: 操作工程师和其他建筑设备操作员
jobs.d: 操作一种或多种类型的电力施工设备，例如平地机、推土机、铲运机、压缩机、泵、井架、铲子、拖拉机或前端装载机，用于挖掘、移动和平整土地、竖立结构或浇筑混凝土或其他硬表面路面。除了其他职责外，还可以修理和维护设备。
jobs.te: Operating Engineers and Other Construction Equipment Operators
jobs.de: Operate one or several types of power construction equipment, such as motor graders, bulldozers, scrapers, compressors, pumps, derricks, shovels, tractors, or front-end loaders to excavate, move, and grade earth, erect structures, or pour concrete or other hard surface pavement. May repair and maintain equipment in addition to other duties.

jobs.t: 干墙和天花板瓷砖安装工
jobs.d: 将石膏板或其他墙板应用于建筑物的天花板或内墙。将吸音砖或吸震材料块、条或片应用或安装到建筑物的天花板和墙壁上，以减少或反射声音。材料可能具有装饰性。包括将木制、金属或岩板板条固定到建筑物的墙壁、天花板或隔断上，为灰泥、防火或隔音材料提供支撑基础的起泡工。
jobs.de: Apply plasterboard or other wallboard to ceilings or interior walls of buildings. Apply or mount acoustical tiles or blocks, strips, or sheets of shock-absorbing materials to ceilings and walls of buildings to reduce or reflect sound. Materials may be of decorative quality. Includes lathers who fasten wooden, metal, or rockboard lath to walls, ceilings, or partitions of buildings to provide support base for plaster, fireproofing, or acoustical material.

jobs.d: 密封石膏板或其他墙板之间的接缝，为墙面涂漆或铺纸做好准备。
jobs.de: Seal joints between plasterboard or other wallboard to prepare wall surface for painting or papering.

jobs.d: 安装、维护和修理电线、设备和固定装置。确保工作符合相关规范。可以安装或维修路灯、对讲系统或电气控制系统。
jobs.de: Install, maintain, and repair electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures. Ensure that work is in accordance with relevant codes. May install or service street lights, intercom systems, or electrical control systems.

jobs.d: 在窗户、天窗、店面和展示柜上安装玻璃，或在建筑物正面、内墙、天花板和桌面等表面上安装玻璃。
jobs.de: Install glass in windows, skylights, store fronts, and display cases, or on surfaces, such as building fronts, interior walls, ceilings, and tabletops.

jobs.t: 绝缘工人、地板、天花板和墙壁
jobs.d: 用绝缘材料铺设和覆盖结构。可使用棉絮、卷材或吹制隔热材料。
jobs.te: Insulation Workers, Floor, Ceiling, and Wall
jobs.de: Line and cover structures with insulating materials. May work with batt, roll, or blown insulation materials.

jobs.d: 将隔热材料应用于管道或管道系统或其他机械系统，以帮助控制和维持温度。
jobs.de: Apply insulating materials to pipes or ductwork, or other mechanical systems in order to help control and maintain temperature.

jobs.d: 使用刷子、滚筒和喷枪粉刷墙壁、设备、建筑物、桥梁和其他结构表面。可以在涂漆前去除旧油漆以准备表面。可以混合颜色或油以获得所需的颜色或稠度。
jobs.de: Paint walls, equipment, buildings, bridges, and other structural surfaces, using brushes, rollers, and spray guns. May remove old paint to prepare surface prior to painting. May mix colors or oils to obtain desired color or consistency.

jobs.d: 用装饰性壁纸或织物覆盖房间的内墙或天花板，或在墙壁和广告牌等表面贴上广告海报。可以清除旧材料或准备要铺纸的表面。
jobs.de: Cover interior walls or ceilings of rooms with decorative wallpaper or fabric, or attach advertising posters on surfaces such as walls and billboards. May remove old materials or prepare surfaces to be papered.

jobs.d: 铺设暴雨或卫生下水道、排水管和总水管的管道。执行以下任务的任意组合：对沟渠或涵洞进行平整、定位管道或密封接头。
jobs.de: Lay pipe for storm or sanitation sewers, drains, and water mains. Perform any combination of the following tasks: grade trenches or culverts, position pipe, or seal joints.

jobs.t: 管道工、管道安装工和蒸汽安装工
jobs.d: 组装、安装、改造和修理输送水、蒸汽、空气或其他液体或气体的管道或管道系统。可安装加热和冷却设备以及机械控制系统。包括洒水装置安装工。
jobs.de: Assemble, install, alter, and repair pipelines or pipe systems that carry water, steam, air, or other liquids or gases. May install heating and cooling equipment and mechanical control systems. Includes sprinkler fitters.

jobs.t: 太阳能热安装工和技术人员
jobs.d: 安装或维修太阳能系统，旨在收集、储存和循环住宅、商业或工业用途的太阳能热水。
jobs.de: Install or repair solar energy systems designed to collect, store, and circulate solar-heated water for residential, commercial or industrial use.

jobs.d: 应用内部或外部灰泥、水泥、灰泥或类似材料。还可以设置装饰灰泥。
jobs.de: Apply interior or exterior plaster, cement, stucco, or similar materials. May also set ornamental plaster.

jobs.d: 在混凝土模板中定位并固定钢筋或网格，以加固混凝土。使用各种紧固件、弯杆机、喷灯和手动工具。包括杆破坏器。
jobs.de: Position and secure steel bars or mesh in concrete forms in order to reinforce concrete. Use a variety of fasteners, rod-bending machines, blowtorches, and hand tools. Includes rod busters.

jobs.d: 用木瓦、板岩、沥青、铝、木材或相关材料覆盖结构的屋顶。可以用材料喷涂屋顶、壁板和墙壁，以粘合、密封、绝缘或隔音结构部分。
jobs.de: Cover roofs of structures with shingles, slate, asphalt, aluminum, wood, or related materials. May spray roofs, sidings, and walls with material to bind, seal, insulate, or soundproof sections of structures.

jobs.d: 制造、组装、安装和修理钣金产品和设备，例如管道、控制箱、排水管和炉壳。工作可能涉及以下任何内容： 设置和操作制造机器来切割、弯曲和矫直金属板；使用锤子在砧座、块或模型上塑造金属形状；操作焊接设备连接钣金零件；或检查、组装和平滑毛刺表面的接缝和接头。包括安装用于供暖、空调或其他用途的预制钣金管道的钣金管道安装人员。
jobs.de: Fabricate, assemble, install, and repair sheet metal products and equipment, such as ducts, control boxes, drainpipes, and furnace casings. Work may involve any of the following: setting up and operating fabricating machines to cut, bend, and straighten sheet metal; shaping metal over anvils, blocks, or forms using hammer; operating soldering and welding equipment to join sheet metal parts; or inspecting, assembling, and smoothing seams and joints of burred surfaces. Includes sheet metal duct installers who install prefabricated sheet metal ducts used for heating, air conditioning, or other purposes.

jobs.d: 升高、放置和连接钢铁梁、柱和其他结构构件以形成完整的结构或结构框架。可以安装金属储罐并组装预制金属建筑。
jobs.de: Raise, place, and unite iron or steel girders, columns, and other structural members to form completed structures or structural frameworks. May erect metal storage tanks and assemble prefabricated metal buildings.

jobs.d: 根据现场评估和示意图在屋顶或其他结构上组装、安装或维护太阳能光伏 (PV) 系统。可能包括测量、切割、组装和用螺栓固定结构框架和太阳能模块。可以执行小型电气工作，例如电流检查。
jobs.de: Assemble, install, or maintain solar photovoltaic (PV) systems on roofs or other structures in compliance with site assessment and schematics. May include measuring, cutting, assembling, and bolting structural framing and solar modules. May perform minor electrical work such as current checks.

jobs.t: 助手--砖瓦工，砌块工、石匠以及瓷砖和大理石安装工
jobs.d: 帮助砖瓦匠、砌块匠、石匠或瓷砖和大理石安装工执行技能要求较低的职责。职责包括使用、供应或持有材料或工具，以及清洁工作区域和设备。
jobs.te: Helpers--Brickmasons, Blockmasons, Stonemasons, and Tile and Marble Setters
jobs.de: Help brickmasons, blockmasons, stonemasons, or tile and marble setters by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

jobs.d: 通过执行需要较少技能的任务来帮助木匠。职责包括使用、供应或持有材料或工具，以及清洁工作区域和设备。
jobs.de: Help carpenters by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

jobs.d: 帮助电工履行技能要求较低的职责。职责包括使用、供应或保存材料或工具，以及清洁工作区域和设备。
jobs.de: Help electricians by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

jobs.t: Helpers--油漆工、裱纸工、抹灰工和粉刷工
jobs.d: 帮助油漆工、裱纸工、抹灰工或灰泥泥瓦匠履行技能要求较低的职责。职责包括使用、供应或持有材料或工具，以及清洁工作区域和设备。
jobs.te: Helpers--Painters, Paperhangers, Plasterers, and Stucco Masons
jobs.de: Help painters, paperhangers, plasterers, or stucco masons by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

jobs.t: Helpers--铺管工、水管工、管道安装工和Steamfitters
jobs.d: 帮助管道工、管道安装工、蒸汽安装工或管道铺设工履行技能要求较低的职责。职责包括使用、供应或持有材料或工具，以及清洁工作区域和设备。
jobs.de: Help plumbers, pipefitters, steamfitters, or pipelayers by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

jobs.d: 帮助屋顶工履行需要较少技能的职责。职责包括使用、供应或持有材料或工具，以及清洁工作区域和设备。
jobs.de: Help roofers by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

jobs.d: 使用工程技能检查结构，以确定结构的健全性以及是否符合规范、建筑规范和其他法规。检查可能是一般性的，也可能仅限于特定区域，例如电气系统或管道系统。
jobs.de: Inspect structures using engineering skills to determine structural soundness and compliance with specifications, building codes, and other regulations. Inspections may be general in nature or may be limited to a specific area, such as electrical systems or plumbing.

jobs.d: 对建筑物​​、建筑系统或过程系统进行能源审计。还可以对建筑物或系统进行投资级审核。
jobs.de: Conduct energy audits of buildings, building systems, or process systems. May also conduct investment grade audits of buildings or systems.

jobs.t: 电梯和自动扶梯安装和维修工
jobs.d: 组装、安装、维修或维护电动或液压货运或客运电梯、自动扶梯或杂物电梯。
jobs.te: Elevator and Escalator Installers and Repairers
jobs.de: Assemble, install, repair, or maintain electric or hydraulic freight or passenger elevators, escalators, or dumbwaiters.

jobs.d: 使用手动和电动工具安装和维修栅栏和栅栏门。
jobs.de: Erect and repair fences and fence gates, using hand and power tools.

jobs.d: 识别、清除、包装、运输或处置危险材料，包括石棉、含铅油漆、废油、燃料、传动液、放射性材料或污染物土壤。通常需要危险材料处理方面的专门培训和认证或密闭进入许可证。可以操作土方设备或卡车。
jobs.de: Identify, remove, pack, transport, or dispose of hazardous materials, including asbestos, lead-based paint, waste oil, fuel, transmission fluid, radioactive materials, or contaminated soil. Specialized training and certification in hazardous materials handling or a confined entry permit are generally required. May operate earth-moving equipment or trucks.

jobs.d: 维护高速公路、市政和乡村道路、机场跑道和通行权。职责包括修补破损或侵蚀的路面以及修复护栏、高速公路标记和雪栅栏。还可以修剪或清除道路沿线的灌木丛，或犁除道路上的积雪。
jobs.de: Maintain highways, municipal and rural roads, airport runways, and rights-of-way. Duties include patching broken or eroded pavement and repairing guard rails, highway markers, and snow fences. May also mow or clear brush from along road, or plow snow from roadway.

jobs.t: 铁轨铺设和维护设备操作员
jobs.d: 为常规铁路服务或厂场、采石场、沙石坑和矿山中使用的标准或窄轨铁路设备铺设、维修和维护轨道。包括道碴清理机操作员和路床捣固机操作员。
jobs.te: Rail-Track Laying and Maintenance Equipment Operators
jobs.de: Lay, repair, and maintain track for standard or narrow-gauge railroad equipment used in regular railroad service or in plant yards, quarries, sand and gravel pits, and mines. Includes ballast cleaning machine operators and railroad bed tamping machine operators.

jobs.t: 化粪池处理工和下水道管道清洁工
jobs.d: 清洁和修理化粪池、下水道或排水沟。可以修补水箱的墙壁和隔板，更换损坏的排水瓦，或修复地下管道的破损处。
jobs.te: Septic Tank Servicers and Sewer Pipe Cleaners
jobs.de: Clean and repair septic tanks, sewer lines, or drains. May patch walls and partitions of tank, replace damaged drain tile, or repair breaks in underground piping.

jobs.d: 布置、切割和放置分段铺路单元。包括铺路单元的垫层和约束材料的安装人员。
jobs.de: Lay out, cut, and place segmental paving units. Includes installers of bedding and restraining materials for the paving units.

jobs.t: 防风化安装人员和技术人员
jobs.d: 进行各种活动，使房屋能够适应气候并提高能源效率。职责包括修理窗户、绝缘管道以及进行供暖、通风和空调 (HVAC) 工作。可以进行能源审计并就节能措施向客户提供建议。
jobs.de: Perform a variety of activities to weatherize homes and make them more energy efficient. Duties include repairing windows, insulating ducts, and performing heating, ventilating, and air-conditioning (HVAC) work. May perform energy audits and advise clients on energy conservation measures.

jobs.t: 井架操作员，石油和天然气
jobs.d: 钻机井架设备并操作泵，使泥浆或流体通过钻孔循环。
jobs.de: Rig derrick equipment and operate pumps to circulate mud or fluid through drill hole.

jobs.t: 旋转钻机操作员，石油和天然气
jobs.d: 设置或操作各种钻机以清除地下石油和天然气，或在石油和天然气勘探过程中取出岩心样本进行测试。
jobs.te: Rotary Drill Operators, Oil and Gas
jobs.de: Set up or operate a variety of drills to remove underground oil and gas, or remove core samples for testing during oil and gas exploration.

jobs.t: 服务单元操作员，石油和天然气
jobs.d: 操作设备以增加生产井的石油流量或清除钻井中卡住的管道、套管、工具或其他障碍物。包括打捞工具技术人员。
jobs.te: Service Unit Operators, Oil and Gas
jobs.de: Operate equipment to increase oil flow from producing wells or to remove stuck pipe, casing, tools, or other obstructions from drilling wells. Includes fishing-tool technicians.

jobs.t: 挖掘和装载机及拉斗铲操作员、露天采矿
jobs.d: 在露天采矿现场操作或维护机械，配备铲子、铲子或铲斗来挖掘和装载松散材料。
jobs.te: Excavating and Loading Machine and Dragline Operators, Surface Mining
jobs.de: Operate or tend machinery at surface mining site, equipped with scoops, shovels, or buckets to excavate and load loose materials.

jobs.d: 操作各种钻机，例如旋转式、搅拌式和气动式钻机，以挖掘地下水和盐矿床，在矿产勘探或土壤测试过程中取出岩心样本，并促进在采矿或建筑中使用炸药。包括卧式钻机和钻地机操作员。
jobs.te: Earth Drillers, Except Oil and Gas
jobs.de: Operate a variety of drills such as rotary, churn, and pneumatic to tap subsurface water and salt deposits, to remove core samples during mineral exploration or soil testing, and to facilitate the use of explosives in mining or construction. Includes horizontal and earth boring machine operators.

jobs.t: 爆炸物工人、军械处理专家和爆破工
jobs.d: 放置并引爆炸药以拆除结构或松动、移除或移动泥土、岩石或其他材料。可以执行专门的处理、存储和会计程序。
jobs.te: Explosives Workers, Ordnance Handling Experts, and Blasters
jobs.de: Place and detonate explosives to demolish structures or to loosen, remove, or displace earth, rock, or other materials. May perform specialized handling, storage, and accounting procedures.

jobs.d: 操作自走式采矿机，从矿井工作面剥离煤炭、金属和非金属矿石、岩石、石头或沙子，并将其连续装载到输送机、穿梭车或卡车上。
jobs.de: Operate self-propelled mining machines that rip coal, metal and nonmetal ores, rock, stone, or sand from the mine face and load it onto conveyors, shuttle cars, or trucks in a continuous operation.

jobs.d: 操作机械在地下矿井中安装顶板支撑螺栓。
jobs.de: Operate machinery to install roof support bolts in underground mine.

jobs.t: 装载和移动机器操作员、地下采矿
jobs.d: 操作地下装载或移动机器，使用穿梭机、矿车或输送机装载或移动煤炭、矿石或岩石。设备可能包括电铲、配备电缆牵引刮刀或铲斗的提升发动机，或配备集料臂和输送机的机器。
jobs.te: Loading and Moving Machine Operators, Underground Mining
jobs.de: Operate underground loading or moving machine to load or move coal, ore, or rock using shuttle or mine car or conveyors. Equipment may include power shovels, hoisting engines equipped with cable-drawn scraper or scoop, or machines equipped with gathering arms and conveyor.

jobs.d: 使用手提钻、楔子或切锯从采石场中分离出粗糙尺寸的石块。
jobs.de: Separate blocks of rough dimension stone from quarry mass using jackhammers, wedges, or chop saws.

jobs.d: 使用手动和电动工具组装或修理油田设备。根据需要执行其他任务。
jobs.de: Assemble or repair oil field equipment using hand and power tools. Perform other tasks as needed.

jobs.d: 通过执行技能要求较低的任务，帮助采掘工艺工人，例如钻土工、爆破工和炸药工人、井架操作员和采矿机操作员。职责包括提供设备或清洁工作区域。
jobs.de: Help extraction craft workers, such as earth drillers, blasters and explosives workers, derrick operators, and mining machine operators, by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include supplying equipment or cleaning work area.

jobs.t: 机械师、安装人员和维修人员的一线主管
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调机械师、安装人员和维修人员的活动。还可以向客户提供推荐服务的建议。不包括团队或工作领导。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Mechanics, Installers, and Repairers
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of mechanics, installers, and repairers. May also advise customers on recommended services. Excludes team or work leaders.

jobs.t: 计算机、自动柜员机和办公机器维修人员
jobs.d: 修理、维护或安装计算机、文字处理系统、自动柜员机和电子办公机器，例如复印机和传真机。
jobs.te: Computer, Automated Teller, and Office Machine Repairers
jobs.de: Repair, maintain, or install computers, word processing systems, automated teller machines, and electronic office machines, such as duplicating and fax machines.

jobs.t: 无线电、蜂窝和塔式设备安装和维修人员
jobs.d: 修理、安装或维护移动或固定无线电发射、广播和接收设备，以及用于蜂窝电信、移动宽带、船对岸、飞机对地通信以及服务和紧急车辆中的无线电设备的双向无线电通信系统。可以测试和分析网络覆盖范围。
jobs.te: Radio, Cellular, and Tower Equipment Installers and Repairers
jobs.de: Repair, install, or maintain mobile or stationary radio transmitting, broadcasting, and receiving equipment, and two-way radio communications systems used in cellular telecommunications, mobile broadband, ship-to-shore, aircraft-to-ground communications, and radio equipment in service and emergency vehicles. May test and analyze network coverage.

jobs.t: 电信设备安装和维修人员（线路除外）安装人员
jobs.d: 安装、设置、重新布置或移除中心局或头端中使用的交换、分配、路由和拨号设备。服务或修理客户财产上的电话、有线电视、互联网和其他通信设备。可以在建筑物内安装通信设备或通信线路。
jobs.te: Telecommunications Equipment Installers and Repairers, Except Line Installers
jobs.de: Install, set up, rearrange, or remove switching, distribution, routing, and dialing equipment used in central offices or headends. Service or repair telephone, cable television, Internet, and other communications equipment on customers' property. May install communications equipment or communications wiring in buildings.

jobs.d: 安装、检查、测试、调整或维修航空电子设备，例如飞机或航天器中的雷达、无线电、导航和导弹控制系统。
jobs.de: Install, inspect, test, adjust, or repair avionics equipment, such as radar, radio, navigation, and missile control systems in aircraft or space vehicles.

jobs.t: 电机、电动工具及相关维修人员
jobs.d: 维修、维护或安装电动机、线路或开关。
jobs.te: Electric Motor, Power Tool, and Related Repairers
jobs.de: Repair, maintain, or install electric motors, wiring, or switches.

jobs.t: 电气和电子安装人员和维修人员、运输设备
jobs.d: 安装、调整或维护移动电子通信设备，包括火车、船只或其他移动设备上的声音、声纳、安全、导航和监视系统设备。
jobs.te: Electrical and Electronics Installers and Repairers, Transportation Equipment
jobs.de: Install, adjust, or maintain mobile electronics communication equipment, including sound, sonar, security, navigation, and surveillance systems on trains, watercraft, or other mobile equipment.

jobs.t: 电气和电子维修人员、商业和工业设备
jobs.d: 修理、测试、调整或安装电子设备，例如工业控制装置、发射机和天线。
jobs.te: Electrical and Electronics Repairers, Commercial and Industrial Equipment
jobs.de: Repair, test, adjust, or install electronic equipment, such as industrial controls, transmitters, and antennas.

jobs.t: 电气和电子维修人员、发电厂、变电站和继电器
jobs.d: 检查、测试、修理或维护发电站、变电站和在役继电器中的电气设备。
jobs.te: Electrical and Electronics Repairers, Powerhouse, Substation, and Relay
jobs.de: Inspect, test, repair, or maintain electrical equipment in generating stations, substations, and in-service relays.

jobs.t: 电子设备安装和维修人员、电机车辆
jobs.d: 安装、诊断或修理机动车辆中的通信、声音、安全或导航设备。
jobs.te: Electronic Equipment Installers and Repairers, Motor Vehicles
jobs.de: Install, diagnose, or repair communications, sound, security, or navigation equipment in motor vehicles.

jobs.t: 视听设备安装和维修人员
jobs.d: 安装、修理或调整音频或电视接收器、立体声系统、摄像机、视频系统或家庭或其他场所的其他电子娱乐设备。可以执行日常维护。
jobs.de: Install, repair, or adjust audio or television receivers, stereo systems, camcorders, video systems, or other electronic entertainment equipment in homes or other venues. May perform routine maintenance.

jobs.t: 安全和火灾报警系统安装人员
jobs.d: 安装、编程、维护和修理安全和火灾报警线路和设备。确保工作符合相关规范。
jobs.te: Security and Fire Alarm Systems Installers

jobs.de: Diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul aircraft engines and assemblies, such as hydraulic and pneumatic systems.

jobs.de: Repair and refinish automotive vehicle bodies and straighten vehicle frames.

jobs.t: 汽车玻璃安装和维修人员

jobs.de: Replace or repair broken windshields and window glass in motor vehicles.

jobs.t: 汽车服务技术人员和机械师

jobs.te: Bus and Truck Mechanics and Diesel Engine Specialists

jobs.te: Farm Equipment Mechanics and Service Technicians

jobs.t: 移动重型设备机械师，发动机除外
jobs.d: 诊断、调整、修理或检修移动机械、液压和气动设备，例如建筑、伐木和采矿中使用的起重机、推土机、平地机和输送机。
jobs.te: Mobile Heavy Equipment Mechanics, Except Engines
jobs.de: Diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul mobile mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic equipment, such as cranes, bulldozers, graders, and conveyors, used in construction, logging, and mining.

jobs.d: 诊断、调整、修理或大修铁路机车车辆、矿车或公共交通轨道车辆。
jobs.de: Diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul railroad rolling stock, mine cars, or mass transit rail cars.

jobs.t: 摩托艇机械师和服务技术人员
jobs.d: 修理和调整舷内或舷内-舷外船舶发动机的电气和机械设备。
jobs.de: Repair and adjust electrical and mechanical equipment of inboard or inboard-outboard boat engines.

jobs.d: 诊断、调整、修理或检修摩托车、踏板车、轻便摩托车、越野车或类似机动车辆。
jobs.de: Diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul motorcycles, scooters, mopeds, dirt bikes, or similar motorized vehicles.

jobs.t: 户外动力设备和其他小型发动机机械师
jobs.d: 诊断、调整、修理或检修用于为割草机、链锯、休闲运动设备和相关设备提供动力的小型发动机。
jobs.te: Outdoor Power Equipment and Other Small Engine Mechanics
jobs.de: Diagnose, adjust, repair, or overhaul small engines used to power lawn mowers, chain saws, recreational sporting equipment, and related equipment.

jobs.d: 修理和服务自行车。
jobs.de: Repair and service bicycles.

jobs.d: 诊断、检查、调整、修理或检修休闲车辆，包括旅行拖车。可能专门从事维护燃气、电力、液压、管道或底盘/牵引系统以及修理发电机、电器和内部部件。包括进行定制货车改装的工人。
jobs.de: Diagnose, inspect, adjust, repair, or overhaul recreational vehicles including travel trailers. May specialize in maintaining gas, electrical, hydraulic, plumbing, or chassis/towing systems as well as repairing generators, appliances, and interior components. Includes workers who perform customized van conversions.

jobs.d: 修理和更换轮胎。
jobs.de: Repair and replace tires.

jobs.d: 安装、维护或修理自动门装置和液压门。包括车库门机械。
jobs.de: Install, service, or repair automatic door mechanisms and hydraulic doors. Includes garage door mechanics.

jobs.t: 控制和阀门安装工和维修工，机械门除外
jobs.d: 安装、维修和维护机械调节和控制装置，如电表、燃气调节器、恒温器、安全和流量阀以及其他机械调速器。
jobs.te: Control and Valve Installers and Repairers, Except Mechanical Door
jobs.de: Install, repair, and maintain mechanical regulating and controlling devices, such as electric meters, gas regulators, thermostats, safety and flow valves, and other mechanical governors.

jobs.t: 供暖、空调和制冷机械师和安装工
jobs.d: 安装或维修供暖、中央空调、HVAC 或制冷系统，包括燃油燃烧器、热风炉和采暖炉。
jobs.te: Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers
jobs.de: Install or repair heating, central air conditioning, HVAC, or refrigeration systems, including oil burners, hot-air furnaces, and heating stoves.

jobs.d: 维修、调整或安装所有类型的电动或燃气家用电器，如冰箱、洗衣机、烘干机和烤箱。
jobs.de: Repair, adjust, or install all types of electric or gas household appliances, such as refrigerators, washers, dryers, and ovens.

jobs.d: 修理、安装、调整或维护工业生产和加工机械或炼油厂和管道分配系统。还可以根据计划安装、拆卸或移动机械和重型设备。
jobs.de: Repair, install, adjust, or maintain industrial production and processing machinery or refinery and pipeline distribution systems. May also install, dismantle, or move machinery and heavy equipment according to plans.

jobs.d: 润滑机械、更换零件或进行其他日常机械维护。
jobs.de: Lubricate machinery, change parts, or perform other routine machinery maintenance.

jobs.d: 根据布局图、蓝图或其他图纸安装、拆卸或移动机械和重型设备。
jobs.de: Install, dismantle, or move machinery and heavy equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, or other drawings.

jobs.t: 耐火材料修理工，砖瓦匠除外
jobs.d: 使用耐火材料建造或修理熔炉、窑炉、冲天炉、锅炉、转炉、钢包、均热坑和烤炉等设备材料。
jobs.de: Build or repair equipment such as furnaces, kilns, cupolas, boilers, converters, ladles, soaking pits, and ovens, using refractory materials.

jobs.t: 电力线路安装工和修理工
jobs.d: 安装或维修电力或配电系统中使用的电缆或电线。可以架设电线杆和轻型或重型输电塔。
jobs.de: Install or repair cables or wires used in electrical power or distribution systems. May erect poles and light or heavy duty transmission towers.

jobs.t: 电信线路安装工和修理工
jobs.d: 安装和维修电信电缆，包括光纤。
jobs.de: Install and repair telecommunications cable, including fiber optics.

jobs.t: 相机和摄影设备修理工
jobs.d: 维修和调整相机和摄影设备，包括商业视频和电影摄像设备。
jobs.de: Repair and adjust cameras and photographic equipment, including commercial video and motion picture camera equipment.

jobs.d: 测试、调整或维修生物医学或电子医疗设备。
jobs.de: Test, adjust, or repair biomedical or electromedical equipment.

jobs.d: 维修打击乐器、弦乐器、簧片乐器或管乐器。可能专注于某一领域，例如钢琴调音。
jobs.de: Repair percussion, stringed, reed, or wind instruments. May specialize in one area, such as piano tuning.

jobs.d: 修理、清洁和调整计时仪器（例如钟表）的机构。包括钟表匠、钟表技师和机械钟表修理工。
jobs.de: Repair, clean, and adjust mechanisms of timing instruments, such as watches and clocks. Includes watchmakers, watch technicians, and mechanical timepiece repairers.

jobs.d: 从事涉及两种或多种维护或工艺职业技能的工作，以保持机器、机械设备或建筑物结构的维修。职责可能涉及管道安装；暖通空调维护；绝缘；焊接;加工;木工；修理电气或机械设备；安装、对准和平衡新设备；以及修理建筑物、地板或楼梯。
jobs.de: Perform work involving the skills of two or more maintenance or craft occupations to keep machines, mechanical equipment, or the structure of a building in repair. Duties may involve pipe fitting; HVAC maintenance; insulating; welding; machining; carpentry; repairing electrical or mechanical equipment; installing, aligning, and balancing new equipment; and repairing buildings, floors, or stairs.

jobs.t: 风电涡轮机服务技术人员
jobs.d: 检查、诊断、调整或修理风力涡轮机。对风力涡轮机设备进行维护，包括解决电气、机械和液压故障。
jobs.de: Inspect, diagnose, adjust, or repair wind turbines. Perform maintenance on wind turbine equipment including resolving electrical, mechanical, and hydraulic malfunctions.

jobs.t: 硬币、自动售货机和游乐机服务商和维修人员
jobs.d: 安装、保养、调整或修理投币机、自动售货机或游艺机，包括视频游戏、自动点唱机、弹球机或老虎机。
jobs.te: Coin, Vending, and Amusement Machine Servicers and Repairers
jobs.de: Install, service, adjust, or repair coin, vending, or amusement machines including video games, juke boxes, pinball machines, or slot machines.

jobs.d: 在水面以下工作，使用水面供气或水肺设备检查、修理、拆除或安装设备和结构。可能使用各种电动和手动工具，例如钻头、大锤、手电筒和焊接设备。可以进行测试或实验、安装炸药或拍摄建筑物或海洋生物。
jobs.de: Work below surface of water, using surface-supplied air or scuba equipment to inspect, repair, remove, or install equipment and structures. May use a variety of power and hand tools, such as drills, sledgehammers, torches, and welding equipment. May conduct tests or experiments, rig explosives, or photograph structures or marine life.

jobs.d: 修理和开锁、制作钥匙、更换锁和保险柜组合，以及安装和修理保险箱。
jobs.de: Repair and open locks, make keys, change locks and safe combinations, and install and repair safes.

jobs.t: 制造建筑和移动房屋安装人员

jobs.te: Manufactured Building and Mobile Home Installers
jobs.de: Move or install mobile homes or prefabricated buildings.

jobs.d: 为建筑项目、制造厂、伐木场、船舶和造船厂或娱乐业设置或修理索具。
jobs.de: Set up or repair rigging for construction projects, manufacturing plants, logging yards, ships and shipyards, or for the entertainment industry.

jobs.t: 信号和轨道开关维修人员

jobs.de: Install, inspect, test, maintain, or repair electric gate crossings, signals, signal equipment, track switches, section lines, or intercommunications systems within a railroad system.

jobs.t: 助手--安装、维护和维修工人
jobs.d: 帮助安装、维护和修理工人进行车辆、工业机械和电气和电子设备的维护、零件更换和修理。履行职责，例如向其他工人提供工具、材料和用品；清洁工作区域、机器和工具；并为其他工人保存材料或工具。
jobs.de: Help installation, maintenance, and repair workers in maintenance, parts replacement, and repair of vehicles, industrial machinery, and electrical and electronic equipment. Perform duties such as furnishing tools, materials, and supplies to other workers; cleaning work area, machines, and tools; and holding materials or tools for other workers.

jobs.d: 在发电厂或个别装置中进行地热能源发电所需的技术活动。监视和控制地热发电设施的运行活动，并根据需要进行维护和维修。安装、测试和维护住宅和商业地热热泵。
jobs.de: Perform technical activities at power plants or individual installations necessary for the generation of power from geothermal energy sources. Monitor and control operating activities at geothermal power generation facilities and perform maintenance and repairs as necessary. Install, test, and maintain residential and commercial geothermal heat pumps.

jobs.d: 直接监督和协调生产和操作工人的活动，例如检查员、精密工人、机器设置员和操作员、装配员、制造商以及工厂和系统操作员。不包括团队或工作领导者。

jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of production and operating workers, such as inspectors, precision workers, machine setters and operators, assemblers, fabricators, and plant and system operators. Excludes team or work leaders.

jobs.t: 飞机结构、表面、索具和系统装配工

jobs.te: Aircraft Structure, Surfaces, Rigging, and Systems Assemblers

jobs.t: 绕线机、卷锥机和精加工工
jobs.d: 用于电气元件（例如电阻器和变压器）以及电气设备和仪器（例如励磁芯、线轴、电枢）的绕组线核心、电动机、发电机和控制设备。
jobs.de: Wind wire coils used in electrical components, such as resistors and transformers, and in electrical equipment and instruments, such as field cores, bobbins, armature cores, electrical motors, generators, and control equipment.

jobs.t: 电气和电子设备装配工

jobs.de: Assemble or modify electrical or electronic equipment, such as computers, test equipment telemetering systems, electric motors, and batteries.

jobs.de: Assemble or modify electromechanical equipment or devices, such as servomechanisms, gyros, dynamometers, magnetic drums, tape drives, brakes, control linkage, actuators, and appliances.

jobs.de: Fabricate, position, align, and fit parts of structural metal products.

jobs.t: 玻璃纤维层压工和制造工

jobs.de: Laminate layers of fiberglass on molds to form boat decks and hulls, bodies for golf carts, automobiles, or other products.

jobs.t: 计时装置装配工和调节工

jobs.de: Perform precision assembling or adjusting, within narrow tolerances, of timing devices such as digital clocks or timing devices with electrical or electronic components.

jobs.d: 作为团队的一部分工作，负责组装整个产品或产品的组件。团队装配人员可以执行团队在装配过程中执行的所有任务，并轮流执行全部或大部分任务，而不是永久分配到特定任务。可能参与影响工作的管理决策。包括作为团队成员工作的团队领导。

Team assemblers can perform all tasks conducted by the team in the assembly process and rotate through all or most of them, rather than being assigned to a specific task on a permanent basis. May participate in making management decisions affecting the work. Includes team leaders who work as part of the team.

jobs.d: 混合和烘焙原料，生产面包、面包卷、饼干、蛋糕、馅饼、糕点或其他烘焙食品。
jobs.de: Mix and bake ingredients to produce breads, rolls, cookies, cakes, pies, pastries, or other baked goods.

jobs.d: 切割、修剪或准备消费者大小的肉类，以便在零售场所使用或销售。
jobs.de: Cut, trim, or prepare consumer-sized portions of meat for use or sale in retail establishments.

jobs.t: 肉类、家禽和鱼类切割工和修剪工

jobs.te: Meat, Poultry, and Fish Cutters and Trimmers
jobs.de: Use hands or hand tools to perform routine cutting and trimming of meat, poultry, and seafood.

jobs.d: 执行涉及以下方面的非常规或精确功能：准备大份的肉。工作可能包括专门的屠宰任务、切割用于营销的标准或优质肉类、制作香肠或包装肉类。工作通常发生在屠宰、肉类包装或批发场所。
jobs.de: Perform nonroutine or precision functions involving the preparation of large portions of meat. Work may include specialized slaughtering tasks, cutting standard or premium cuts of meat for marketing, making sausage, or wrapping meats. Work typically occurs in slaughtering, meat packing, or wholesale establishments.

jobs.t: 食品和烟草烘烤、烘焙和干燥机操作员和投标人

jobs.te: Food and Tobacco Roasting, Baking, and Drying Machine Operators and Tenders
jobs.de: Operate or tend food or tobacco roasting, baking, or drying equipment, including hearth ovens, kiln driers, roasters, char kilns, and vacuum drying equipment.

jobs.d: 设置和操作用于混合或混合食品制造中使用的成分的设备。包括糖果制造商和奶酪制造商。
jobs.de: Set up and operate equipment that mixes or blends ingredients used in the manufacturing of food products. Includes candy makers and cheese makers.

jobs.t: 食品烹饪机操作员和投标人
