jobs.te: Food Cooking Machine Operators and Tenders
jobs.de: Operate or tend cooking equipment, such as steam cooking vats, deep fry cookers, pressure cookers, kettles, and boilers, to prepare food products.

jobs.t: 挤压和拉拔机安装工、操作员和投标人、金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护机器，将热塑性或金属材料挤压或拉制成管、棒、软管、线材、棒材或结构形状。
jobs.te: Extruding and Drawing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend machines to extrude or draw thermoplastic or metal materials into tubes, rods, hoses, wire, bars, or structural shapes.

jobs.t: 锻造机安装工、操作员、金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护锻造机，以形成金属或塑料零件的锥度、形状或成形。
jobs.te: Forging Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend forging machines to taper, shape, or form metal or plastic parts.

jobs.t: 滚压机安装工、操作员和投标人，金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护机器，以滚压钢或塑料形成弯头、珠子、滚花、卷或板，或压平、回火或减小规格材料。
jobs.te: Rolling Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend machines to roll steel or plastic forming bends, beads, knurls, rolls, or plate, or to flatten, temper, or reduce gauge of material.

jobs.t: 切割、冲孔和冲压机安装工、操作员和投标人，金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护机器，以锯切、剪切、切缝、打孔、卷曲、开槽、弯曲或矫直金属或塑料材料。
jobs.te: Cutting, Punching, and Press Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend machines to saw, cut, shear, slit, punch, crimp, notch, bend, or straighten metal or plastic material.

jobs.t: 钻孔和镗孔机床安装工、操作员和投标人，金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护钻机，以在金属或塑料工件上钻孔、钻孔、铰孔、铣削或埋头孔。
jobs.te: Drilling and Boring Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend drilling machines to drill, bore, ream, mill, or countersink metal or plastic work pieces.

jobs.t: 磨削、研磨、抛光和抛光机床安装工、操作员，和招标，金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护磨削及相关工具，以去除表面上多余的材料或毛刺、锐化边缘或拐角或抛光、磨削或抛光金属或塑料工件。
jobs.te: Grinding, Lapping, Polishing, and Buffing Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend grinding and related tools that remove excess material or burrs from surfaces, sharpen edges or corners, or buff, hone, or polish metal or plastic work pieces.

jobs.t: 车床和车床工具安装工、操作员和投标人，金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护车床和车床，对金属或塑料材料（例如线材、棒材或棒料）进行车削、钻孔、螺纹、成型或端面加工。
jobs.te: Lathe and Turning Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend lathe and turning machines to turn, bore, thread, form, or face metal or plastic materials, such as wire, rod, or bar stock.

jobs.t: 铣床和刨床安装工、操作员和投标人，金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护铣床或刨床，对金属或塑料工件进行铣削、平面、形状、凹槽或轮廓加工。
jobs.te: Milling and Planing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend milling or planing machines to mill, plane, shape, groove, or profile metal or plastic work pieces.

jobs.d: 设置和操作各种机床，以生产金属精密零件和仪器。包括制造、改装或修理机械仪器的精密仪器制造商。还可以应用机械、数学、金属特性、布局和加工程序知识来制造或修理机床或维护工业机器。
jobs.de: Set up and operate a variety of machine tools to produce precision parts and instruments out of metal. Includes precision instrument makers who fabricate, modify, or repair mechanical instruments. May also fabricate and modify parts to make or repair machine tools or maintain industrial machines, applying knowledge of mechanics, mathematics, metal properties, layout, and machining procedures.

jobs.t: 金属精炼炉操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 操作或维护熔炉，例如燃气炉、油炉、煤炉、电弧炉或电感应炉、平炉或氧气炉，在铸造前熔化和精炼金属或生产特定类型的钢。
jobs.de: Operate or tend furnaces, such as gas, oil, coal, electric-arc or electric induction, open-hearth, or oxygen furnaces, to melt and refine metal before casting or to produce specified types of steel.

jobs.d: 操作手动控制机构，将熔融金属倒入模具中并调节其流量，以生产铸件或铸件。锭。
jobs.de: Operate hand-controlled mechanisms to pour and regulate the flow of molten metal into molds to produce castings or ingots.

jobs.t: 模型制造商，金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置和操作机器，例如车床、铣床、雕刻机以及坐标镗床，以制作金属或塑料物体的工作模型。包括模板制作者。
jobs.de: Set up and operate machines, such as lathes, milling and engraving machines, and jig borers to make working models of metal or plastic objects. Includes template makers.

jobs.t: 模型制造商，金属和塑料
jobs.d: 将铸件和零件布置、加工、装配和组装成金属或塑料铸造模型、型芯盒或匹配板。
jobs.de: Lay out, machine, fit, and assemble castings and parts to metal or plastic foundry patterns, core boxes, or match plates.

jobs.d: 制造或形成铸造厂金属铸件生产中使用的蜡或砂芯或模具。
jobs.de: Make or form wax or sand cores or molds used in the production of metal castings in foundries.

jobs.t: 成型、制芯和铸造机器安装工、操作员和投标人，金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置、操作或管理金属或塑料成型、铸造或制芯机器，以模制或铸造金属或热塑性零件或产品。
jobs.te: Molding, Coremaking, and Casting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend metal or plastic molding, casting, or coremaking machines to mold or cast metal or thermoplastic parts or products.

jobs.t: 多机床安装工、操作员和投标工，金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置、操作、或管理超过一种类型的切割或成型机床或机器人。
jobs.te: Multiple Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend more than one type of cutting or forming machine tool or robot.

jobs.d: 分析规格，布置金属库存，设置和操作机床，安装和组装零件以制造和修理模具、切削工具、夹具、固定装置、量规和机械师的手动工具。
jobs.de: Analyze specifications, lay out metal stock, set up and operate machine tools, and fit and assemble parts to make and repair dies, cutting tools, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and machinists' hand tools.

jobs.t: 焊工、切割工、焊锡工和钎焊工
jobs.d: 使用手工焊接、火焰切割、手工钎焊或钎焊设备来焊接或连接金属部件，或填充金属部件的孔、凹痕或接缝金属制品。
jobs.de: Use hand-welding, flame-cutting, hand-soldering, or brazing equipment to weld or join metal components or to fill holes, indentations, or seams of fabricated metal products.

jobs.t: 焊接、钎焊和钎焊机安装工、操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护焊接、钎焊、钎焊机器或机器人，用于焊接、钎焊、锡焊或热处理金属产品、部件或组件。包括操作激光切割机或激光束机器的工人。
jobs.te: Welding, Soldering, and Brazing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend welding, soldering, or brazing machines or robots that weld, braze, solder, or heat treat metal products, components, or assemblies. Includes workers who operate laser cutters or laser-beam machines.

jobs.t: 热处理设备安装工、操作员和投标人、金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护加热设备，例如热处理炉、火焰硬化机、感应机、均热坑或真空设备，以对金属或塑料物体进行回火、硬化、退火或热处理。
jobs.te: Heat Treating Equipment Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend heating equipment, such as heat-treating furnaces, flame-hardening machines, induction machines, soaking pits, or vacuum equipment to temper, harden, anneal, or heat treat metal or plastic objects.

jobs.d: 在金属或塑料库存或工件（例如板材、板材、管材、结构形状、铸件或机器零件）上布置参考点和尺寸，以供进一步使用处理。包括造船工。
jobs.de: Lay out reference points and dimensions on metal or plastic stock or workpieces, such as sheets, plates, tubes, structural shapes, castings, or machine parts, for further processing. Includes shipfitters.

jobs.t: 电镀机安装工、操作员和投标人、金属和塑料
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护电镀机，用铬、锌、铜、镉、镍或其他金属涂覆金属或塑料产品，以保护或装饰表面。通常，将要涂覆的产品浸入熔融金属或电解溶液中。
jobs.te: Plating Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend plating machines to coat metal or plastic products with chromium, zinc, copper, cadmium, nickel, or other metal to protect or decorate surfaces. Typically, the product being coated is immersed in molten metal or an electrolytic solution.

jobs.t: 工具磨床、锉刀和磨刀器
jobs.d: 对金属物体进行精密平滑、锐化、抛光或研磨。
jobs.de: Perform precision smoothing, sharpening, polishing, or grinding of metal objects.

jobs.d: 将设计师和客户提交的文本和图像格式化并校样为可打印的成品页面。包括数字和照片排版。可生产印刷版。
jobs.de: Format and proof text and images submitted by designers and clients into finished pages that can be printed. Includes digital and photo typesetting. May produce printing plates.

jobs.d: 设置和操作数字、凸版、平版、柔版、凹版或其他印刷机。包括短版胶印机。
jobs.de: Set up and operate digital, letterpress, lithographic, flexographic, gravure, or other printing machines. Includes short-run offset printing presses.

jobs.d: 装订书籍和其他出版物或手工或机器完成印刷产品。可以设置装订和整理机器。
jobs.de: Bind books and other publications or finish printed products by hand or machine. May set up binding and finishing machines.

jobs.d: 操作或维护洗衣机或干洗机来清洗或干洗工业或家庭用品，例如布制服装、麂皮、皮革、毛皮、毛毯、窗帘、亚麻布、地毯和地毯。包括这些制品的检验员和染色工。
jobs.de: Operate or tend washing or dry-cleaning machines to wash or dry-clean industrial or household articles, such as cloth garments, suede, leather, furs, blankets, draperies, linens, rugs, and carpets. Includes spotters and dyers of these articles.

jobs.t: 压烫机、纺织、服装和相关材料
jobs.d: 用手或机器压制或塑造制品。
jobs.te: Pressers, Textile, Garment, and Related Materials
jobs.de: Press or shape articles by hand or machine.

jobs.d: 操作或维护缝纫机，以在服装或非服装产品的制造中连接、加固、装饰或执行相关缝纫操作。
jobs.de: Operate or tend sewing machines to join, reinforce, decorate, or perform related sewing operations in the manufacture of garment or nongarment products.

jobs.t: 制鞋和皮革工人和修理工
jobs.d: 构造、装饰或修理皮革和类似皮革的产品，例如行李箱、鞋子和马鞍。可以使用手动工具。
jobs.te: Shoe and Leather Workers and Repairers
jobs.de: Construct, decorate, or repair leather and leather-like products, such as luggage, shoes, and saddles. May use hand tools.

jobs.d: 操作或维护各种机器来连接、装饰、加固或完成鞋子和鞋零件。
jobs.de: Operate or tend a variety of machines to join, decorate, reinforce, or finish shoes and shoe parts.

jobs.d: 通常使用针和线缝合、连接、加固或完成各种制成品。包括织布工和缝纫工。
jobs.de: Sew, join, reinforce, or finish, usually with needle and thread, a variety of manufactured items. Includes weavers and stitchers.

jobs.t: 裁缝、裁缝和定制下水道
jobs.d: 设计、制作、改造、修理或试穿服装。
jobs.de: Design, make, alter, repair, or fit garments.

jobs.t: 纺织漂白和染色机操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 操作或照料机器来漂白、收缩、洗涤、染色或整理纺织品或合成纤维或玻璃纤维。
jobs.te: Textile Bleaching and Dyeing Machine Operators and Tenders
jobs.de: Operate or tend machines to bleach, shrink, wash, dye, or finish textiles or synthetic or glass fibers.

jobs.t: 纺织切割机安装工、操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 设置、操作或照料切割纺织品的机器。
jobs.te: Textile Cutting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend machines that cut textiles.

jobs.t: 纺织品针织和织造机安装工、操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 设置、操作或照料对纺织品进行针织、套圈、编织或拉伸的机器。
jobs.te: Textile Knitting and Weaving Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend machines that knit, loop, weave, or draw in textiles.

jobs.t: 纺织品卷绕、加捻和拉出机器安装工、操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 设置、操作、或照管卷绕或扭曲纺织品的机器；或者抽出并混合棉条，例如羊毛、大麻或合成纤维。包括粗纺机和并条机操作员。
jobs.te: Textile Winding, Twisting, and Drawing Out Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend machines that wind or twist textiles; or draw out and combine sliver, such as wool, hemp, or synthetic fibers. Includes slubber machine and drawing frame operators.

jobs.t: 挤出和成型机安装工、操作员和投标人、合成纤维和玻璃纤维
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护从合成材料（例如液体聚合物、人造丝和玻璃纤维）挤出并形成连续长丝的机器。
jobs.te: Extruding and Forming Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Synthetic and Glass Fibers
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend machines that extrude and form continuous filaments from synthetic materials, such as liquid polymer, rayon, and fiberglass.

jobs.d: 绘制并构造一组精确的主织物图案或布局。还可以标记和切割织物和服装。
jobs.de: Draw and construct sets of precision master fabric patterns or layouts. May also mark and cut fabrics and apparel.

jobs.d: 制作、修理或更换家用家具或运输车辆的内饰。
jobs.de: Make, repair, or replace upholstery for household furniture or transportation vehicles.

jobs.d: 切割、成型和组装木制品或设置和操作各种木工机械，例如电锯、接合机和榫眼机，以对木材进行表面处理、切割或成型或制造木制品零件。
jobs.de: Cut, shape, and assemble wooden articles or set up and operate a variety of woodworking machines, such as power saws, jointers, and mortisers to surface, cut, or shape lumber or to fabricate parts for wood products.

jobs.d: 对损坏、磨损或使用过的家具或新家具进行成型、抛光和修补指定颜色或饰面的高档家具。
jobs.de: Shape, finish, and refinish damaged, worn, or used furniture or new high-grade furniture to specified color or finish.

jobs.d: 构建全尺寸和比例的木质产品精密模型。包括木夹具制造商和阁楼工人。
jobs.de: Construct full-size and scale wooden precision models of products. Includes wood jig builders and loft workers.

jobs.d: 规划、布置和构建用于形成铸件砂模的木制单元或截面模型。
jobs.de: Plan, lay out, and construct wooden unit or sectional patterns used in forming sand molds for castings.

jobs.t: 锯床安装工、操作员和投标人，木材
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护木材锯床。可以操作计算机数控（CNC）设备。包括铅锯工。
jobs.te: Sawing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Wood
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend wood sawing machines. May operate computer numerically controlled (CNC) equipment. Includes lead sawyers.

jobs.t: 木工机械安装工、操作员和投标人，锯切除外
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护木工机械，例如钻床、车床、成型机、刳刨机、砂光机、刨床和木钉机。可以操作计算机数控 (CNC) 设备。
jobs.te: Woodworking Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Except Sawing
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend woodworking machines, such as drill presses, lathes, shapers, routers, sanders, planers, and wood nailing machines. May operate computer numerically controlled (CNC) equipment.

jobs.d: 操作或控制核反应堆。移动控制杆，启动和停止设备，监控和调整控制装置，并将数据记录在日志中。需要时实施紧急程序。可以对异常情况做出反应，确定原因，并建议纠正措施。
jobs.de: Operate or control nuclear reactors. Move control rods, start and stop equipment, monitor and adjust controls, and record data in logs. Implement emergency procedures when needed. May respond to abnormalities, determine cause, and recommend corrective action.

jobs.d: 协调、调节或分配电力或蒸汽。
jobs.de: Coordinate, regulate, or distribute electricity or steam.

jobs.d: 控制、操作或维护发电机械。包括辅助设备操作员。
jobs.de: Control, operate, or maintain machinery to generate electric power. Includes auxiliary equipment operators.

jobs.t: 生物质发电厂技术人员
jobs.d: 控制和监测生物质发电厂的活动并根据需要进行维护。
jobs.de: Control and monitor biomass plant activities and perform maintenance as needed.

jobs.d: 监测和控制与水力发电相关的活动。操作工厂设备，例如涡轮机、泵、阀门、闸门、风扇、电气控制板和电池组。监控设备运行和性能并进行必要的调整以确保最佳性能。根据需要进行设备维护和修理。
jobs.de: Monitor and control activities associated with hydropower generation. Operate plant equipment, such as turbines, pumps, valves, gates, fans, electric control boards, and battery banks. Monitor equipment operation and performance and make necessary adjustments to ensure optimal performance. Perform equipment maintenance and repair as necessary.

jobs.t: 固定工程师和锅炉操作员
jobs.d: 操作或维护固定式发动机、锅炉或其他机械设备，为建筑物或工业流程提供公用设施。操作蒸汽机、发电机、电动机、涡轮机和蒸汽锅炉等设备。
jobs.de: Operate or maintain stationary engines, boilers, or other mechanical equipment to provide utilities for buildings or industrial processes. Operate equipment such as steam engines, generators, motors, turbines, and steam boilers.

jobs.t: 水和废水处理工厂和系统操作员
jobs.d: 通常通过使用控制板来操作或控制整个过程或机器系统，以传输或处理水或废水。
jobs.te: Water and Wastewater Treatment Plant and System Operators
jobs.de: Operate or control an entire process or system of machines, often through the use of control boards, to transfer or treat water or wastewater.

jobs.d: 控制或操作整个化学过程或机器系统。
jobs.de: Control or operate entire chemical processes or system of machines.

jobs.d: 通过控制压缩机以维持主管道上的指定压力，为公用事业公司和其他机构分配或处理气体。
jobs.de: Distribute or process gas for utility companies and others by controlling compressors to maintain specified pressures on main pipelines.

jobs.t: 石油泵系统操作员、炼油厂操作员和计量器
jobs.d: 操作或控制石油精炼或加工装置。可能专注于控制歧管和泵送系统，计量或测试储罐中的油，或调节进入管道的油流量。
jobs.te: Petroleum Pump System Operators, Refinery Operators, and Gaugers
jobs.de: Operate or control petroleum refining or processing units. May specialize in controlling manifold and pumping systems, gauging or testing oil in storage tanks, or regulating the flow of oil into pipelines.

jobs.d: 在发酵或反应工艺容器中计算、测量、装载、混合和加工含有添加剂的精炼原料，并监控生产过程。执行工厂维护、维修和安全检查并保存记录。
jobs.de: Calculate, measure, load, mix, and process refined feedstock with additives in fermentation or reaction process vessels and monitor production process. Perform, and keep records of, plant maintenance, repairs, and safety inspections.

jobs.t: 化学设备操作员和投标
jobs.d: 操作或维护设备以控制工业或消费品加工中的化学变化或反应。使用的设备包括脱硫机、蒸汽夹套釜和反应容器。
jobs.de: Operate or tend equipment to control chemical changes or reactions in the processing of industrial or consumer products. Equipment used includes devulcanizers, steam-jacketed kettles, and reactor vessels.

jobs.t: 分离、过滤、澄清、沉淀和静止机设置人员、操作员和投标
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护连续流或槽式设备；压滤机；振动筛；离心机；冷凝管；沉淀、发酵或蒸发罐；洗涤塔；或批量剧照。这些机器从其他材料中提取、分类或分离液体、气体或固体，以回收精炼产品。包括乳制品加工设备操作员。
jobs.te: Separating, Filtering, Clarifying, Precipitating, and Still Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend continuous flow or vat-type equipment; filter presses; shaker screens; centrifuges; condenser tubes; precipitating, fermenting, or evaporating tanks; scrubbing towers; or batch stills. These machines extract, sort, or separate liquids, gases, or solids from other materials to recover a refined product. Includes dairy processing equipment operators.

jobs.t: 破碎、研磨和抛光机器设置者、操作员和投标者
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护机器来压碎、研磨或抛光材料，例如煤炭、玻璃、谷物、石头、食品或橡胶。
jobs.te: Crushing, Grinding, and Polishing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend machines to crush, grind, or polish materials, such as coal, glass, grain, stone, food, or rubber.

jobs.d: 使用手动工具或手持式电动工具研磨、打磨或抛光各种金属、木材、石头、粘土、塑料或玻璃物体。包括削片机、缓冲机和整理机。
jobs.de: Grind, sand, or polish, using hand tools or hand-held power tools, a variety of metal, wood, stone, clay, plastic, or glass objects. Includes chippers, buffers, and finishers.

jobs.t: 混合和混合机器设置者、操作员和投标者
jobs.d: 设置、操作或管理机器来混合或混合材料，例如化学品、烟草、液体、彩色颜料或爆炸性成分。
jobs.te: Mixing and Blending Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend machines to mix or blend materials, such as chemicals, tobacco, liquids, color pigments, or explosive ingredients.

jobs.d: 使用手动工具或手持式电动工具切割和修剪各种制成品，例如地毯、织物、石头、玻璃或橡胶。
jobs.de: Use hand tools or hand-held power tools to cut and trim a variety of manufactured items, such as carpet, fabric, stone, glass, or rubber.

jobs.t: 切割和切片机器设置者、操作员和投标者
jobs.d: 设置、操作或管理机器来切割或切片材料，例如玻璃、石头、软木、橡胶、烟草、食品、纸张或绝缘材料。
jobs.te: Cutting and Slicing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend machines that cut or slice materials, such as glass, stone, cork, rubber, tobacco, food, paper, or insulating material.

jobs.t: 挤压、成型、压制和压实机安装工、操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护机器，例如玻璃成型机、压条机和块茎机，以成型和成型产品，例如玻璃器皿、食品、橡胶、肥皂、砖、瓷砖、粘土、蜡、烟草或化妆品。
jobs.te: Extruding, Forming, Pressing, and Compacting Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend machines, such as glass-forming machines, plodder machines, and tuber machines, to shape and form products such as glassware, food, rubber, soap, brick, tile, clay, wax, tobacco, or cosmetics.

jobs.t: 熔炉、窑炉、烘箱、干燥机和水壶操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 操作或维护基本金属、塑料或食品加工设备以外的加热设备。包括玻璃退火、木材干燥、橡胶固化、材料除湿或煮肥皂等活动。
jobs.te: Furnace, Kiln, Oven, Drier, and Kettle Operators and Tenders
jobs.de: Operate or tend heating equipment other than basic metal, plastic, or food processing equipment. Includes activities such as annealing glass, drying lumber, curing rubber, removing moisture from materials, or boiling soap.

jobs.t: 检查员、测试员、分选员、取样员和称重员
jobs.d: 检查、测试、分类、取样或称重非农业原材料或加工、机加工、制造或组装的零件或产品是否有缺陷、磨损和与规格的偏差。可以使用精密测量仪器和复杂的测试设备。
jobs.te: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers
jobs.de: Inspect, test, sort, sample, or weigh nonagricultural raw materials or processed, machined, fabricated, or assembled parts or products for defects, wear, and deviations from specifications. May use precision measuring instruments and complex test equipment.

jobs.t: 珠宝工人和宝石和金属工人
jobs.d: 设计、制造、调整、修理或评估珠宝、金、银、其他贵金属或宝石。
jobs.te: Jewelers and Precious Stone and Metal Workers
jobs.de: Design, fabricate, adjust, repair, or appraise jewelry, gold, silver, other precious metals, or gems.

jobs.d: 制造、修饰或评估珠宝或工业工具中使用的宝石和钻石的质量。
jobs.de: Fabricate, finish, or evaluate the quality of gems and diamonds used in jewelry or industrial tools.

jobs.d: 建造和修理全口或部分假牙或牙科器具。
jobs.de: Construct and repair full or partial dentures or dental appliances.

jobs.d: 建造、维护或修理医疗支持设备，例如牙套、矫形器和假肢装置、关节、足弓支撑以及其他外科和医疗器具。
jobs.de: Construct, maintain, or repair medical supportive devices such as braces, orthotics and prosthetic devices, joints, arch supports, and other surgical and medical appliances.

jobs.d: 切割、研磨和抛光眼镜、隐形眼镜或其他精密光学元件。将镜片组装并安装到框架中或加工其他光学元件。包括精密镜片抛光机或研磨机、中心磨边机和镜片安装机。
jobs.de: Cut, grind, and polish eyeglasses, contact lenses, or other precision optical elements. Assemble and mount lenses into frames or process other optical elements. Includes precision lens polishers or grinders, centerer-edgers, and lens mounters.

jobs.t: 包装和灌装机操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 操作或维护机器以准备工业或消费品以进行存储或运输。包括包装食品的罐头厂工人。
jobs.te: Packaging and Filling Machine Operators and Tenders
jobs.de: Operate or tend machines to prepare industrial or consumer products for storage or shipment. Includes cannery workers who pack food products.

jobs.d: 对家具、玻璃、餐具、陶器、珠宝、玩具、书籍或皮革等物品进行油漆、涂层或装饰。
jobs.de: Paint, coat, or decorate articles, such as furniture, glass, plateware, pottery, jewelry, toys, books, or leather.

jobs.t: 涂装、喷漆和喷涂机安装人员、操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 设置、操作或维护喷涂或滚压机器，用清漆、银、铜、橡胶、清漆、釉料等对各种产品进行涂层或油漆，包括玻璃器皿、布料、陶瓷、金属、塑料、纸张或木材。搪瓷、油或防锈材料。包括运输车辆的油漆工，例如车身修理厂的油漆工。
jobs.te: Coating, Painting, and Spraying Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend spraying or rolling machines to coat or paint any of a wide variety of products, including glassware, cloth, ceramics, metal, plastic, paper, or wood, with lacquer, silver, copper, rubber, varnish, glaze, enamel, oil, or rust-proofing materials. Includes painters of transportation vehicles such as painters in auto body repair facilities.

jobs.d: 在电子半导体制造中执行以下任何或所有功能：将半导体材料装入炉中；将成型锭锯成段；将各个片段加载到晶体生长室中并进行监控；使用 X 射线设备定位锭中的晶轴并将锭锯成晶圆；清洁、抛光晶圆并将其装入一系列专用熔炉、化学浴以及用于形成电路和改变导电性能的设备中。
jobs.de: Perform any or all of the following functions in the manufacture of electronic semiconductors: load semiconductor material into furnace; saw formed ingots into segments; load individual segment into crystal growing chamber and monitor controls; locate crystal axis in ingot using x-ray equipment and saw ingots into wafers; and clean, polish, and load wafers into series of special purpose furnaces, chemical baths, and equipment used to form circuitry and change conductive properties.

jobs.t: 摄影加工工人和加工机器操作员
jobs.d: 执行涉及冲洗和处理胶片或数字媒体的摄影图像的工作。可以执行精确的任务，例如编辑摄影底片和照片。
jobs.te: Photographic Process Workers and Processing Machine Operators
jobs.de: Perform work involved in developing and processing photographic images from film or digital media. May perform precision tasks such as editing photographic negatives and prints.

jobs.t: 计算机数控工具操作员
jobs.d: 操作计算机控制的工具、机器或机器人来加工或处理由金属、塑料、木材、石头或其他材料制成的零件、工具或其他工件。还可以设置和维护设备。
jobs.de: Operate computer-controlled tools, machines, or robots to machine or process parts, tools, or other work pieces made of metal, plastic, wood, stone, or other materials. May also set up and maintain equipment.

jobs.t: 计算机数控工具程序员
jobs.d: 开发程序以控制自动机床、设备或系统对材料的加工或加工。还可以设置、操作或维护设备。
jobs.de: Develop programs to control machining or processing of materials by automatic machine tools, equipment, or systems. May also set up, operate, or maintain equipment.

jobs.t: 粘合机操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 操作或维护使用粘合剂连接物品以进行进一步加工或形成成品的粘合机。工艺包括将单板连接成胶合板；胶纸；或连接橡胶和橡胶织物部件、塑料、人造皮革或其他材料。
jobs.te: Adhesive Bonding Machine Operators and Tenders
jobs.de: Operate or tend bonding machines that use adhesives to join items for further processing or to form a completed product. Processes include joining veneer sheets into plywood; gluing paper; or joining rubber and rubberized fabric parts, plastic, simulated leather, or other materials.

jobs.t: 清洁、清洗和金属酸洗设备操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 操作或维护机器来清洗或清洁产品，例如桶或小桶、玻璃制品、马口铁、食品、纸浆、煤炭、塑料或橡胶，以去除杂质。
jobs.te: Cleaning, Washing, and Metal Pickling Equipment Operators and Tenders
jobs.de: Operate or tend machines to wash or clean products, such as barrels or kegs, glass items, tin plate, food, pulp, coal, plastic, or rubber, to remove impurities.

jobs.t: 冷却和冷冻设备操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 操作或维护设备，例如冷却和冷冻装置、冰箱、批量冷冻机和冷冻隧道，以冷却或冷冻产品、食品、血浆和化学品。
jobs.te: Cooling and Freezing Equipment Operators and Tenders
jobs.de: Operate or tend equipment such as cooling and freezing units, refrigerators, batch freezers, and freezing tunnels, to cool or freeze products, food, blood plasma, and chemicals.

jobs.d: 雕刻或蚀刻金属、木材、橡胶或其他材料。包括蚀刻电路加工者、受电弓雕刻师和丝网蚀刻师等工人。
jobs.de: Engrave or etch metal, wood, rubber, or other materials. Includes such workers as etcher-circuit processors, pantograph engravers, and silk screen etchers.

jobs.t: 成型工、成型工和铸工，金属和塑料除外
jobs.d: 对产品进行模具、成型、成型、铸造或雕刻，例如由粘土、玻璃、石膏、混凝土、石头或材料组合组成的食品、雕像、瓷砖、管道和蜡烛。
jobs.te: Molders, Shapers, and Casters, Except Metal and Plastic
jobs.de: Mold, shape, form, cast, or carve products such as food products, figurines, tile, pipes, and candles consisting of clay, glass, plaster, concrete, stone, or combinations of materials.

jobs.t: 石材切割工和雕刻工，制造业
jobs.d: 根据图表和图案切割或雕刻石头。
jobs.de: Cut or carve stone according to diagrams and patterns.

jobs.t: 玻璃吹制工、模工工、弯曲工和修整工
jobs.d: 根据图案。
jobs.te: Glass Blowers, Molders, Benders, and Finishers
jobs.de: Shape molten glass according to patterns.

jobs.d: 操作搅拌机、跳汰机或陶轮等生产机器，在陶瓷、陶器和粗陶产品的制造中加工粘土。
jobs.de: Operate production machines such as pug mill, jigger machine, or potter's wheel to process clay in manufacture of ceramic, pottery and stoneware products.

jobs.t: 纸品机械安装工、操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 设置、操作或照管纸制品机器，执行各种功能，例如转换、锯切、瓦楞、捆扎、包装、装箱、缝合、成型或将纸或纸板片密封成产品。
jobs.te: Paper Goods Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
jobs.de: Set up, operate, or tend paper goods machines that perform a variety of functions, such as converting, sawing, corrugating, banding, wrapping, boxing, stitching, forming, or sealing paper or paperboard sheets into products.

jobs.d: 操作机器来构建轮胎。
jobs.de: Operate machines to build tires.

jobs.d: 帮助生产工人履行技能要求较低的职责。职责包括提供或保存材料或工具，以及清洁工作区域和设备。
jobs.de: Help production workers by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include supplying or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

jobs.d: 监督和协调地勤人员在飞机货物或行李的装载、卸载、固定和暂存方面的活动。可以确定货物的数量和方向并计算飞机的重心。可以作为机组人员陪伴飞机，监控和处理飞行中的货物，并协助并向乘客介绍安全和紧急程序。包括装载管理员。
jobs.de: Supervise and coordinate the activities of ground crew in the loading, unloading, securing, and staging of aircraft cargo or baggage. May determine the quantity and orientation of cargo and compute aircraft center of gravity. May accompany aircraft as member of flight crew and monitor and handle cargo in flight, and assist and brief passengers on safety and emergency procedures. Includes loadmasters.

jobs.t: 帮手、工人和物料搬运工的一线主管、手工
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调助手、劳工或物料搬运工的活动。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Helpers, Laborers, and Material Movers, Hand
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate the activities of helpers, laborers, or material movers, hand.

jobs.d: 监督市政府或私营公司的路边和投放回收计划。
jobs.de: Supervise curbside and drop-off recycling programs for municipal governments or private firms.

jobs.t: 物料搬运机械和车辆的一线主管运营商
jobs.d: 直接监督和协调物料搬运机器和车辆操作员和助手的活动。
jobs.te: First-Line Supervisors of Material-Moving Machine and Vehicle Operators
jobs.de: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of material-moving machine and vehicle operators and helpers.

jobs.t: 航空公司飞行员、副驾驶和飞行工程师
jobs.d: 固定翼飞机的飞行和驾驶，通常在定期航空承运航线上，用于乘客和货物的运输。需要联邦航空运输证书和所使用的特定飞机类型的评级。包括地区、国家和国际航空公司飞行员以及航空公司飞行员的飞行教练。
jobs.te: Airline Pilots, Copilots, and Flight Engineers
jobs.de: Pilot and navigate the flight of fixed-wing aircraft, usually on scheduled air carrier routes, for the transport of passengers and cargo. Requires Federal Air Transport certificate and rating for specific aircraft type used. Includes regional, national, and international airline pilots and flight instructors of airline pilots.

jobs.d: 在不定期航空承运航线上驾驶和驾驶固定翼飞机或直升机。需要商业飞行员证书。包括具有类似认证的包机飞行员以及空中救护和空中旅游飞行员。不包括地区、国家和国际航空公司的飞行员。
jobs.de: Pilot and navigate the flight of fixed-wing aircraft on nonscheduled air carrier routes, or helicopters. Requires Commercial Pilot certificate. Includes charter pilots with similar certification, and air ambulance and air tour pilots. Excludes regional, national, and international airline pilots.

jobs.d: 根据既定程序和政策，控制机场及其附近的空中交通，以及高空区域和控制中心之间的空中交通。根据政府或公司规定授权、监管和控制商业航空公司航班，以加快和确保飞行安全。
jobs.de: Control air traffic on and within vicinity of airport, and movement of air traffic between altitude sectors and control centers, according to established procedures and policies. Authorize, regulate, and control commercial airline flights according to government or company regulations to expedite and ensure flight safety.

jobs.d: 确保商业和军用飞机安全起降。职责包括空中交通管制和维护人员之间的协调、调度、使用机场着陆和导航设备、实施机场安全程序、监控和维护飞行记录以及应用天气信息知识。
jobs.de: Ensure the safe takeoff and landing of commercial and military aircraft. Duties include coordination between air-traffic control and maintenance personnel, dispatching, using airfield landing and navigational aids, implementing airfield safety procedures, monitoring and maintaining flight records, and applying knowledge of weather information.

jobs.d: 监控飞机机舱的安全。为航空公司乘客提供服务、解释安全信息、提供食品和饮料以及应对紧急事件。
jobs.de: Monitor safety of the aircraft cabin. Provide services to airline passengers, explain safety information, serve food and beverages, and respond to emergency incidents.

jobs.t: 救护车司机和服务员，紧急医疗技术人员除外
jobs.d: 驾驶救护车或协助救护车司机运送病人、受伤或康复者。协助抬升患者。
jobs.te: Ambulance Drivers and Attendants, Except Emergency Medical Technicians
jobs.de: Drive ambulance or assist ambulance driver in transporting sick, injured, or convalescent persons. Assist in lifting patients.

jobs.d: 在既定路线或既定区域内驾驶卡车或其他车辆，销售或运送货物，例如食品，包括餐厅外卖物品，或者收取或运送商业洗衣等物品。还可以在交货点接受订单、收取付款或库存商品。
jobs.de: Drive truck or other vehicle over established routes or within an established territory and sell or deliver goods, such as food products, including restaurant take-out items, or pick up or deliver items such as commercial laundry. May also take orders, collect payment, or stock merchandise at point of delivery.

jobs.d: 驾驶牵引车-拖车组合或车辆总重 (GVW) 至少为 26,001 磅的卡车。可能需要卸载卡车。需要商业驾驶执照。包括拖车司机。
jobs.de: Drive a tractor-trailer combination or a truck with a capacity of at least 26,001 pounds Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW). May be required to unload truck. Requires commercial drivers' license. Includes tow truck drivers.

jobs.d: 驾驶轻型车辆，例如卡车或厢式货车，车辆总重 (GVW) 小于 26,001 磅，主要用于从配送中心提取商品或包裹并交付。可以装卸车辆。
jobs.de: Drive a light vehicle, such as a truck or van, with a capacity of less than 26,001 pounds Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), primarily to pick up merchandise or packages from a distribution center and deliver. May load and unload vehicle.

jobs.t: 公共汽车司机、交通和城际
jobs.d: 驾驶巴士或大客车，包括常规路线运营、包车和私人马车。可以协助乘客搬运行李。可以收取车费或车票。
jobs.de: Drive bus or motor coach, including regular route operations, charters, and private carriage. May assist passengers with baggage. May collect fares or tickets.

jobs.d: 驾驶电动、柴电、蒸汽或燃气轮机电力机车来运输乘客或货物。解释列车指令、电子或手动信号以及铁路规则和规定。
jobs.de: Drive electric, diesel-electric, steam, or gas-turbine-electric locomotives to transport passengers or freight. Interpret train orders, electronic or manual signals, and railroad rules and regulations.

jobs.t: 铁路场工程师、小型操作员和主持人
jobs.d: 在铁路站场、工业厂房、采石场、建筑项目或类似地点驱动切换或其他机车或小型发动机。
jobs.te: Rail Yard Engineers, Dinkey Operators, and Hostlers
jobs.de: Drive switching or other locomotive or dinkey engines within railroad yard, industrial plant, quarry, construction project, or similar location.

jobs.t: 铁路制动器、信号和开关操作员和机车消防员
jobs.d: 操作或监控铁路轨道切换或机车仪器。可以连接或断开机车车辆以组装或分解火车。留意并转发交通信号。可以检查联轴器、空气软管、轴箱和手制动器。可能会留意通行权上的拖动设备或障碍物。
jobs.te: Railroad Brake, Signal, and Switch Operators and Locomotive Firers
jobs.de: Operate or monitor railroad track switches or locomotive instruments. May couple or uncouple rolling stock to make up or break up trains. Watch for and relay traffic signals. May inspect couplings, air hoses, journal boxes, and hand brakes. May watch for dragging equipment or obstacles on rights-of-way.

jobs.d: 协调铁路站场、工业厂房或类似地点内转车组的活动。售票员协调客运或货运列车上列车乘务人员的活动。站长审查列车时刻表和换车指令，并协调从事铁路交通运营的工人的活动，例如列车的装卸和站场换车。
jobs.de: Coordinate activities of switch-engine crew within railroad yard, industrial plant, or similar location. Conductors coordinate activities of train crew on passenger or freight trains. Yardmasters review train schedules and switching orders and coordinate activities of workers engaged in railroad traffic operations, such as the makeup or breakup of trains and yard switching.

jobs.t: 地铁和有轨电车操作员
jobs.d: 运营没有单独机车或电动有轨电车的地铁或高架郊区列车来运送乘客。可以处理票价。
jobs.de: Operate subway or elevated suburban trains with no separate locomotive, or electric-powered streetcar, to transport passengers. May handle fares.

jobs.d: 站值班寻找船只路径上的障碍物、测量水深、转动驾驶台上的方向盘或按照船长、大副或领航员的指示使用应急设备。拆卸、安装、检修和储存货物装卸装置、固定索具和行走装置。执行各种维护任务，以保护船舶的油漆表面并维护线路和船舶设备。在液体运输船上工作时必须持有政府颁发的证书和油轮操作员证书。包括高级海员和普通海员。
jobs.de: Stand watch to look for obstructions in path of vessel, measure water depth, turn wheel on bridge, or use emergency equipment as directed by captain, mate, or pilot. Break out, rig, overhaul, and store cargo-handling gear, stationary rigging, and running gear. Perform a variety of maintenance tasks to preserve the painted surface of the ship and to maintain line and ship equipment. Must hold government-issued certification and tankerman certification when working aboard liquid-carrying vessels. Includes able seamen and ordinary seamen.

jobs.t: 水上船舶的船长、大副和引航员
jobs.d: 指挥或监督船舶和水上船只（例如拖船和渡船）的操作。需要持有美国海岸警卫队颁发的许可证。
jobs.te: Captains, Mates, and Pilots of Water Vessels
jobs.de: Command or supervise operations of ships and water vessels, such as tugboats and ferryboats. Required to hold license issued by U.S. Coast Guard.

jobs.d: 操作小型机动船。可协助航行活动。
jobs.de: Operate small motor-driven boats. May assist in navigational activities.

jobs.d: 监督和协调从事操作和维护船上发动机、锅炉、甲板机械以及电气、卫生和制冷设备的船员的活动。
jobs.de: Supervise and coordinate activities of crew engaged in operating and maintaining engines, boilers, deck machinery, and electrical, sanitary, and refrigeration equipment aboard ship.

jobs.d: 操作和维护桥梁、运河船闸和灯塔，以允许内陆水道、近岸和水道危险点的海上通行。可以监督此类操作。包括吊桥操作员、锁操作员和滑桥操作员。
jobs.de: Operate and tend bridges, canal locks, and lighthouses to permit marine passage on inland waterways, near shores, and at danger points in waterway passages. May supervise such operations. Includes drawbridge operators, lock operators, and slip bridge operators.

jobs.d: 在停车场或车库停放车辆或为顾客开票。可以在汽车经销店或租车设施等环境中停放或照管车辆。可能会收取费用。
jobs.de: Park vehicles or issue tickets for customers in a parking lot or garage. May park or tend vehicles in environments such as a car dealership or rental car facility. May collect fee.

jobs.t: 汽车和船舶服务服务员
jobs.d: 为汽车、公共汽车、卡车、船只以及其他汽车或船舶车辆提供燃料、润滑油和配件。收取服务和用品费用。可以润滑车辆、更换机油、补充防冻剂或更换车灯或其他配件，例如挡风玻璃雨刷片或风扇皮带。可以修理或更换轮胎。
jobs.de: Service automobiles, buses, trucks, boats, and other automotive or marine vehicles with fuel, lubricants, and accessories. Collect payment for services and supplies. May lubricate vehicle, change motor oil, refill antifreeze, or replace lights or other accessories, such as windshield wiper blades or fan belts. May repair or replace tires.

jobs.d: 在交通工程师的指导下进行实地研究，以确定交通量、速度、信号有效性、照明是否充足以及影响交通状况的其他因素。
jobs.de: Conduct field studies to determine traffic volume, speed, effectiveness of signals, adequacy of lighting, and other factors influencing traffic conditions, under direction of traffic engineer.

jobs.d: 检查与货物或人员安全运输有关的设备或货物。包括铁路运输检查员，例如货运检查员、铁路检查员和其他未分类的运输车辆检查员。
jobs.de: Inspect equipment or goods in connection with the safe transport of cargo or people. Includes rail transportation inspectors, such as freight inspectors, rail inspectors, and other inspectors of transportation vehicles not elsewhere classified.

jobs.d: 检查飞机、维护程序、空中导航设备、空中交通管制和通信设备，以确保符合联邦安全法规。
jobs.de: Inspect aircraft, maintenance procedures, air navigational aids, air traffic controls, and communications equipment to ensure conformance with Federal safety regulations.

jobs.t: 运输车辆、设备和系统检查员，航空除外
jobs.d: 检查和监控运输设备、车辆或系统，以确保符合法规和安全标准。
jobs.te: Transportation Vehicle, Equipment and Systems Inspectors, Except Aviation
jobs.de: Inspect and monitor transportation equipment, vehicles, or systems to ensure compliance with regulations and safety standards.

jobs.d: 提供服务以确保船上、公共汽车、火车或在公共区域内乘客的安全车站或航站楼。履行职责，例如解释安全设备的使用、提供膳食或饮料或回答与旅行相关的问题。
jobs.de: Provide services to ensure the safety of passengers aboard ships, buses, trains, or within the station or terminal. Perform duties such as explaining the use of safety equipment, serving meals or beverages, or answering questions related to travel.

jobs.t: 输送机操作员和投标人
jobs.d: 控制或维护将材料或产品移入和移出库存、加工站、部门或车辆的输送机或输送系统。可以控制材料或产品的速度和路线。
jobs.de: Control or tend conveyors or conveyor systems that move materials or products to and from stockpiles, processing stations, departments, or vehicles. May control speed and routing of materials or products.

jobs.d: 操作机械吊杆和电缆或塔和电缆设备，以在多个方向提升和移动材料、机器或产品。
jobs.de: Operate mechanical boom and cable or tower and cable equipment to lift and move materials, machines, or products in many directions.

jobs.d: 操作挖泥机清除沙子、砾石或其他材料，以便挖掘和维护水道中的通航通道。
jobs.de: Operate dredge to remove sand, gravel, or other materials in order to excavate and maintain navigable channels in waterways.

jobs.d: 操作或维护起重机或绞车，以使用电动电缆设备提升和拉动负载。
jobs.de: Operate or tend hoists or winches to lift and pull loads using power-operated cable equipment.

jobs.t: 工业卡车和拖拉机操作员
jobs.d: 操作工业卡车或配备拖拉机，用于在仓库、堆场、工厂、建筑工地或类似地点移动材料。
jobs.de: Operate industrial trucks or tractors equipped to move materials around a warehouse, storage yard, factory, construction site, or similar location.

jobs.d: 清洗或以其他方式清洁车辆、机械和其他设备。使用水、清洁剂、刷子、布和软管等材料。
jobs.de: Wash or otherwise clean vehicles, machinery, and other equipment. Use such materials as water, cleaning agents, brushes, cloths, and hoses.

jobs.t: 工人和货运、库存和材料搬运工、手工
jobs.d: 手动移动货物、库存、行李或其他材料，或执行其他一般劳动。包括其他未分类的所有体力劳动者。
jobs.te: Laborers and Freight, Stock, and Material Movers, Hand
jobs.de: Manually move freight, stock, luggage, or other materials, or perform other general labor. Includes all manual laborers not elsewhere classified.

jobs.d: 准备和分类材料或产品以供回收。识别并去除有害物质。拆卸电器等产品的组件。
jobs.de: Prepare and sort materials or products for recycling. Identify and remove hazardous substances. Dismantle components of products such as appliances.

jobs.d: 将材料送入自动或由其他工人操作的机器或设备中或从中取出材料。
jobs.de: Feed materials into or remove materials from machines or equipment that is automatic or tended by other workers.

jobs.d: 手工包装或包装各种产品和材料。
jobs.de: Pack or package by hand a wide variety of products and materials.

jobs.d: 从库房、仓库或堆场接收、储存和发放商品、材料、设备和其他物品，以填充货架、货架、桌子或客户的订单。可以操作电力设备来完成订单。可以在商品上标价并设置销售展示。
jobs.de: Receive, store, and issue merchandise, materials, equipment, and other items from stockroom, warehouse, or storage yard to fill shelves, racks, tables, or customers' orders. May operate power equipment to fill orders. May mark prices on merchandise and set up sales displays.

jobs.t: 气体压缩机和气体泵站操作员
jobs.d: 操作蒸汽、天然气、电动机或内燃机驱动的压缩机。传输、压缩或回收气体，如丁烷、氮气、氢气和天然气。
jobs.te: Gas Compressor and Gas Pumping Station Operators
jobs.de: Operate steam-, gas-, electric motor-, or internal combustion-engine driven compressors. Transmit, compress, or recover gases, such as butane, nitrogen, hydrogen, and natural gas.

jobs.t: 泵操作员，除了井口泵工
jobs.d: 管理、控制或操作动力驱动、固定或便携式泵和歧管系统，以将气体、油、其他液体、泥浆或粉末材料输送到各种容器和过程。
jobs.de: Tend, control, or operate power-driven, stationary, or portable pumps and manifold systems to transfer gases, oil, other liquids, slurries, or powdered materials to and from various vessels and processes.

jobs.d: 操作动力泵和辅助设备，从油田的井中产生石油或天然气流。
jobs.de: Operate power pumps and auxiliary equipment to produce flow of oil or gas from wells in oil field.

jobs.t: 垃圾和可回收材料收集者
jobs.d: 收集和倾倒垃圾或垃圾可回收材料从集装箱到卡车。可以驾驶卡车。
jobs.de: Collect and dump refuse or recyclable materials from containers into truck. May drive truck.

jobs.t: 罐车、卡车和船舶装载机
jobs.d: 使用物料运输设备将化学品和散装固体（例如煤炭、沙子和谷物）装卸到罐车、卡车或船舶上或从罐车、卡车或船舶上卸载。可以执行与产品运输相关的各种其他任务。可以对运输罐进行测量或取样并测试其是否泄漏。
jobs.te: Tank Car, Truck, and Ship Loaders
jobs.de: Load and unload chemicals and bulk solids, such as coal, sand, and grain, into or from tank cars, trucks, or ships, using material moving equipment. May perform a variety of other tasks relating to shipment of products. May gauge or sample shipping tanks and test them for leaks.

jobs.d: 在地方、部落、州或联邦层面制定、引入或颁布法律和法规。仅包括当选职位的工作人员。
jobs.de: Develop, introduce, or enact laws and statutes at the local, tribal, state, or federal level. Includes only workers in elected positions.

jobs.d: 计划、指导或协调旨在为其组织或客户创造或维持良好的公众形象或提高问题意识的活动。
jobs.de: Plan, direct, or coordinate activities designed to create or maintain a favorable public image or raise issue awareness for their organization or client.

jobs.d: 计划、指导或协调活动，为特殊项目或非营利组织筹集和维持资金。
jobs.de: Plan, direct, or coordinate activities to solicit and maintain funds for special projects or nonprofit organizations.

jobs.d: 指导组织的安全职能，包括员工和设施的人身安全和安全。
jobs.de: Direct an organization's security functions, including physical security and safety of employees and facilities.

jobs.d: 未单独列出的所有教育管理员。
jobs.de: All education administrators not listed separately.

jobs.t: 娱乐和休闲经理，赌博除外
jobs.d: 计划，指导或协调娱乐和娱乐活动以及娱乐设施的运营，包括游轮和公园。
jobs.te: Entertainment and Recreation Managers, Except Gambling
jobs.de: Plan, direct, or coordinate entertainment and recreational activities and operations of a recreational facility, including cruise ships and parks.

jobs.t: 个人服务经理，所有其他
jobs.d: 未单独列出的所有个人服务经理。
jobs.de: All personal service managers not listed separately.

jobs.de: All managers not listed separately.

jobs.d: 按项目分析和协调产品或服务的时间表、时间表、采购、人员配备和预算。领导和指导技术人员的工作。可以作为客户或顾客的联系人。
jobs.de: Analyze and coordinate the schedule, timeline, procurement, staffing, and budget of a product or service on a per project basis. Lead and guide the work of technical staff. May serve as a point of contact for the client or customer.

jobs.t: 业务运营专家，所有其他
jobs.d: 未单独列出的所有业务运营专家。
jobs.de: All business operations specialists not listed separately.

jobs.d: 对组织进行安全评估，并设计安全系统和流程。可能专注于人身安全或员工和设施的安全等领域。
jobs.de: Conduct security assessments for organizations, and design security systems and processes. May specialize in areas such as physical security or the safety of employees and facilities.

jobs.t: 个人和企业财产评估师
jobs.d: 评估和估计有形个人或企业财产的公允价值，例如珠宝、艺术品、古董、收藏品和设备。还可以评估土地。
jobs.te: Appraisers of Personal and Business Property
jobs.de: Appraise and estimate the fair value of tangible personal or business property, such as jewelry, art, antiques, collectibles, and equipment. May also appraise land.

jobs.d: 对涉及公共或私人机构的投资计划或财务数据的信息进行定量分析，包括企业估值。
jobs.de: Conduct quantitative analyses of information involving investment programs or financial data of public or private institutions, including valuation of businesses.

jobs.d: 分析和衡量威胁组织资产、盈利能力或经济状况的信贷和市场风险。可以提出限制风险的建议。
jobs.de: Analyze and measure exposure to credit and market risk threatening the assets, earning capacity, or economic state of an organization. May make recommendations to limit risk.

jobs.d: 未单独列出的所有财务专家。
jobs.de: All financial specialists not listed separately.

jobs.d: 研究、设计和开发计算机和网络软件或专门的实用程序。应用计算机科学、工程学和数学分析的原理和技术，分析用户需求并开发软件解决方案。更新软件或增强现有软件功能。可以与计算机硬件工程师合作，集成硬件和软件系统，并制定规格和性能要求。可以维护应用程序领域内的数据库，单独工作或作为团队的一部分协调数据库开发。
jobs.de: Research, design, and develop computer and network software or specialized utility programs. Analyze user needs and develop software solutions, applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. Update software or enhance existing software capabilities. May work with computer hardware engineers to integrate hardware and software systems, and develop specifications and performance requirements. May maintain databases within an application area, working individually or coordinating database development as part of a team.

jobs.t: 网络和数字界面设计师
jobs.d: 设计数字用户界面或网站。开发和测试布局、界面、功能和导航菜单，以确保跨浏览器或设备的兼容性和可用性。可以使用 Web 框架应用程序以及客户端代码和流程。可以根据网络和可访问性标准评估网页设计，并可以分析网络使用指标并优化网站的适销性和搜索引擎排名。可以设计和测试促进人机交互的界面，并最大限度地提高数字设备、网站和软件的可用性，重点关注美观和设计。可以创建网站中使用的图形并管理网站内容和链接。
jobs.de: Design digital user interfaces or websites. Develop and test layouts, interfaces, functionality, and navigation menus to ensure compatibility and usability across browsers or devices. May use web framework applications as well as client-side code and processes. May evaluate web design following web and accessibility standards, and may analyze web use metrics and optimize websites for marketability and search engine ranking. May design and test interfaces that facilitate the human-computer interaction and maximize the usability of digital devices, websites, and software with a focus on aesthetics and design. May create graphics used in websites and manage website content and links.

jobs.d: 未单独列出的所有计算机职业。
jobs.de: All computer occupations not listed separately.

jobs.d: 通过使用对手工具和技术进行模拟内部和外部网络攻击来评估网络系统安全性。尝试破坏和利用关键系统并获取敏感信息以评估系统安全性。
jobs.de: Evaluate network system security by conducting simulated internal and external cyberattacks using adversary tools and techniques. Attempt to breach and exploit critical systems and gain access to sensitive information to assess system security.

jobs.d: 制定并监督信息安全程序和政策的实施。构建、维护和升级安全技术，例如防火墙，以安全使用计算机网络以及信息的传输和检索。设计并实施适当的安全控制，以识别漏洞并保护数字文件和电子基础设施。监控和响应计算机安全漏洞、病毒和入侵，并进行取证调查。可以监督信息安全系统的评估。
jobs.de: Develop and oversee the implementation of information security procedures and policies. Build, maintain and upgrade security technology, such as firewalls, for the safe use of computer networks and the transmission and retrieval of information. Design and implement appropriate security controls to identify vulnerabilities and protect digital files and electronic infrastructures. Monitor and respond to computer security breaches, viruses, and intrusions, and perform forensic investigation. May oversee the assessment of information security systems.

jobs.d: 对基于计算机的犯罪进行调查，建立文件或实物证据，例如与网络入侵事件相关的数字媒体和日志。分析数字证据并调查计算机安全事件，以获取支持系统和网络漏洞缓解的信息。保存和提供与计算机相关的证据，以支持犯罪、欺诈、反情报或执法调查。
jobs.de: Conduct investigations on computer-based crimes establishing documentary or physical evidence, such as digital media and logs associated with cyber intrusion incidents. Analyze digital evidence and investigate computer security incidents to derive information in support of system and network vulnerability mitigation. Preserve and present computer-related evidence in support of criminal, fraud, counterintelligence, or law enforcement investigations.

jobs.d: 维护和支持分布式和去中心化的基于区块链的网络或区块链应用程序，例如加密货币交换、支付处理、文档共享和数字投票。使用先进技术在地理分布式网络上设计和部署安全的区块链设计模式和解决方案。可以协助基础设施设置和测试，以实现应用程序透明度和安全性。
jobs.de: Maintain and support distributed and decentralized blockchain-based networks or block-chain applications such as cryptocurrency exchange, payment processing, document sharing, and digital voting. Design and deploy secure block-chain design patterns and solutions over geographically distributed networks using advanced technologies. May assist with infrastructure setup and testing for application transparency and security.

jobs.d: 开发并实施一套技术或分析应用程序，使用面向数据的编程语言和可视化软件将原始数据转换为有意义的信息。应用数据挖掘、数据建模、自然语言处理和机器学习从大型结构化和非结构化数据集中提取和分析信息。可视化、解释和报告数据结果。可以创建动态数据报告。
jobs.de: Develop and implement a set of techniques or analytics applications to transform raw data into meaningful information using data-oriented programming languages and visualization software. Apply data mining, data modeling, natural language processing, and machine learning to extract and analyze information from large structured and unstructured datasets. Visualize, interpret, and report data findings. May create dynamic data reports.

jobs.d: 未单独列出的所有数学科学家。
jobs.de: All mathematical scientists not listed separately.

jobs.d: 通过应用测量科学、数学、物理、化学和电子学知识，有时在工程人员的指导下，执行或调整校准测量设备的程序和技术。确定测量标准是否适合校准测量设备。可以对设备进行预防性维护。可以采取纠正措施来解决已发现的校准问题。
jobs.de: Execute or adapt procedures and techniques for calibrating measurement devices, by applying knowledge of measurement science, mathematics, physics, chemistry, and electronics, sometimes under the direction of engineering staff. Determine measurement standard suitability for calibrating measurement devices. May perform preventive maintenance on equipment. May perform corrective actions to address identified calibration problems.

jobs.d: 收集和整理有关地下水和地表水的分布和循环，及其物理、化学和生物特性的数据。测量并报告流速和地下水位、维护现场设备、收集水样、安装和收集采样设备以及处理样品以运送到测试实验室。可以代表水文学家、工程师、开发商、政府机构或农业收集数据。
jobs.de: Collect and organize data concerning the distribution and circulation of ground and surface water, and data on its physical, chemical, and biological properties. Measure and report on flow rates and ground water levels, maintain field equipment, collect water samples, install and collect sampling equipment, and process samples for shipment to testing laboratories. May collect data on behalf of hydrologists, engineers, developers, government agencies, or agriculture.

jobs.de: Teach academic, social, and life skills to kindergarten students with learning, emotional, or physical disabilities. Includes teachers who specialize and work with students who are blind or have visual impairments; students who are deaf or have hearing impairments; and students with intellectual disabilities.

jobs.d: 在陆地或水生环境中的战斗情况下指导坦克、轻型装甲和两栖攻击车辆部队的操作。职责包括指导机组人员操作瞄准和射击系统；协调先进机载通信和导航设备的运行；指挥作战期间人员和装备的运输；制定和实施作战计划，包括装甲车辆部队的战术运用；并与步兵、炮兵和空中支援部队协调。
jobs.de: Direct the operation of tanks, light armor, and amphibious assault vehicle units during combat situations on land or in aquatic environments. Duties include directing crew members in the operation of targeting and firing systems; coordinating the operation of advanced onboard communications and navigation equipment; directing the transport of personnel and equipment during combat; formulating and implementing battle plans, including the tactical employment of armored vehicle units; and coordinating with infantry, artillery, and air support units.

jobs.d: 管理人员和武器行动，摧毁敌方阵地、飞机和船只。职责包括规划、瞄准和协调野战炮兵和防空炮兵导弹系统部队的战术部署；指导火控通信系统的建立和运行；瞄准并发射洲际弹道导弹；指导核弹药及其部件的储存和处理；监督武器储存和发射设施的安全；以及管理武器系统的维护。
jobs.de: Manage personnel and weapons operations to destroy enemy positions, aircraft, and vessels. Duties include planning, targeting, and coordinating the tactical deployment of field artillery and air defense artillery missile systems units; directing the establishment and operation of fire control communications systems; targeting and launching intercontinental ballistic missiles; directing the storage and handling of nuclear munitions and components; overseeing security of weapons storage and launch facilities; and managing maintenance of weapons systems.

jobs.d: 管理对于控制空中、地面和海军行动至关重要的通信、探测和武器系统的运行。职责包括管理空军、海军和地面部队之间的关键通信联系；制定并实施自然灾害和战时灾害应急预案；协调应急响应小组和机构；评估指挥中心信息以及高层军事和政府报告的需求；管理监视和检测系统的运行；提供有关能力和运营准备情况的技术信息和建议；指挥武器瞄准、射击和发射计算机系统的操作。
jobs.de: Manage the operation of communications, detection, and weapons systems essential for controlling air, ground, and naval operations. Duties include managing critical communication links between air, naval, and ground forces; formulating and implementing emergency plans for natural and wartime disasters; coordinating emergency response teams and agencies; evaluating command center information and need for high-level military and government reporting; managing the operation of surveillance and detection systems; providing technical information and advice on capabilities and operational readiness; and directing operation of weapons targeting, firing, and launch computer systems.

jobs.d: 在地面作战行动中指挥、训练和领导步兵部队。职责包括指挥步兵武器、车辆和装备的部署；指导步兵阵地和装备的选址、建造和伪装；管理现场通信业务；与装甲、炮兵和空中支援部队协调；执行战略和战术规划，包括制定作战计划；并领导基本侦察行动。
jobs.de: Direct, train, and lead infantry units in ground combat operations. Duties include directing deployment of infantry weapons, vehicles, and equipment; directing location, construction, and camouflage of infantry positions and equipment; managing field communications operations; coordinating with armor, artillery, and air support units; performing strategic and tactical planning, including battle plan development; and leading basic reconnaissance operations.

jobs.d: 领导精英团队在战斗或和平时期通过空中、陆地或海上实施非常规行动。这些活动包括进攻性袭击、爆破、侦察、搜救和反恐。除了战斗训练外，特种部队军官还经常接受游泳、潜水、跳伞、生存、急救医学和外语等方面的专门训练。职责包括指挥先进侦察行动和评估情报信息；招募、训练和装备友军；领导对敌方领土的袭击和入侵；培训人员执行个别任务和应急计划；为政治敏感任务执行战略和战术规划；并操作先进的通信设备。
jobs.de: Lead elite teams that implement unconventional operations by air, land, or sea during combat or peacetime. These activities include offensive raids, demolitions, reconnaissance, search and rescue, and counterterrorism. In addition to their combat training, special forces officers often have specialized training in swimming, diving, parachuting, survival, emergency medicine, and foreign languages. Duties include directing advanced reconnaissance operations and evaluating intelligence information; recruiting, training, and equipping friendly forces; leading raids and invasions on enemy territories; training personnel to implement individual missions and contingency plans; performing strategic and tactical planning for politically sensitive missions; and operating sophisticated communications equipment.

jobs.de: Supervise and coordinate the activities of air crew members. Supervisors may also perform the same activities as the workers they supervise.

jobs.de: Supervise and coordinate the activities of all other tactical operations specialists not classified separately above. Supervisors may also perform the same activities as the workers they supervise.

jobs.d: 履行飞行职责，以确保成功完成战斗、侦察、运输和搜救任务。职责包括操作飞机通信和探测设备，包括建立卫星联系和干扰敌方通信能力；对机载设备进行飞行前、飞行中和飞行后检查；操作和维护飞机武器和防御系统；操作和维护飞机空中加油系统；执行飞机安全和应急程序；计算和验证乘客、货物、燃料以及紧急和特种设备的重量和平衡数据；
jobs.de: Perform in-flight duties to ensure the successful completion of combat, reconnaissance, transport, and search and rescue missions. Duties include operating aircraft communications and detection equipment, including establishing satellite linkages and jamming enemy communications capabilities; conducting preflight, in-flight, and postflight inspections of onboard equipment; operating and maintaining aircraft weapons and defensive systems; operating and maintaining aircraft in-flight refueling systems; executing aircraft safety and emergency procedures; computing and verifying passenger, cargo, fuel, and emergency and special equipment weight and balance data; and conducting cargo and personnel drops.

jobs.d: 操作和维护主要涉及航空母舰起飞和着陆操作的弹射器、阻拦装置以及相关机械、液压和控制系统。职责包括安装和维护目视着陆辅助设备；使用电气和机械测试设备以及手动工具测试和维护发射和回收设备；在紧急着陆情况下启动机场制动系统，例如防撞栏和电缆；使用手势或灯光信号指挥飞机起飞和回收操作；维护飞机发射、回收和设备维护的日志。
jobs.de: Operate and maintain catapults, arresting gear, and associated mechanical, hydraulic, and control systems involved primarily in aircraft carrier takeoff and landing operations. Duties include installing and maintaining visual landing aids; testing and maintaining launch and recovery equipment using electric and mechanical test equipment and hand tools; activating airfield arresting systems, such as crash barriers and cables, during emergency landing situations; directing aircraft launch and recovery operations using hand or light signals; and maintaining logs of airplane launches, recoveries, and equipment maintenance.

jobs.d: 在陆地或水生环境中的战斗情况下操作坦克、轻型装甲和两栖攻击车辆。职责包括驾驶需要专门训练的装甲车；操作和维护瞄准和发射系统；操作和维护先进的机载通信和导航设备；在战斗环境中运输人员和装备；操作和维护辅助武器，包括机枪和榴弹发射器。
jobs.de: Operate tanks, light armor, and amphibious assault vehicles during combat situations on land or in aquatic environments. Duties include driving armored vehicles that require specialized training; operating and maintaining targeting and firing systems; operating and maintaining advanced onboard communications and navigation equipment; transporting personnel and equipment in a combat environment; and operating and maintaining auxiliary weapons, including machine guns and grenade launchers.

jobs.d: 瞄准、射击和维护用于摧毁敌方阵地、飞机和船只的武器。野战炮兵在地面作战行动中主要使用火炮、加农炮和榴弹炮，而防空炮兵则主要使用导弹和火箭。海军炮兵人员主要使用从舰艇或潜艇发射的鱼雷和导弹。职责包括测试、检查和储存弹药、导弹和鱼雷；对武器及相关设备进行预防性和日常维护；建立和维护无线电和有线通信；以及操作武器瞄准、射击和发射计算机系统。
jobs.de: Target, fire, and maintain weapons used to destroy enemy positions, aircraft, and vessels. Field artillery crew members predominantly use guns, cannons, and howitzers in ground combat operations, while air defense artillery crew members predominantly use missiles and rockets. Naval artillery crew members predominantly use torpedoes and missiles launched from a ship or submarine. Duties include testing, inspecting, and storing ammunition, missiles, and torpedoes; conducting preventive and routine maintenance on weapons and related equipment; establishing and maintaining radio and wire communications; and operating weapons targeting, firing, and launch computer systems.

jobs.d: 操作和监控对于控制空中、地面和海军行动至关重要的通信、探测和武器系统。职责包括维护和中继空中、海军和地面部队之间的关键通信；实施自然灾害和战时灾害应急预案；将指挥中心信息转发给高级军事和政府决策者；监控监视和探测系统，例如防空系统；解释和评估战术情况并向上级提出建议；以及操作武器瞄准、射击和发射计算机系统。
jobs.de: Operate and monitor communications, detection, and weapons systems essential for controlling air, ground, and naval operations. Duties include maintaining and relaying critical communications between air, naval, and ground forces; implementing emergency plans for natural and wartime disasters; relaying command center information to high-level military and government decisionmakers; monitoring surveillance and detection systems, such as air defense; interpreting and evaluating tactical situations and making recommendations to superiors; and operating weapons targeting, firing, and launch computer systems.

jobs.d: 在地面作战行动中操作武器和装备。职责包括操作和维护武器，如步枪、机枪、迫击炮和手榴弹；定位、建造和伪装步兵阵地和装备；评估地形并记录地形信息；操作和维护现场通信设备；评估火力支援需求并指挥；在陆地上放置炸药和进行扫雷活动；并参与基本侦察行动。
jobs.de: Operate weapons and equipment in ground combat operations. Duties include operating and maintaining weapons, such as rifles, machine guns, mortars, and hand grenades; locating, constructing, and camouflaging infantry positions and equipment; evaluating terrain and recording topographical information; operating and maintaining field communications equipment; assessing need for and directing supporting fire; placing explosives and performing minesweeping activities on land; and participating in basic reconnaissance operations.

jobs.d: 在战斗或和平时期作为精锐团队成员通过空中、陆地或海上实施非常规行动。这些活动包括进攻性袭击、爆破、侦察、搜救和反恐。除了战斗训练外，特种部队成员还经常接受游泳、潜水、跳伞、生存、急救医学和外语等方面的专门训练。职责包括进行高级侦察行动和收集情报信息；招募、训练和装备友军；对敌方领土进行袭击和入侵；为拆除目标埋设和引爆炸药；定位、识别、拆除和处置军械；以及操作和维护复杂的通信设备。
jobs.de: Implement unconventional operations by air, land, or sea during combat or peacetime as members of elite teams. These activities include offensive raids, demolitions, reconnaissance, search and rescue, and counterterrorism. In addition to their combat training, special forces members often have specialized training in swimming, diving, parachuting, survival, emergency medicine, and foreign languages. Duties include conducting advanced reconnaissance operations and collecting intelligence information; recruiting, training, and equipping friendly forces; conducting raids and invasions on enemy territories; laying and detonating explosives for demolition targets; locating, identifying, defusing, and disposing of ordnance; and operating and maintaining sophisticated communications equipment.
